The text is not divided in paragraphs so it is wrapped in an ab-element. Pages 41-49 have charts and graphics. The text in the charts was encoded in table-elements, when possible. Text embedded in graphic elements was not encoded.

children.text: मानसदीपिकारामायणटीका ।।
children.translated_text: The <s>Mānasadīpikā</s> Commentary on the <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s>.

children.text: श्रीगणेशायनमः ।। अथ श्रीसीताराम परमभक्त गोस्वामी तुलसीदास
कृतस्य श्रीमत् भाषारामायणस्य मानस दीपिका समाख्याया टीकाया भू-
children.translated_text: is being written. Therein, first the auspicious invocation. <s>Dohā</s> (couplet):

children.text: मिका लिख्यते । तत्रादौ मंगलाचरणं दोहा ।। परशुधरन संपतिभरन अवं
children.translated_text: The introduction to the commentary named <s>Mānasadīpikā</s> on the glorious vernacular <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s> is [now] written. First, the auspicious invocation. <s>Dohā</s>: O <s>Gaṇeśa</s>, wielder of the axe, bestower of wealth, crusher of obstacles,

children.text: टरटरन गनेश । विघनहरन मंगलकरन राखहु शरन हमेश १ एकरदन करि
children.translated_text: remover of obstacles, maker of auspiciousness — always keep [us] in your shelter. 1. O one-tusked, elephant-faced, abode of <s>siddhi</s> (accomplishment), giver of joy —

children.text: वर बदन सिद्धिसदन मुददानि । मदन कदन नंदन जपहु जगवंदन जिय
children.translated_text: destroyer of <s>Madana</s> (Cupid), O <s>Nandana</s> (son of Śiva), meditate upon the one worshipped by the world, knowing him in the heart. 2. Vermilion-hued, with a face like a thousand elephants, whose bright white tusks shine forth —

children.text: जानि २ सिंदुर सहसिंधुरवदन रदन विशद द्युतिभाति । ईश्ववरकबि फबि
children.translated_text: the poet of <s>Īśvara</s> (the Lord), beholding him, says that the beauty of the sun and the thunderbolt is surpassed. 3. Now, a brief description of the royal lineage.

children.text: वो निरखि रबि पबि छबि दबिजाति ३ अथ संक्षेपतो राजवंश वर्णनं ।
children.translated_text: <s>Haripadachand</s> meter: Supremely austere, radiant — the illustrious <s>Barkhaḍū Miśra</s>;

children.text: हरिपदछंद । परमतपस्वी तेजस्वी बरखिडू मिश्र उजागर । हुतेवेद विद
children.translated_text: versed in the <s>Vedas</s>, worthy of veneration by the learned, an ocean of auspicious truth and fair renown. 4.

children.text: वन्दनीय शुभ सत्यसुयशकेसागर ४ गौतम गोत्र सुपात्र पेखि पदपंकजपै
children.translated_text: Seeing him as a worthy vessel of the <s>Gautama</s> <s>gotra</s> (lineage), [the emperor] placed his lotus feet upon [his] head,

children.text: शिरधरकै । दये ग्राम बसुबिंशति जिनको नृपवनार छलकरिकै ५ क्यों छल
children.translated_text: and gave him twenty-two villages — to him, through a stratagem of the king of <s>Varanasi</s>. 5. What stratagem was employed?

children.text: कियो कौनथल कैसे कौन लह्योफल भारी । बहुरि मिश्रजूको प्रभाव अरु
children.translated_text: What land? How? Who obtained the great fruit? Furthermore, the greatness of the <s>Miśra</s> [family] and

children.text: वंशावली सुखारी ६ यहसबकथा कहांलगि कहिये सुनहुसुजनसुखदानी ।
children.translated_text: the pleasant genealogy — 6. How far shall this entire tale be told? Listen, O givers of joy to the good!

children.text: काशिराजचन्द्रिका ग्रंथ में सह विस्तार बखानी ७ यहप्रसंग बसकहां कहौं
children.translated_text: It is narrated in detail in the book called <s>Kāśirājacandrikā</s>. 7. Why should I elaborate on this subject?

children.text: ते बंशावली अदूषित । जाहिरह्वै जगमें विशेष जेहि कियोबंश निजभूषित ८
children.translated_text: That unblemished genealogy — which shone forth in the world especially, which adorned the lineage — 8.

children.text: विडूमिश्च मुनीश्वरजूके बंशमाहिंप्रगटेहैं । महाराज बरबंड सिंह जिनप्रबल
children.translated_text: In the lineage of the great sage <s>Biḍūmiśra</s>, there appeared

children.text: प्रतीयठटेहैं ९ बनेठनेपरगने छानबेगनेघने मनभाये । तिन्हैंराखि निजशरण
children.translated_text: Mahārāja <s>Barabaṇḍasiṃha</s>, whose mighty prowess was renowned. 9. Keeping many estates and thick forested <s>parganas</s> in his protection,

children.text: शत्रुहति काशीराज कहाये १० कहौंसत्य सुनबेकों सतजन सावधान मन
children.translated_text: having destroyed enemies, he was called the King of <s>Kāśī</s>. 10. I speak the truth — listen, O virtuous ones, with attentive minds.

children.text: हूजो । नृपबरिवंडसमान जगतमें नृपवरिवंडनदूजो ११ तासुधर्म अरु राज
children.translated_text: In the world, there was no other king equal to King <s>Barivaṇḍa</s>. 11. His son, beautiful, was the rightful heir to both <s>dharma</s> (righteousness) and the kingdom —

children.text: दुहूंको अधिकारी सुत सुन्दर । नृपमहीप नारायण प्रगटे प्रोद्धत पुहुमि पुरं
children.translated_text: King <s>Mahīpa Nārāyaṇa</s> appeared, like <s>Indra</s> arisen upon the earth. 12.

children.text: दर १२ तिनकेसुतभे तीनतीनिहूं सबप्रकार सबलायक । जिहकोयश जहान
children.translated_text: His sons were three, all worthy in every way,

children.text: मेंजाहिर गानकरत गुनगायक १३ तिन्हमें ज्येष्ठ श्रेष्ठ काशीपति नृपति
children.translated_text: whose fame was manifest in the world — singers sang of their virtues. 13. Among them, the eldest and best, the lord of <s>Kāśī</s>, King

children.text: उदितनारायण । तदनुदीपनारायण बाबूपरमपुण्यपारायण १४ तदनुप्रसिद्ध
children.translated_text: <s>Uditanārāyaṇa</s>; then <s>Dīpanārāyaṇa Bābū</s>, supremely devoted to meritorious deeds. 14. Then, famous in the world,

children.text: जगतमें बाबू श्रीप्रसिद्धनारायण । दान देतहरि ध्यान धरत गुणगान करत
children.translated_text: <s>Bābū Śrīprasiddhanārāyaṇa</s> — giving charity, meditating on <s>Hari</s>, singing the virtues

children.text: रामायण १५ अथातिसंक्षेप क्रमेण राज श्रीराजधानी राजसभा बर्णनम् ।।
children.translated_text: of the <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s>. 15. Now, a very brief description of the glorious royal capital, the royal court.

children.text: दोहा ।। श्रीकाशीपति नृपतिकीअतिराजत श्रीभाति । रचितराजधानीरुचिर
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: The glory of the lord of <s>Kāśī</s>, the king, shines exceedingly;

children.text: सुखदानीसरसाति १६ सभाभूरिशोभाभरीभूषितप्रभाविभाति । निजकररची
children.translated_text: the beautiful capital, giver of happiness, is most delightful. 16. The court, filled with abundant splendor, adorned and radiant —

children.text: मानसदीपिका रामायण टी० ।। ३
children.translated_text: <s>Mānasadīpikā Rāmāyaṇa</s> Commentary. 3.

children.text: विरंचिजनु रंचनबरणीजाति १७ अथमुख्य प्रसंगबर्णन हरिगीतिकाछंद ।
children.translated_text: as if fashioned by <s>Brahmā</s> himself, beyond description. 17. Now the description of the main topic. <s>Harigītikā</s> meter:

children.text: तिहिसभावरबिचराजगादी सत्यबादी भ्राजते । नृपउदितनारायणरहेमन
children.translated_text: In that court, upon the excellent throne of deliberation, the truthful one shines forth —

children.text: मुदित नित्य विराजते ।। अतिसुमति प्रबल प्रताप सुयश कलाप गुणगण
children.translated_text: King <s>Uditanārāyaṇa</s> abides, ever delighted in mind, resplendent,

children.text: धामसे ।। जगमें उजागर शीलसागर रूपआगर कामसे १८ सहबंधु शोभा
children.translated_text: of supreme wisdom, mighty prowess, fame, and a multitude of qualities, an abode of virtues —

children.text: सिंधु बैठे एक दिन दिनमें रहे । जनु धर्मराज सभीम अर्जुन पेखि छबि
children.translated_text: illustrious in the world, an ocean of good character, a mine of beauty, like <s>Kāma</s> (the god of love). 18. Seated one day together with [his] brother, who is an ocean of beauty —

children.text: सबहीकहे ।। तहँ दासतुलसीरवित रामायन कथाके अर्थको । चलि भो
children.translated_text: as if beholding <s>Dharmarāja</s>, <s>Bhīma</s>, and <s>Arjuna</s> — all exclaimed at the sight.

children.text: प्रसंग सुढंग भाषै सर्ब अंग समर्थको १९ इहिहेत अंग समेत टीको नि-
children.translated_text: There, the servant <s>Tulasī</s>, learned in the meaning of the <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s> narrative, began

children.text: पट नीकोईबनै ।। जिहिजगत सनमानै सुधीशकबीशबृंद भलोभनै ।। सुनि
children.translated_text: a discourse in elegant language, competent in all aspects. 19. For this purpose, a commentary complete with [all] parts would be well made,

children.text: सभासदभेकण्ठ गदगदगिरासुखप्रदमुदमर्ह । कहिजयति काशीराज आज
children.translated_text: which the world would honor — which hosts of wise poets and scholars would approve. Hearing this,

children.text: अनूप यह आज्ञाभई २० चौपार्ह ।। बाबू श्रीप्रसिद्ध नारायण । भूसुर भक्त
children.translated_text: the courtiers spoke with one voice, their words choked with joyful emotion, saying 'Victory to the King of <s>Kāśī</s>! Today

children.text: पुण्य पारायण ।। कबिकोविदहि महदभुददायक । भूयबन्धु सब बिधि सब
children.translated_text: this incomparable command has been given.' 20. <s>Chaupāī</s>: <s>Bābū Śrīprasiddhanārāyaṇa</s> —

children.text: लायक २१ भूपतिकी आज्ञाअतिभारी । अद्भुत अमित जगतहितकारी ।।
children.translated_text: devoted to Brahmins, meritorious, a great giver of happiness to poets and scholars,

children.text: सुनतश्रवण निजशिरपरधारी । समुझिसुखद सुरतरुकी डारी २२ क्योंकि
children.translated_text: a brother to the earth, in every way worthy. 21. The command of the king is most weighty,

children.text: तिलक द्वैनृप विरचाये । जे अतिअद्भुत जगतकहाये ।। पहलोतिलक राम
children.translated_text: wondrous, immeasurable, and for the benefit of the world.

children.text: लीलाबर । जिहि लखिपरत न तिमिर कूपनर २३ सोरठादि दोहा समु-
children.translated_text: Hearing it, bearing it upon his own head, understanding it as a bliss-giving branch of the wish-fulfilling tree. 22. Because

children.text: दाई । छन्दअमन्द चारु चौपाई ।। जाकोजहं अर्थहैजैसो ।। लीला ललित
children.translated_text: two <s>tilakas</s> (commentaries) were composed by the king, which are called most wondrous in the world.

children.text: लखावति तैसो २४ दूजो तिलक सकल मन भायो ।। रामायण सहचित्र
children.translated_text: The first <s>tilaka</s> is the excellent <s>Rāmalīlā</s> (divine play of <s>Rāma</s>),

children.text: लिखायो ।। मूर्तिवन्तजनु अर्थविराजै । जिहिलखि अर्थकथन लजिभाजै
children.translated_text: seeing which, the person in the pit of darkness [of ignorance] does not remain [in darkness]. 23. <s>Sorathā</s> and other <s>dohā</s> meters,

children.text: २५ यद्यपि तिलक दिव्य ये दोऊ । अति प्रसन्न इनतें सबकोऊ।। तदपि
children.translated_text: abundant, beautiful <s>caupāīs</s> — wherever the meaning is as it should be,

children.text: सकल पुरनगर निवासी । जेहैं रामायण अभ्यासी २६ तिन्हैं न सुलभ
children.translated_text: the charming divine play shows it likewise. 24. The second <s>tilaka</s> pleased all minds —

children.text: सुलभहू जिनको । सोउनसदा न सनथलतिनको ।। तातें सुलभ सदाअरु
children.translated_text: the <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s> with illustrations was commissioned.

children.text: सब थल । तीजो तिलकवरणमय अति भल २७ बनै भूप यह आज्ञाकी-
children.translated_text: As if the meaning shines forth embodied — seeing which, even verbal explanation feels ashamed. 25. Although both these <s>tilakas</s> are divine,

children.text: न्हीं । वांछितअति संपतिजनुदीन्हीं ।। इहितेसमुझिकामतरुडारी । नृपति
children.translated_text: and everyone is most pleased with them,

children.text: अनुज निज शिरपर धारी २८ तब निज भक्ति समेत अनुज कहँ । पेखि
children.translated_text: yet all residents of the city and town who are practitioners of the <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s> — 26.

children.text: भयेनृप प्रमुदितमनमहँ ।। षट्पदी ।। प्रमुदित ह्वै नृपनीतिरीति सतप्रीति
children.translated_text: for them it is not easily available, and even those for whom it is available —

children.text: अमितहित । दानसबुधि सनमान ज्ञान भगवान ध्याननित ।। रागरंगसत
children.translated_text: it is not always accessible to them everywhere.

children.text: संग अंगयुत अति अभंगतहँ । परमधर्मलगि यज्ञकरत सर्बज्ञ नृपतिकहँ ।।
children.translated_text: Therefore, easily available at all times and in all places, a third <s>tilaka</s>, made of words, most excellent. 27. 'Let it be made' — the king issued this command,

children.text: बहुबर्ष अमल उत्कर्ष अति हर्ष सहित बीततभये ।। लखि नेमक्षेम प्रदप्रेम
children.translated_text: as if he had given the most desired wealth.

children.text: निज पूर्णतूर्ण रघुपतिदये २९ दोहा ।। काशिराज नृपराजतब मनमेंकियो
children.translated_text: Understanding this as a branch of the wish-fulfilling tree, the king's younger brother bore it upon his own head. 28. Then, seeing his younger brother endowed with devotion,

children.text: विचार । सबप्रकारसामर्थ्ययुत अबयहभयोकुमार ३० वयलघुअलघुप्रताप
children.translated_text: the king became greatly delighted in his mind.

children.text: अति सुयशवंत गंभीर । शील सिंधु शोभा उदधि धर्म धुरंधर धीर ३१
children.translated_text: <s>Ṣaṭpadī</s> (six-line verse): Delighted, the king, with proper conduct and policy, true affection, immeasurable benevolence,

children.text: दयावन्त दानीबड़ो सतगुणवन्तसुजान । अस्त्रशस्त्रमें विज्ञतरवरकृतज्ञबल
children.translated_text: giving with wisdom, honoring knowledge, ever meditating on the Lord,

children.text: वान ३२ बहुबिधि विद्यानिधिविविध बुद्धिसमृद्धि निधान । सतसंगति
children.translated_text: with passion for music, in good company, complete in all limbs, utterly unbreakable —

children.text: रति समुझि अति नरपति मुदित महान ३३ नेहहिकरि हरिचरण ते
children.translated_text: engaged in sacrifice (<s>yajña</s>) for the sake of supreme <s>dharma</s>, the omniscient king.

children.text: देहहि परखि अनित्य ।स ुतहि तुरत युवराजकैभ ूप भये कृतकृत्य ३४
children.translated_text: Many years passed with purity, distinction, and great joy;

children.text: षट्पदी ।। तदनन्तर शुभकरन सुमरि गुरुचरन चारुतर । सुनत दीह दुख
children.translated_text: seeing the blessed <s>Raghupati</s> (Lord <s>Rāma</s>) fully grant [his] devotion, discipline, welfare, and love. 29. <s>Dohā</s>: The King of <s>Kāśī</s>, the king, then deliberated in his mind:

children.text: दरनग्रन्थगीतादि मुक्तिकर ।। सकलसुबुध सनमानसाधु गुणगानज्ञानरत ।
children.translated_text: 'Now this prince has become endowed with all kinds of ability.' 30. Young in age yet great in prowess,

children.text: करत दान हरि ध्यानधरत नहिं आन आचरत ।। कीते सुवर्ष बीते जबहिं
children.translated_text: of fair fame, profound, an ocean of good character, an ocean of beauty, a champion of <s>dharma</s>, steadfast — 31.

children.text: तब प्रकर्ष हर्षहि लह्यो । है प्राप्त काम निजनाम करि परमधाम जैबो
children.translated_text: compassionate, a great giver, endowed with true virtues, wise,

children.text: चह्यो ३५ चौपाई ।। अष्टादशशतद्विनवति १८९२ संबत्अतिपुनीत रवि
children.translated_text: expert in weapons and missiles, the finest, grateful, and powerful. 32. A treasure of many kinds of learning, a storehouse of varied intelligence and prosperity —

children.text: सौम्य गोलगति ।। चैत्रशुक्लषष्ठी शनिवासर । मध्यदिवसलहि समय शुद्ध
children.translated_text: understanding this, with delight in holy company, the great king was joyful. 33. Having attached his heart to the feet of <s>Hari</s>,

children.text: तर ३६ कवित्त ।। लक्षन मँगायकरि परम सुलक्षणकी गाय वरवच्छनकी
children.translated_text: perceiving the body as impermanent, making his son crown prince at once, the king became fulfilled. 34.

children.text: पूरणपननिसों । केसकैंबखानि अलकेशकीसी संपतहू काशिकेश उद्दितदै
children.translated_text: <s>Ṣaṭpadī</s>: Thereafter, performing auspicious [deeds], remembering the feet of the <s>guru</s>, most beautiful,

children.text: बेदकीभननिसों ।। काशीमाहिं बैठ कमलासन कुशासनपै श्वासन समेटि
children.translated_text: listening to texts and songs that destroy the sorrow of long suffering and grant liberation,

children.text: कै समाधिकी बननिसों ।। सत्यसंधयशके प्रबन्धसुनि ह्वैकै मगब्रह्मरंध्रतन
children.translated_text: honoring all the wise, devoted to the praise and knowledge of the virtues of saints,

children.text: छोड़ि छूटे बंधननिसों ३७ चौपाई ।। तब युवराजसमय लखि शुभतर ।
children.translated_text: giving charity, meditating on <s>Hari</s>, not following any other practice.

children.text: राज तिलक लहि सुख सुखमाकर ।। साजसकाय सत्यवादीबर ।। बैठे
children.translated_text: When several auspicious years had passed, then great excellence and joy were attained.

children.text: राज राजगादीपर ३८ कवित्त ।। बैठे राज ईश्वरीप्रसाद नारायणसिंह दी-
children.translated_text: 'My purpose is fulfilled; having made my name, I desire to go to the supreme abode.' 35. <s>Caupāī</s>: In the most sacred year 1892 [Vikrama Saṃvat], on a Monday with the sun in transit,

children.text: पतिदराज शुभसाज सजेतनहैं । बरैगिन ओजनसों हीन बिन फौजनह्वै
children.translated_text: on the <s>ṣaṣṭhī</s> (sixth) of the bright half of <s>Caitra</s>, a Saturday, at the purest midday moment — 36.

children.text: भोजन विहाय बेगि भाजे बनबनहैं ।। राजे कबिकोबिद समूह यश साजे
children.translated_text: <s>Kavitta</s>: Having arranged for the charitable gift of a most excellent cow with fine markings and a fine calf, fulfilling all vows —

children.text: तिन बाजे बजे छाजे प्रजाबृंद छन छन हैं । आये जेपगन शीश जिन
children.translated_text: described by <s>Keśa</s> as possessing wealth like that of <s>Alakeśa</s> (<s>Kubera</s>), given by the Lord of <s>Kāśī</s> (<s>Udit</s>) with Vedic recitation —

children.text: के नगनपायमांगे धनगन ह्वैगे मगनमगनहैं ३९ दोहा ।। तब मंगनगन
children.translated_text: seated in <s>Kāśī</s> upon a lotus seat on a <s>kuśa</s> grass mat, having withdrawn the breath in the manner of <s>samādhi</s> —

children.text: मगनह्वै मौजैंपाय विशेष । कियोगौननिज भौनप्रतिदै आशिषा अशेष ४०
children.translated_text: hearing the narrative of his truthful vow, becoming absorbed, leaving the body through the <s>brahmarandhra</s> (crown aperture), he was freed from bondage. 37. <s>Caupāī</s>: Then, seeing the auspicious time for the crown prince,

children.text: आशिषा यथा कवित्त ।। राजू भूप ईश्वरीप्रसाद नारायन सिंह रावरे
children.translated_text: having received the royal <s>tilaka</s> (consecration mark) with supreme joy,

children.text: प्रतापनकी पंगति भगीरहै । तंतकरि दशहू दिगंतर परियन्त सचीकन्त
children.translated_text: the truthful one, duly prepared, sat upon the royal throne. 38.

children.text: सी सुकीरति अनन्त उमगी रहै ।। ईश्वर विरजिराजकाज में परमक्षेम
children.translated_text: <s>Kavitta</s>: King <s>Īśvarīprasāda Nārāyaṇasiṃha</s> sat upon the royal throne, the king of lamps, adorned with auspicious preparations.

children.text: नेमसों निबाहें नीति प्रेमसों पगी रहै । काशिराज संयुत समाज जीवौ
children.translated_text: Mountains lost their luster before him; those without armies, abandoning their meals, quickly fled to the forests.

children.text: युगयुग जातों जगजीवनकी जीविकाजगीरहै ४१ दोहा ।। विद्यमान मनुजें
children.translated_text: Kings, assemblies of poets and scholars, adorned by his fame — bells rang, the populace rejoiced moment by moment.

children.text: द्रकहं जब समेत नृप नीति । राजकरति अतिहर्षसोंकिते बर्षगेबीति ४२
children.translated_text: Those who came on foot, whose heads bore [no crowns] — the naked ones who begged for wealth — they all became absorbed in ecstasy. 39. <s>Dohā</s>: Then the begging multitudes, absorbed in ecstasy,

children.text: हरि गीतिका छंद ।। तब परम धाम निवास कारी काशिराज नरेश
children.translated_text: having obtained special delights, returned to their own homes, giving abundant blessings. 40.

children.text: शकी । जुविशेष आज्ञा शीशधारी ध्याय मूर्त्ति महेशकी ।। गुनिभूप बंधु
children.translated_text: Blessings as in the <s>Kavitta</s>: 'O King <s>Īśvarīprasāda Nārāyaṇasiṃha</s>! May the glory of your prowess

children.text: सुजान शोभासिंधु सोर्ह कहतभे । बर विद्यमान नरेश काशीराज सुनि
children.translated_text: be like that of <s>Bhagīratha</s>! May your infinite fair renown overflow to the ends of the ten directions, like that of the consort of <s>Śacī</s> (<s>Indra</s>)!

children.text: सुख लहतभे ४३ अवधेश भक्त सुव्यक्तविद्या युक्त सतगुन संचई । रघु-
children.translated_text: May <s>Īśvara</s> (the Lord) sustain you radiantly in royal affairs, with supreme welfare and propriety, steeped in love-filled conduct!

children.text: नाथदास वुधेंद्रपै मनुजेंद्रकी आज्ञाभई ।। तिनदास तुलसी रचित रामा
children.translated_text: May you live age after age, O King of <s>Kāśī</s>, with your assembly — your livelihood being the life of the world!' 41. <s>Dohā</s>: When the reigning king

children.text: यणसुटीका निर्मई । धरिनाम मानसदीपिका सब दीपजो दीपितभर्ह
children.translated_text: ruled with due policy, how many years passed with great joy? 42.

children.text: ४४ दोहा ।। मुद्रित मुद्राआक्षरनि लच्छन स्वच्छ समेत । दक्षनहेत समक्ष
children.translated_text: <s>Harigītikā</s> meter: Then, dwelling in the supreme abode [of <s>Kāśī</s>], the chief command of the King of <s>Kāśī</s>,

children.text: जनु अक्षय गिरानिकेत ४५ सोरठा ।। ईश्वरकवि कविराय भूरिभव्य हय
children.translated_text: bearing the special command upon his head, meditating on the form of <s>Maheśa</s> (Śiva) —

children.text: भूमिका । विरची आज्ञापाय विद्यमान मनुजेंद्रकी ४६ ।।
children.translated_text: the wise king's brother, the knower, ocean of beauty, <s>Sorha</s> — thus he spoke.

children.text: स्वस्तिश्रीकाशिराज महाराजाधिराज श्रीईश्वरीप्रसाद नारायणसिंहस्या
children.translated_text: The reigning King of <s>Kāśī</s> — hearing, he obtained happiness. 43. A devotee of the Lord of <s>Ayodhyā</s>, manifestly learned, endowed with true virtues —

children.text: ज्ञानुगामिना काशिबासि मिश्रोपनामकेन ईश्वराख्येन कबिना विर
children.translated_text: upon <s>Raghunāthadāsa Budhendra</s>, the command of the king was bestowed.

Obeisance to the glorious <s>Gaṇeśa</s>. Now, the introduction to the commentary called <s>Mānasadīpikā</s> on the glorious vernacular <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s> composed by <s>Gosvāmī Tulasīdāsa</s>, the supreme devotee of the glorious <s>Sītā</s> and <s>Rāma</s>,

children.text: चिता गोस्वामी तुलसीदासकृत श्रीमद्भाषा रामायणस्य
children.translated_text: The commentary on the <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s> composed by the servant <s>Tulasī</s> was produced,

children.text: मानसदीपिकासमाख्यायाटीकाया भूमिकासपूर्णम् ।।
children.translated_text: bearing the name <s>Mānasadīpikā</s> — a lamp that illuminates all lamps.

children.text: श्रीगणेशायनमः ।। दोहा ।। गणपति सियपति गौरिपति गौरिप्रभापति
पाय । वंदौवंदनजगतके चंदनलौंसुखदाय १ दुरितदोष दूषन दलन जासु
children.translated_text: carrying out the command of the reigning king. 46.

children.text: नाम भवसेतु । ताहिसुभिर टीका रचित काशिराज मुदहेतु २ यासभा में
children.translated_text: By the grace of the glorious Mahārājādhirāja of <s>Kāśī</s>, Śrī <s>Īśvarīprasāda Nārāyaṇasiṃha</s>,

children.text: विचारभयो पंडित अरु कविनसों श्री गोसाईंजी दासकृत रामायणग्रंथ
children.translated_text: following his command, by the poet named <s>Īśvara</s>, surnamed <s>Miśra</s>, resident of <s>Kāśī</s>,

children.text: बहुत विख्यातहै अरु याको तिलक बहुत महात्मोंने कियो है बाबा राम
children.translated_text: the introduction to the commentary named <s>Mānasadīpikā</s> on the glorious vernacular <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s> composed by <s>Gosvāmī Tulasīdāsa</s> is complete.

children.text: चरण दासजी अयोध्यासंत सिंहजी लाहौर राजागोपालशरण सिंह वकार
children.translated_text: Obeisance to the glorious <s>Gaṇeśa</s>. <s>Dohā</s>: I salute the feet of <s>Gaṇapati</s>, the Lord of <s>Sītā</s>, the Lord of <s>Gaurī</s>, and the Lord of <s>Gaurī</s>'s glory —

children.text: अरु स्वामीजी महाराज बर्तमान काशी जे निजगुरू श्री बिद्यारण्यतीर्थ
children.translated_text: the sandalwood-like givers of happiness to the world. 1. He whose name is the bridge over worldly existence, the crusher and destroyer of sin and fault —

children.text: स्वामीजी के नामते रामायण परिचर्या बनायो सो अति संक्षेपते सबको
children.translated_text: for him, this commentary has been composed with care, for the delight of the King of <s>Kāśī</s>. 2. In that court, a deliberation took place with scholars and poets:

children.text: ज्ञान नहीं होत ताकी आशय ख्यात कियो जाय अरु प्रथम उपोद्घातमें
children.translated_text: the <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s> text composed by Śrī <s>Gosvāmījī Dāsa</s> is very famous, and many great souls have composed <s>tilakas</s> (commentaries) on it —

children.text: रामायणको द्वैप्रकारको संदेह बर्णन कियो चाहिये एक सत्यत्वमें दूसरो
children.translated_text: <s>Bābā Rāmacaraṇadāsajī</s>, <s>Ayodhyā Santsiṃhajī</s>, <s>Lāhora Rājā Gopālaśaraṇa Siṃha Vakāra</s>,

children.text: प्रसंगके भेदमों एक वाक्यतापूर्वक बूझेमों आवै अरु स्मृति श्रुति ग्रंथांतर
children.translated_text: and <s>Svāmījī Mahārāja</s>, currently [residing in] <s>Kāśī</s>, who under the name of his own <s>guru</s> Śrī <s>Vidyāraṇyatīrtha Svāmījī</s> composed a <s>Rāmāyaṇa Paricaryā</s> —

children.text: को प्रमाण न लिख्योजाय हेतु कि या ग्रन्थको सबकोऊ देखैगो यातें श्री
children.translated_text: but that being very concise, complete knowledge does not arise from it. Its purport should be made known. And in the prolegomenon,

children.text: गोसाईंजके ग्रन्थनको प्रमाण दियोजाय अरु श्रीगोसाईं जी अरु औरहू
children.translated_text: two kinds of doubt regarding the <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s> should be described: one regarding its truth, and the second regarding differences in narrative episodes —

children.text: महात्मोंको सम्मत यहीहो कि ज्ञानभक्ति संपुटमें नामरत्नया रामायणमें
children.translated_text: so that they may be understood through the coherence of a single statement. And [external] proof from <s>Smṛti</s>, <s>Śruti</s>, or other texts

children.text: सिद्धांतहै औरहू रामायण विविध भांति प्रसिद्ध हैं रामायण सतकोटि
children.translated_text: should not be cited, because everyone will see this text — therefore, proof should be given from the texts of Śrī <s>Gosvāmījī</s> himself.

children.text: अपारा अरु अर्थ विषै जो सरलरीति अक्षरपदनते प्राप्त लोई मुख्य सो
children.translated_text: And the consensus of Śrī <s>Gosvāmījī</s> and other great souls is this: that the <s>Nāma-ratna</s> (jewel of the Name) in the casket of knowledge and devotion — the <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s> —

children.text: छडआग्रही जो अर्थ नहीं है सो करि आपन अर्थ निकारतहैं ताहीते मत-
children.translated_text: contains the established doctrine. And the <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s> is famous in various ways — 'the <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s> is a hundred <s>koṭi</s> (billion) [verses], boundless.'

children.text: नमों अब ऐसो विरोधहै कि जैसे एक बाक्यता सब देवतनके परत्व में
children.translated_text: And regarding the meaning: whatever is obtained simply and straightforwardly from the letters and words — that is primary. Setting that aside, those who are obstinate

children.text: होतहै सोऊ व्याक्ति अव्याक्ति करकैभी मतनमें ख्यातहै कष्टते अरु यहि
children.translated_text: extract their own meaning [that is not there] — and from that arise doctrinal disagreements. Just as

children.text: ग्रन्थमें अति आग्रह नाहीं राखत ताहेतुते याको सद्ग्रंथ मानत हैं अरु
children.translated_text: unity of statement exists regarding the supremacy of all the deities, that too, whether manifest or unmanifest,

children.text: मतग्रन्थके आचार्य बड़े बड़े भये हैं वामें जो विचार कियोजाय तौ जा
children.translated_text: is well known among doctrines, though with difficulty. And this text does not maintain extreme partisanship; therefore it is accepted as a true scripture.

children.text: स्थानपर सिद्धांत करत हैं कि एहीअर्थ सत्यहै आग्रहसे जो सिद्धांत है सो
children.translated_text: And the teachers of doctrinal texts have been very great; and if one examines them, wherever they establish their doctrine

children.text: रहिजात है सो पुरानादिकसों विरुद्ध भासत है परत्व सबपुराणमें भिन्नहै
children.translated_text: insisting 'this meaning alone is true' — that partisan doctrine contradicts the <s>Purāṇas</s> and other [scriptures]. The supremacy [of each deity] is different in each <s>Purāṇa</s>,

children.text: परंतु एकबाक्यता होइसकै है यथा मतवारनसो अरजयही कि अपनेअपने
children.translated_text: but coherence can be achieved. As requested of the proponents of [various] doctrines: do you accept

children.text: इष्टनकोतुम ब्यापकमानतहो कि नहीं उ० । ब्यापक मानौ तो इष्टनमें
children.translated_text: your chosen deities as pervading [all], or not? Reply: If you accept them as pervading, then among the chosen deities

children.text: कतहूं न वैर विरोध चही ।। नहिं व्यापक वहतो वाहूमें जीव दशा आय
children.translated_text: there is nowhere any enmity or opposition.

children.text: रही १ का निर्गुणका सर्गुण मतमें रहिहै एकै बात सही । सार भाग सब
children.translated_text: If not pervading, then in that too, the condition of the individual soul applies. 1. Whether in the <s>nirguṇa</s> (attributeless) or <s>saguṇa</s> (with attributes) doctrine, one thing remains true:

children.text: हीको लीजै रसते तजिये छाछमही २ बूसीबाद सारनिज करनी बोलगये
children.translated_text: take the essential portion from everyone; discard the buttermilk, keep the cream. 2. After idle talk, take the essence for your own practice — the wise ones spoke thus, taking the essence.

children.text: अस सारगही। बेद मंत्र दमड़ीके कारण जिन बेचोकरि दही दही ३ रेचित
children.translated_text: Do not sell the <s>Veda mantras</s> for a penny, churning them into whey. 3. Stir your mind, deliberate —

children.text: चेत न करै विचार । मतपर बिचारसार नहिं सोचोपरउपकार ४ सो नव
children.translated_text: if there is no thoughtful essence in the doctrine, think of the welfare of others. 4. The new learning — churning the curd of knowledge, discarding the water —

children.text: नीति विद्या दधि मथि तजि वारि बिकार मति मदिरा अति पान किये ते
children.translated_text: those who drink the wine of corrupt intellect excessively become mad fools. 5.

children.text: होत सुमत मतवार ५ सत विद्या सागर सम शीतल करनीकरै सम्हार ।
children.translated_text: True knowledge is cool like the ocean; one should practice restraint.

children.text: सहृद निकट हृदयस्थ त्यागिकत बाहर करत पुकार ६ ऐसोई जो बात न
children.translated_text: Abandoning what is close to the heart and established within, why do they cry out externally? 6. That which

children.text: कहीजाय वाकोकहतहैं अरुन देखोजाय ताको देखतुहैं तातें प्रथमपुराणन
children.translated_text: cannot be spoken of, they speak of; and that which cannot be seen, they see — therefore, first from the <s>Purāṇas</s>

children.translated_text: Some examples and principles from the <s>śāstras</s>, and secondly, in the present time, <s>Rāma</s>

children.text: गुलाम जू पंडितरहे सर्बशास्त्र अरु पुराण याही रामायणके दृष्टांतहेतु श्रम
children.translated_text: <s>Gulām Jū</s> was a <s>paṇḍita</s> [versed in] all <s>śāstras</s> and <s>Purāṇas</s>; for the sake of examples from this very <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s> he labored

children.text: कियोरह्यो सो सर्व अर्थ बिस्तरभयतें न लिखोजायहै परन्तुअर्थ जो शब्दवत्
children.translated_text: greatly — all that meaning, for fear of prolixity, cannot be written down; but the meaning that accords with the words,

children.text: अरु यावत्का व्यंग लक्षणा विंजनापूर्वक सहज निकरै सोर्ह सद अर्थ है
children.translated_text: and the innuendo (<s>vyaṅga</s>) of what is intended, through indication (<s>lakṣaṇā</s>) and suggestion (<s>vyañjanā</s>), what flows naturally — that is the true meaning.

children.text: याहेतुतें कछु काव्यंगहू अरु तृतीय सर्वश्रेय भक्ति जो नाममूल है श्रीरा-
children.translated_text: For this reason, some aspects of poetics (<s>kāvyāṅga</s>) as well; and thirdly, the supreme good which is <s>bhakti</s> (devotion), rooted in the Name — following the path of the <s>Tilaka</s> commentary on the <s>Śrī Rāmāyaṇa</s>,

children.text: मायणके तिलकको सरनी प्रसंगरीति करकै अरु याहीमें श्लोकनके अर्थ
children.translated_text: in the manner of contextual interpretation; and within this, the meanings of the verses

children.translated_text: and the elucidation of the Name, the <s>Mānasa</s> and so on — wherever they are obscure, there the clear
