children.translated_text: meaning is given within the context; and fourthly, many people raise doubts here and there,

children.text: ताते कछु मुख्य मुख्य शंकाको समाधान हूं अरु पञ्चम यावत् यामें
children.translated_text: therefore the resolution of some principal doubts is also [given]; and fifthly, wherever

children.text: विषम विषम शब्दहैं ताको अर्थ मुख्य एककोश करिकै ये पांचों अंगयुक्त
children.translated_text: there are difficult words, giving the meaning mainly through a single lexicon — with these five components,

children.text: श्रीरामायणको तिलक लिख्यो ।। इतिश्रीमानसदीपिकायांउपोद्घातव
children.translated_text: the <s>Tilaka</s> commentary on the <s>Śrī Rāmāyaṇa</s> has been written. Thus ends the first section (<s>prakāśa</s>) in the description of the introduction of the <s>Śrī Mānasa Dīpikā</s>.

children.text: र्णनेप्रथमःप्रकाशः ।। श्रीगोसांईजी कह्यो है नानापुराण निगमागम इ-
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Gosāīṃ Jī</s> has said: 'Various <s>Purāṇas</s>, <s>Nigamas</s>, <s>Āgamas</s>' and so on — therefore some elements of the <s>Purāṇas</s> and the rest are written.

children.text: त्यादि तातें कछु पुराणादि अंग लिखतहैं। अथ प्रथम अंगदशलक्षण पुरा-
children.translated_text: Now, the first component: the ten characteristics of <s>Purāṇas</s> — as stated in the <s>Bhāgavata</s>:

children.text: णनके भागवतमें कह्यो है सर्ग १ विसर्ग २ स्थान ३ पोषण ४ अति ५
children.translated_text: <s>Sarga</s> (creation) 1, <s>Visarga</s> (secondary creation) 2, <s>Sthāna</s> (position) 3, <s>Poṣaṇa</s> (sustenance) 4, <s>Ūti</s> (impetus) 5,

children.text: मन्वंतर ६ ईशान कथा ७ निरोध ८ मुक्ति ९ आश्रय १० प्रथम सर्ग
children.translated_text: <s>Manvantara</s> (epochs of <s>Manus</s>) 6, <s>Īśānakathā</s> (narratives of the Lord) 7, <s>Nirodha</s> (dissolution) 8, <s>Mukti</s> (liberation) 9, <s>Āśraya</s> (ultimate refuge) 10.

children.text: लक्षण महाभूत आकाशादि तन्मात्रा पंचशब्दादि इन्द्री दशमहत्तत्त्व
children.translated_text: First, the characteristic of <s>Sarga</s>: the great elements (<s>mahābhūta</s>) beginning with space (<s>ākāśa</s>), the subtle elements (<s>tanmātra</s>), the five [qualities] beginning with sound (<s>śabda</s>), the ten senses,

children.text: अहंकार ये सबको ब्रह्मसे गुण वैषम्य करिकै जो परिनाम वातें विराट्
children.translated_text: the <s>Mahat-tattva</s> (the Great Principle), <s>Ahaṃkāra</s> (ego) — all of these, through the differentiation of qualities (<s>guṇa-vaiṣamya</s>) from <s>Brahman</s>, through transformation (<s>pariṇāma</s>), the <s>Virāṭ</s>

children.text: स्वरूप अरु स्वरूपकरिकै जो जन्मवाको नामसर्ग१ विराट्से जो भयो चरा
children.translated_text: form and essential form — the birth that results [from this] is called <s>Sarga</s> 1; the birth of the moving and non-moving [beings] from <s>Virāṭ</s>

children.text: चरको जन्मसो विसर्ग २ भगवानके विजयपूर्वक सृष्टिको मर्यादा पालन
children.translated_text: is <s>Visarga</s> 2; the Lord's maintaining the order of creation with victory

children.text: करनेसे जो उत्कर्षसो स्थान ३ अपने भक्तके ऊपर अनुग्रह सो पोषण ४
children.translated_text: — that eminence is <s>Sthāna</s> 3; the grace upon his own devotees is <s>Poṣaṇa</s> 4;

children.text: कर्मनकी बासना अरु वर्णाश्रमकृपा सोऊति ५ अपने कालपर्यंत एकएक
children.translated_text: the impressions (<s>vāsanā</s>) of <s>karmas</s> and the grace upon the <s>varṇāśrama</s> [system] is <s>Ūti</s> 5; each <s>Manu</s> maintaining the

children.text: मनुसतधमको पालनकरतहैं सो मन्वंतर ६ ईश भगवानको जो अनुचरित
children.translated_text: <s>dharma</s> of his own era is <s>Manvantara</s> 6; the pastimes of <s>Īśa</s> (the Lord)

children.text: सोर्ह ईशानकथा अथवा ईश जो सूर्यचंद्र वंशके राजा उनकी जो कथा
children.translated_text: — that is <s>Īśānakathā</s>; or <s>Īśa</s> meaning the kings of the Solar and Lunar dynasties — their narratives

children.text: सोई ईशान कथा कहिये ७ दुष्टन को मारनो वाहिरकी योग निद्रा के
children.translated_text: are called <s>Īśānakathā</s> 7; the slaying of the wicked — externally, the dissolution of the living being along with the power of <s>Yoganidrā</s> (the sleep of cosmic illusion)

children.text: शक्ति सहित जीवनका लय सो निरोध ८ आरोपित कतृत्वादि त्यागि कै
children.translated_text: is <s>Nirodha</s> 8; abandoning the superimposed agency and the rest,

children.text: शुद्ध ब्रह्म स्वरूपजो स्थिति सो मुक्ति ९ जगतकी उत्पति अरु विनाशजा
children.translated_text: the establishment in the nature of pure <s>Brahman</s> is <s>Mukti</s> 9; that from which the creation and destruction of the world

children.text: तें ज्ञातहोतहैं सो आत्मापरव्रह्म सबही को आश्रय १० अरु अपर पुराण
children.translated_text: are known — that Supreme <s>Brahman</s>, the <s>Ātman</s>, is the <s>Āśraya</s> (refuge) of all 10; and the

children.text: के जो पंचलक्षण कहे हैं सो याही दश लक्षणके अंतरगत हैं अरु ये दश
children.translated_text: five characteristics stated in the lesser <s>Purāṇas</s> are included within these ten characteristics; and these ten

children.text: पांचौं के अन्तर्गत हैं सो पांचौं सर्ग १ विसर्ग २ वंश ३ मन्वंतर ४ वंशानु
children.translated_text: are included within [those] five — namely: <s>Sarga</s> 1, <s>Visarga</s> 2, <s>Vaṃśa</s> (lineage) 3, <s>Manvantara</s> 4, <s>Vaṃśānucarita</s> (dynastic history) 5.

children.text: चरित ५ इतिपुराण ।। अथशास्त्र । षट् शास्त्रजो हैं वेद जनिबे को अंग
children.translated_text: Thus [ends the discussion of] <s>Purāṇa</s>. Now, <s>Śāstra</s>: There are six <s>śāstras</s> which are the limbs for understanding the <s>Vedas</s>;

children.text: ताको सिद्धांत बात कछू कछू पृथक् पृथक् लिखत हैं प्रथमतो मीमांसा
children.translated_text: their doctrines are written separately, one by one. First, the <s>Mīmāṃsā</s>

children.text: शास्त्र याको आचार्य जैमिविमुनियामें यज्ञादि धर्म्म विषय है अरु धर्म्म
children.translated_text: <s>Śāstra</s>: its teacher (<s>ācārya</s>) is the sage <s>Jaimini</s>; its subject matter is <s>dharma</s> concerning sacrifice (<s>yajña</s>) and the like; and

children.text: ज्ञानही प्रयोजन है फल उद्देशकरि वेद प्रतिपाद्य जो अर्थ सो धर्म कहिये
children.translated_text: the knowledge of <s>dharma</s> alone is its purpose. The object (<s>artha</s>) taught by the <s>Veda</s> for the purpose of obtaining results (<s>phala</s>) is called <s>dharma</s>;

children.text: स्वर्गरूप फलके हेतु यज्ञ करिके अपूर्वको भावना करनो अरु भावनामें
children.translated_text: performing sacrifice for the sake of the result in the form of heaven (<s>svarga</s>) — the contemplation (<s>bhāvanā</s>) of the unprecedented (<s>apūrva</s>) — and in this contemplation,

children.text: तीन अंशकी अपेक्षा है कारण १ कार्य २ इति कर्तव्यता ३ कौनकार
children.translated_text: three aspects are required: cause (<s>kāraṇa</s>) 1, effect (<s>kārya</s>) 2, and the obligation to act (<s>itikartavyatā</s>) 3. What means

children.text: करनो या कारण अंशकीअपेक्षा है क्या करनो या कार्य अंशकी अपेक्षा है
children.translated_text: to use for performing [the sacrifice] — that is the requirement of the cause aspect; what to do — that is the requirement of the effect aspect;

children.text: कौन प्रकारतें करनो या इति कर्तव्यता अंशकी अपेक्षाहै अरु भावना द्वै
children.translated_text: in what manner to do it — that is the requirement of the obligation aspect. And there are two kinds of contemplation (<s>bhāvanā</s>):

children.text: हैं एक आर्थी दूसरी शाब्दी अरु अपौरुषेय जो बाक्य सो वेदमेंवेद पांच
children.translated_text: one <s>ārthī</s> (meaning-based), the other <s>śābdī</s> (word-based). And an impersonal (<s>apauruṣeya</s>) sentence — that is in the <s>Veda</s>; the <s>Veda</s> is of five

children.text: प्रकारका है विधि १ मन्त्र२ नामधेय ३ अर्थवाद ४ निषेध ५ भेदते सम्पूर्ण
children.translated_text: kinds: <s>Vidhi</s> (injunction) 1, <s>Mantra</s> 2, <s>Nāmadheya</s> (nomenclature) 3, <s>Arthavāda</s> (explanatory passage) 4, <s>Niṣedha</s> (prohibition) 5. Through these distinctions, the entire

children.text: वेद जोहैंसोकोऊसाक्षाततें कोऊपरंपरतेंधर्मप्रतिपादकहैं विधिचारप्रकार
children.translated_text: <s>Veda</s> — some directly, some through tradition — teaches <s>dharma</s>. <s>Vidhi</s> (injunction) is of four kinds:

children.text: की है उत्पति १ विनियोग २ अधिकार ३ प्रयोग ४ भेदतें अग्निहोत्रकर-
children.translated_text: <s>Utpatti</s> (origination) 1, <s>Viniyoga</s> (application) 2, <s>Adhikāra</s> (qualification) 3, <s>Prayoga</s> (procedure) 4. 'Perform the <s>Agnihotra</s>'

children.text: नो उत्पति १ अंगकी वोधक जो विधिसो विनियोग दधि करकै होम
children.translated_text: — that is <s>Utpatti</s> 1. The injunction that informs about the subsidiary (<s>aṅga</s>) is <s>Viniyoga</s>: 'Offer oblation with curd' —

children.text: करनोइहां विनियोगै अंग दो हैं एक सिद्ध दूसरो साध्यदधि आदि सिद्धि
children.translated_text: here in the <s>Viniyoga</s>, there are two subsidiaries: one established (<s>siddha</s>), the other to be accomplished (<s>sādhya</s>). Curd and the like are established;

children.text: प्रयाजादि साध्य २ कर्म जन्य फलवोधक जो विधि सो अधिकार ३
children.translated_text: <s>Prayājas</s> and the like are to be accomplished 2. The injunction that informs about the fruit produced by action is <s>Adhikāra</s> 3:

children.text: स्वर्ग फलके हेतु यज्ञ करनो यहां अंग को क्रमवोधक जो विधि सो प्रयो-
children.translated_text: 'Perform sacrifice for the sake of heavenly fruit' — here the injunction that informs about the sequence of subsidiaries is <s>Prayoga</s>

children.text: ग ४ वेद संपादन करकै वेदी करतहैं याके सहकारी भूतछः प्रमाण हैं
children.translated_text: 4. Having completed the <s>Veda</s> [study], they construct the altar (<s>vedī</s>). The six auxiliary means of valid knowledge (<s>pramāṇa</s>) for this are:

children.text: श्रुति १ लिंग२ बाक्य३ प्रकरण४ स्थान५ समाख्या६ भेदतें निरपेक्ष जो
children.translated_text: <s>Śruti</s> (direct statement) 1, <s>Liṅga</s> (indicatory sign) 2, <s>Vākya</s> (syntactical connection) 3, <s>Prakaraṇa</s> (context) 4, <s>Sthāna</s> (position) 5, <s>Samākhyā</s> (designation) 6.

children.text: शब्द सो श्रुति है १ सामते जो अर्थका वोधक होयसो लिंग २ एक अर्थ
children.translated_text: A word that is independent [in its meaning] is <s>Śruti</s> 1. What indicates meaning through a general [secondary sign] is <s>Liṅga</s> 2. What conveys a single meaning

children.text: को बोधक होय बिभाग ते परस्पर आकांक्षा होय सो वाक्य ३ जहां दोऊ
children.translated_text: through its parts and has mutual expectancy (<s>ākāṅkṣā</s>) is <s>Vākya</s> 3. Where both

children.text: को आंकाक्षाहै सो प्रकरण४ जहां दोऊमें एकको आकांक्षा होयसो स्थान
children.translated_text: have mutual expectancy, that is <s>Prakaraṇa</s> 4. Where one of the two has expectancy, that is <s>Sthāna</s>

children.text: ५ समाख्या कही संकेत६ पुनः बिधि तीन प्रकारकीहै अपूर्व १ नियम २
children.translated_text: 5. <s>Samākhyā</s> is called convention (<s>saṅketa</s>) 6. Furthermore, <s>Vidhi</s> is of three kinds: <s>Apūrva</s> (unprecedented) 1, <s>Niyama</s> (restriction) 2,

children.text: परिसंख्या ३ भेद ।। अत्यंत अप्राप्त अर्थ की जो विधि सो अपूर्व १ अग्नि
children.translated_text: <s>Parisaṅkhyā</s> (enumeration/exclusion) 3. The injunction for a wholly unattained meaning is <s>Apūrva</s> 1: 'Perform the

children.text: होत्र करनो इहां पक्षमों प्राप्त जो विधि नियम२ दधिकरिकै होमकरनो
children.translated_text: <s>Agnihotra</s>' — here the injunction that restricts what is obtained through option is <s>Niyama</s> 2: 'Offer oblation with curd' —

children.text: इहां स्वभावतें प्राप्तसंता पुन जोविधान सो परिसंख्या ३ पंच पंच
children.translated_text: here, when something is already naturally available, the further specification is <s>Parisaṅkhyā</s> 3: 'Five-nailed [animals]

children.text: नखा भक्षइति । प्रशंसा वाक्य जो है सो अर्थ वादहै १ सो तीन भांति गुण
children.translated_text: may be eaten.' The laudatory sentences are <s>Arthavāda</s> 1; they are of three kinds: <s>Guṇavāda</s> (praise)

children.text: बाद ९ अनुबाद २ सूतार्थ बाद ३ भेदतें ।। प्रत्यक्षादि प्रमाणतें विरुद्ध
children.translated_text: 1, <s>Anuvāda</s> (restatement) 2, <s>Bhūtārthavāda</s> (factual eulogy) 3.

children.text: सगुण बाद १ सूर्यख भाहै सो प्रत्यक्षादि प्रमाण तें ज्ञान जो अर्थ वाको
children.translated_text: What contradicts the means of valid knowledge (<s>pramāṇa</s>) such as perception and the like is <s>Guṇavāda</s> 1: 'The sun is a bone' — what informs about a meaning

children.text: बोधक जो सो अनुबाद २ वेतकी जल ते उत्पत्ति भूतका लिक अर्थ
children.translated_text: already known through perception and other <s>pramāṇas</s> is <s>Anuvāda</s> 2: 'Reeds are born from water' — what presents a factual meaning

children.text: को प्रतिपादक जो सो भूतार्थवाद ३ इन्द्रदेवतन में श्रेष्ठतर है इति
children.translated_text: is <s>Bhūtārthavāda</s> 3: '<s>Indra</s> is the most excellent among the gods.'

children.text: ***यज्ञकर्ता को जो संकेतताद्विशिष्ठसो मन्त्र ४ यज्ञनको जो नाम सो
children.translated_text: The conventional designation specific to the performer of sacrifice is <s>Mantra</s> 4; the names of the sacrifices

children.text: नामधेय ५ इच्छातें अनिष्टमों प्रवृत्त पुरुषको निवृत्त करनो सो निषेध ५
children.translated_text: are <s>Nāmadheya</s> 5; preventing a person inclined through desire toward the undesirable is <s>Niṣedha</s> (prohibition) 5:

children.text: कलंजको नखानो और उदय होते सूर्य को न देखनो इहां या रीतिमी
children.translated_text: 'Do not eat <s>kalañja</s>' and 'Do not look at the rising sun.' In this manner,

children.text: मासा परिशोधित तर्कते वेदके पांचौ प्रकारको जानिकेयथोक्त कर्मके अनु
children.translated_text: through <s>Mīmāṃsā</s> purified by logic (<s>tarka</s>), knowing all five kinds of the <s>Veda</s> and performing the prescribed rites (<s>karma</s>),

children.text: ष्टान करके पुरुषको परमपुरुषार्थको लाभ होतहै १ अथद्वितीय वैशेषिक
children.translated_text: a person attains the supreme goal of life (<s>puruṣārtha</s>) 1. Now the second: the <s>Vaiśeṣika</s>

children.text: शास्त्र याको आचार्य कणादमुनि यामें पदार्थ विषयहै औ पदार्थ तत्वज्ञान
children.translated_text: <s>Śāstra</s>; its teacher is the sage <s>Kaṇāda</s>; its subject matter is the categories (<s>padārtha</s>); and the true knowledge of the categories

children.text: प्रयोजनहै पदार्थ दोय एकभाव दूसरो अभाव भावछः हैं द्रव्य १ गुण २
children.translated_text: is its purpose. Categories are two: one <s>bhāva</s> (existence), the other <s>abhāva</s> (non-existence). <s>Bhāva</s> comprises six: <s>Dravya</s> (substance) 1, <s>Guṇa</s> (quality) 2,

children.text: कर्म ३ सामान्य ४ विशेष ५ समबाय ६ येछः पदार्थके सामानधर्मअरु
children.translated_text: <s>Karma</s> (action) 3, <s>Sāmānya</s> (universality) 4, <s>Viśeṣa</s> (particularity) 5, <s>Samavāya</s> (inherence) 6. By knowing the common properties and

children.text: बिरुद्ध धर्म जानिबेते अनेक पदार्थोंके अनेक धर्मको ज्ञान होतर्हे अनेक
children.translated_text: contrary properties of these six categories, knowledge of the many properties of many categories arises;

children.text: धर्मोंमें एक निवृति धर्म है निवृति धर्मते उत्पन्न जो आत्मा साज्ञातकार
children.translated_text: among the many properties, one is the property of cessation (<s>nivṛtti</s>); from the cessation property arises the <s>ātman</s>'s true knowledge,

children.text: ताते मोक्ष होतहै अभावचारहैं प्रागभाव १ प्रध्वंसा भाव २ अत्यन्ताभाव
children.translated_text: from which <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation) results. <s>Abhāva</s> (non-existence) is of four kinds: <s>Prāgabhāva</s> (prior non-existence) 1, <s>Pradhvaṃsābhāva</s> (destructive non-existence) 2, <s>Atyantābhāva</s> (absolute non-existence)

children.text: ३ अन्योन्याभाव ४ अरु द्रव्यत्व १ गुणत्व २ कर्मत्व ३ ईतीन जातिरूप
children.translated_text: 3, <s>Anyonyābhāva</s> (mutual non-existence) 4. And <s>Dravyatva</s> (substancehood) 1, <s>Guṇatva</s> (qualityhood) 2, <s>Karmatva</s> (actionhood) 3 — these three are properties in the form of universals (<s>jāti</s>);

children.text: धर्महैं सामान्यत्व १ विशेषत्व २ समवायत्व३ अभावत्व ४ ईचार उपाधि
children.translated_text: <s>Sāmānyatva</s> 1, <s>Viśeṣatva</s> 2, <s>Samavāyatva</s> 3, <s>Abhāvatva</s> 4 — these four are properties in the form of imposed designations (<s>upādhi</s>).

children.text: रूप धर्महैं पृथिवी १ जल २ तेज ३ व यु ४ आकाश ४ काल ६ दिशा७
children.translated_text: Earth (<s>Pṛthivī</s>) 1, Water (<s>Jala</s>) 2, Fire (<s>Tejas</s>) 3, Air (<s>Vāyu</s>) 4, Space (<s>Ākāśa</s>) 5, Time (<s>Kāla</s>) 6, Direction (<s>Diśā</s>) 7,

children.text: आत्मा ८ मन ९ ईनव द्रव्य हैं अरु पृथिवीत्व १ जलत्व २ तेजत्व ३
children.translated_text: Self (<s>Ātman</s>) 8, Mind (<s>Manas</s>) 9 — these are nine substances. And <s>Pṛthivītva</s> (earthness) 1, <s>Jalatva</s> (waterness) 2, <s>Tejastva</s> (fireness) 3,

children.text: वायत्तवा ४ आत्मत्व ४ मनस्त्व ६ ईछःजाति रूप धर्म हैं शाकाशत्व १
children.translated_text: <s>Vāyutva</s> (airness) 4, <s>Ātmatva</s> (selfness) 5, <s>Manastva</s> (mindness) 6 — these six are properties in the form of universals; <s>Ākāśatva</s> (spaceness) 1,

children.text: कालत्व ८ दिशात्व ३ ईतीन उपाधिरूप धर्म हैं रूप १ रस २ गन्ध ३
children.translated_text: <s>Kālatva</s> (timeness) 2, <s>Diśātva</s> (directionness) 3 — these three are properties in the form of imposed designations. Color (<s>Rūpa</s>) 1, Taste (<s>Rasa</s>) 2, Smell (<s>Gandha</s>) 3,

children.text: स्पर्श ४ संख्या ५ परिमान ६ पृथक्त्व ७ संयोग ८ विभाग ९ परत्व १०
children.translated_text: Touch (<s>Sparśa</s>) 4, Number (<s>Saṅkhyā</s>) 5, Measure (<s>Parimāṇa</s>) 6, Separateness (<s>Pṛthaktva</s>) 7, Conjunction (<s>Saṃyoga</s>) 8, Disjunction (<s>Vibhāga</s>) 9, Remoteness (<s>Paratva</s>) 10,

children.text: अपर्त्व ११ गुरुत्व १२ द्रव्यत्व १३ स्नेह १४ शब्द १५ बुद्धि १६ सुख
children.translated_text: Nearness (<s>Aparatva</s>) 11, Heaviness (<s>Gurutva</s>) 12, Fluidity (<s>Dravatva</s>) 13, Viscidity (<s>Sneha</s>) 14, Sound (<s>Śabda</s>) 15, Cognition (<s>Buddhi</s>) 16, Pleasure (<s>Sukha</s>)

children.text: १७ दुख १८ इच्छा १९ द्वेष २० प्रयत्न २१ धर्म २२ अधर्म २३ सं-
children.translated_text: 17, Pain (<s>Duḥkha</s>) 18, Desire (<s>Icchā</s>) 19, Aversion (<s>Dveṣa</s>) 20, Effort (<s>Prayatna</s>) 21, Merit (<s>Dharma</s>) 22, Demerit (<s>Adharma</s>) 23,

children.text: स्कार २४ ईचौबीस गुणहैं और रूपत्वादिक चौबीसौं जातिरूप धर्म्म हैं
children.translated_text: Disposition (<s>Saṃskāra</s>) 24 — these are the twenty-four qualities; and <s>Rūpatva</s> (colorness) and the rest — all twenty-four are properties in the form of universals.

children.text: पृथिवीमें रूप १ रस २ गन्ध ३ स्पर्श ४ संख्या ४ परिमाण ६ पृथक्त्व ७
children.translated_text: In earth: Color 1, Taste 2, Smell 3, Touch 4, Number 5, Measure 6, Separateness 7,

children.text: संयोग ८ विभाग ९ परत्व १० अपरत्व ११ पुरुत्व १२ द्रवत्व १२ संस्कार
children.translated_text: Conjunction 8, Disjunction 9, Remoteness 10, Nearness 11, Heaviness 12, Fluidity 13, Disposition

children.text: १४ ईचौदह गुणहैं जलमे रूप १ रस २ स्नेह ३ स्पर्श ४ संख्या ५ परि-
children.translated_text: 14 — these are fourteen qualities. In water: Color 1, Taste 2, Viscidity 3, Touch 4, Number 5, Measure

children.text: माण ६ पृथक्त्व ७ संयोग ८ विभाग ९ परत्व १० अपरत्वा ११ गुरुत्व १२
children.translated_text: 6, Separateness 7, Conjunction 8, Disjunction 9, Remoteness 10, Nearness 11, Heaviness 12,

children.text: द्रवत्व १३ संस्कार १४ ईचौदह गुण हैं तेजमें रूप १ स्पर्श २ संख्या ३
children.translated_text: Fluidity 13, Disposition 14 — these are fourteen qualities. In fire: Color 1, Touch 2, Number 3,

children.text: परिमाण ४ पृथक्त्व ५ संयोग ६ विभाग ७ परत्व ८ अपरत्व ९ द्रवत्व १०
children.translated_text: Measure 4, Separateness 5, Conjunction 6, Disjunction 7, Remoteness 8, Nearness 9, Fluidity 10,

children.text: संस्कार ११ ईग्यारह गुण हैं वायुमें स्पर्श१संख्या २ परिमाण ३ पृथक्त्व
children.translated_text: Disposition 11 — these are eleven qualities. In air: Touch 1, Number 2, Measure 3, Separateness

children.text: ४ संयोग ४ विभाग ६ परत्व ७ अपरत्व ८ संस्कार ९ ईनवगुण हैं आ-
children.translated_text: 4, Conjunction 5, Disjunction 6, Remoteness 7, Nearness 8, Disposition 9 — these are nine qualities.

children.text: काशमें शब्द १ संख्या २ परिमाण ३ पृथक्त ४ संयोग ५ विभाग ६ ईछः
children.translated_text: In space: Sound 1, Number 2, Measure 3, Separateness 4, Conjunction 5, Disjunction 6 — these are six

children.text: गुणहैं कालमें अरु दिशामें संख्या १ परिमाण २ पृथक्त्व ३ संयोग ४
children.translated_text: qualities. In time and direction: Number 1, Measure 2, Separateness 3, Conjunction 4,

children.text: विभाग ५ ईपांच गुणहैं जीवात्वामें संख्या१ परिमाण२पृथक्तवैं३ संयोग
children.translated_text: Disjunction 5 — these are five qualities. In the individual self (<s>jīvātman</s>): Number 1, Measure 2, Separateness 3, Conjunction

children.text: ४ विभाग ४ बुद्धि ६ सुख ७ दुःख ८ इच्छा ९ द्वेष १० प्रयत्न ११ धर्म्म
children.translated_text: 4, Disjunction 5, Cognition 6, Pleasure 7, Pain 8, Desire 9, Aversion 10, Effort 11, Merit

children.text: १२ अधर्म १३ संस्कार १४ ईचौदह गुणहे मनमे संख्या १ परिमाण २
children.translated_text: 12, Demerit 13, Disposition 14 — these are fourteen qualities. In mind: Number 1, Measure 2,

children.text: पृथक्त्व ३ संयोग ४विभाग ४ परत्व ६ अपरत्व ७ संस्कार ८ ई आठगुण
children.translated_text: Separateness 3, Conjunction 4, Disjunction 5, Remoteness 6, Nearness 7, Disposition 8 — these are eight qualities.

children.text: हैं ईश्वरमें ज्ञान १ इच्छा २ प्रयत्न ३ संख्या ४ परिमाण ५ पृथक्त्व ६
children.translated_text: In <s>Īśvara</s> (God): Knowledge 1, Desire 2, Effort 3, Number 4, Measure 5, Separateness 6,

children.text: संयोग ७ विभाग ८ ई आठगुणहैं पृथ्वी १ जल २ वायु ३ तेज ४ ई चारौं
children.translated_text: Conjunction 7, Disjunction 8 — these are eight qualities. Earth 1, Water 2, Air 3, Fire 4 — these four

children.text: द्वैप्रकारके हैं एक परिमाण रूप दूसरो सावयव घ्राणकादि रूप अरु आ-
children.translated_text: are of two kinds: one in the form of atomic measure, the other in the form of composite [bodies] such as the objects of smell and so on. And

children.text: काश १ काल २ दिशा ३ आत्मा ४ ई चारौं व्यापक रूप हैं मन अणुरूप
children.translated_text: Space 1, Time 2, Direction 3, Self 4 — these four are of all-pervading form. Mind is atomic in form,

children.text: सावयव अनित्य है बाकी सब नित्य हैं सावयवके तीनभेद हैं शरीर १
children.translated_text: composite and non-eternal. The rest are all eternal. Composites have three divisions: Body 1,

children.text: इन्द्रिय २ विषय ३ मृत्युलोकमों मिट्टीको शररिहै वरुणलोकमों जलको
children.translated_text: Sense-organ 2, Sense-object 3. In the mortal world, the body is of earth; in the world of <s>Varuṇa</s>, of water;

children.text: सूर्यलोकमो तेजको वायुलोकमों वायुको अरु प्राणइंद्री पृथिवीको रसना
children.translated_text: in the world of <s>Sūrya</s>, of fire; in the world of <s>Vāyu</s>, of air. And the sense of smell (<s>prāṇendriya</s>) belongs to earth; the sense of taste (<s>rasanā</s>)

children.text: इन्द्रिय जलको चक्षु इन्द्रिय तेजको कर्ण इन्द्रिय आकाशको पृथ्वीमों
children.translated_text: belongs to water; the sense of sight (<s>cakṣu</s>) to fire; the sense of hearing (<s>karṇa</s>) to space. In earth,

children.text: सातोंरूप रहतहैं जलमों स्वच्छरूप तेजमों प्रकाशरूप अरु पृथ्वीमें छर्वों
children.translated_text: all seven kinds of color exist; in water, the transparent form; in fire, the luminous form. And in earth, all six

children.text: रस रहतहैं जलमों मधरस रहत है अरु पृथ्वीमों दूनों गन्ध रहतुहैं कर्म्म
children.translated_text: tastes exist; in water, the sweet taste exists. And in earth, both kinds of smell exist. Actions (<s>karma</s>)

children.text: पांचहैं ऊर्ध्व क्रिया १ अधोक्रिया २ संकोच ३ विस्तार४ गमन ५ ईयवांवों
children.translated_text: are five: upward motion 1, downward motion 2, contraction 3, expansion 4, locomotion 5 — these

children.text: कर्म द्रव्यमों रहतहैं अरु सामान्यकहै जाति जातितनिहैं व्याप्य १ व्या-
children.translated_text: actions reside in substance. And <s>Sāmānya</s> (universality) means <s>jāti</s> (genus); <s>jāti</s> is of three kinds: pervaded (<s>vyāpya</s>) 1, pervading (<s>vyāpaka</s>)

children.text: पक २ व्याप्य व्यापक ३ सत्ता जाति व्यापकहै द्रव्य गुण कर्म तीनोंमों
children.translated_text: 2, and pervaded-pervading (<s>vyāpya-vyāpaka</s>) 3. <s>Sattā-jāti</s> (the genus 'existence') is the pervading [universal]; it resides in substance, quality, and action — all three.

children.text: रहत हैं घटत्व जाति व्याप्यहै द्रव्यत्व जाति व्याप्य व्यापक है नित्यहोय
children.translated_text: <s>Ghaṭatva-jāti</s> (potness) is a pervaded [universal]. <s>Dravyatva-jāti</s> (substancehood) is pervaded-pervading. What is eternal,

children.text: एकहोय अरु अनेकमों रहै सो जाति अरु नित्य द्रव्यमोंरहै नित्य द्रव्य
children.translated_text: singular, and resides in many — that is <s>jāti</s>. And what resides in eternal substances — the mutual difference among eternal substances

children.text: मों परस्पर भेदहै जाति सो विशेषहै समवाय कहिये नित्य सम्बन्ध अरु
children.translated_text: as a genus — that is <s>Viśeṣa</s> (particularity). <s>Samavāya</s> (inherence) is called the eternal relation. And

children.text: कार्यके पूर्व जो अभाव प्रागभाव १ आर्यको जो नाश सो प्रध्वंसाभाव २
children.translated_text: the non-existence prior to the production of an effect is <s>Prāgabhāva</s> 1; the destruction of an effect is <s>Pradhvaṃsābhāva</s> 2;

children.text: तीनोंकालमों जो अभाव सो अत्यंताभाव३परस्पर जो अभाव सो अन्यो-
children.translated_text: the non-existence in all three times is <s>Atyantābhāva</s> 3; the mutual non-existence is <s>Anyonyābhāva</s>

children.text: न्याभाव ४ अरु प्रमाण द्वै हैं प्रत्यक्ष१ अनुमान२ अरु शब्द औ उपमान
children.translated_text: 4. And the means of valid knowledge (<s>pramāṇa</s>) are two: Perception (<s>Pratyakṣa</s>) 1, Inference (<s>Anumāna</s>) 2; and Verbal testimony (<s>Śabda</s>) and Analogy (<s>Upamāna</s>)

children.text: ईदोऊ अनुमानमों गतार्थ हैं । इतितृतीयन्यायतर्कशास्त्र । याके आचार्य
children.translated_text: — these two are subsumed under Inference. Thus [ends] the third: <s>Nyāya-Tarka Śāstra</s> (the science of logic and reasoning). Its teacher

children.text: मुनि गौतम यामें सोरह पदार्थ विषय हैं सोरह पदार्थ का ज्ञान प्रयोजन
children.translated_text: is the sage <s>Gautama</s>; its subject matter comprises sixteen categories; the knowledge of these sixteen categories

children.text: है वेप्रमाण १ प्रमेय २ संशय ३ प्रयोजन ४ दृष्टांत ५ सिद्धांत ६ अवयव
children.translated_text: is its purpose. They are: <s>Pramāṇa</s> (means of valid knowledge) 1, <s>Prameya</s> (object of knowledge) 2, <s>Saṃśaya</s> (doubt) 3, <s>Prayojana</s> (purpose) 4, <s>Dṛṣṭānta</s> (example) 5, <s>Siddhānta</s> (established conclusion) 6, <s>Avayava</s> (members of a syllogism)

children.text: ७ तर्क ८ निर्णय ९ वाद १०जल्प ११ वितंडा १२ हैत्वाभास १३ छल
children.translated_text: 7, <s>Tarka</s> (hypothetical reasoning) 8, <s>Nirṇaya</s> (ascertainment) 9, <s>Vāda</s> (discussion) 10, <s>Jalpa</s> (wrangling) 11, <s>Vitaṇḍā</s> (cavil) 12, <s>Hetvābhāsa</s> (fallacious reasons) 13, <s>Chala</s> (quibble)

children.text: १४ जाति १५ निग्रहस्थान १६ ये सोरह पदार्थ हैं याके तत्त्व ज्ञानमें
children.translated_text: 14, <s>Jāti</s> (futile objection) 15, <s>Nigrahasthāna</s> (point of defeat) 16 — these are the sixteen categories. Through the true knowledge of these,

children.text: मोक्ष होतुहै मिथ्या ज्ञानके नाशतें दोषको नाश दोषके नाशतें प्रवृत्तिको
children.translated_text: <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation) results. Through the destruction of false knowledge, defects (<s>doṣa</s>) are destroyed; through the destruction of defects, activity (<s>pravṛtti</s>) [ceases];

children.text: प्रवृत्तिके नाशतें जन्मको जग्मके नाशतें दुःखको दुःखनाशे मोक्षहै अरु
children.translated_text: through the destruction of activity, birth (<s>janma</s>) [ceases]; through the destruction of birth, suffering (<s>duḥkha</s>) [ceases]; through the destruction of suffering, <s>mokṣa</s> is attained. And

children.text: प्रत्यक्ष १ अनुमान २ उपमान३ शब्द ४ येचार प्रमाण हैं इन्द्रिय अरु
children.translated_text: Perception (<s>Pratyakṣa</s>) 1, Inference (<s>Anumāna</s>) 2, Analogy (<s>Upamāna</s>) 3, Verbal testimony (<s>Śabda</s>) 4 — these are the four <s>pramāṇas</s>. The knowledge produced

children.text: अर्थके सम्बन्धतें उत्पन्न जो ज्ञान सो प्रत्यक्षहै १ जाकेंप्रत्यक्ष ज्ञानके
children.translated_text: from the contact of a sense-organ and its object is Perception 1; that after which, following perceptual knowledge,

children.text: अनन्तर अनुमिति होयसो अनुमान २ जाके सादृश्य ज्ञानके अनन्तर
children.translated_text: inferential cognition (<s>anumiti</s>) arises — that is Inference 2; that after which, following knowledge of similarity,

children.text: उपमिति होयसो उपमान ३ यथार्थ ज्ञानको जो उपदेश सो शब्द ४ ।।
children.translated_text: analogical cognition (<s>upamiti</s>) arises — that is Analogy 3; the instruction that conveys veridical knowledge — that is Verbal testimony 4.

children.text: आत्मा १ शरीर २ इन्द्रिय ३ अर्थ ४ बुद्धि ५ मन ६ प्रवृत्ति७ दोष ८
children.translated_text: Self (<s>Ātman</s>) 1, Body (<s>Śarīra</s>) 2, Sense-organs (<s>Indriya</s>) 3, Objects (<s>Artha</s>) 4, Cognition (<s>Buddhi</s>) 5, Mind (<s>Manas</s>) 6, Activity (<s>Pravṛtti</s>) 7, Defects (<s>Doṣa</s>) 8,

children.text: प्रेत्यभाव ९ फल १० दुख ११ मोक्ष १२ ये बारह प्रमेय हैं इच्छा १ प्रय-
children.translated_text: Rebirth (<s>Pretyabhāva</s>) 9, Fruit (<s>Phala</s>) 10, Suffering (<s>Duḥkha</s>) 11, Liberation (<s>Mokṣa</s>) 12 — these are the twelve objects of knowledge (<s>prameya</s>). Desire 1, Effort

children.text: त्न २ ज्ञान ३ द्वेष ४ सुख ५ दुःख ६ ये छःआत्माके लक्षण हैं चेष्टा १
children.translated_text: effort (2), knowledge (3), aversion (4), pleasure (5), pain (6) — these six are the characteristics of the <s>Ātman</s> (self). Activity (1),

children.text: इन्द्रिय २ सुख ३ दुःख ४ ये चारों जामोंरहै सो शरीर १ अरुघ्राण २ रस
children.translated_text: the senses (2), pleasure (3), pain (4) — whatever exists in these four, that is the body (1). And smell (2), taste

children.text: ना २ चक्षु ३ त्वक् ४ कर्ण ५ येपांच इन्द्रियहैं सो भूतनतें उत्पन्नहैं पृथ्वी
children.translated_text: (2), sight (3), touch (4), hearing (5) — these five are the senses; they arise from the elements. Earth

children.text: १ जल २ तेज ३ वायु ४ आकाश ५ ये पांच भूतहैं गन्ध पृथ्वीको गुण
children.translated_text: (1), water (2), fire (3), air (4), space (5) — these are the five elements. Smell is the quality of earth;

children.text: रस जलको गुण स्पर्श वायुको गुण शब्द आकाशको गुण गन्ध घ्राण को
children.translated_text: taste is the quality of water; touch is the quality of air; sound is the quality of space. Smell is

children.text: विषय रस रसनाको रूप चक्षुको स्पर्श त्वचाको शब्द कानको विषय वि-
children.translated_text: the object of the sense of smell; taste is [the object] of the tongue; form is [the object] of the eyes; touch is [the object] of the skin; sound is the object of the ears. An ob-

children.text: षय जो है सो अर्थहै ४ बुद्धि कहिये ज्ञान ५ एक कालमों ये आत्मा में
children.translated_text: ject, that which exists, is the meaning [of 'artha'] (4). <s>Buddhi</s> (intellect) is called knowledge (5). In one moment, the production

children.text: अनेक ज्ञानकी उत्पत्ति नहीं है येही हेतुते अणत्व मनको लक्षणहै ६ अरु
children.translated_text: of many cognitions does not occur in the <s>Ātman</s> (self) — this very reason is the defining characteristic of the atom-like nature of the mind (6). And

children.text: बाणी १ बुद्धि २ शरीर ३ ये तीनका जो प्रयत्न सो प्रवृत्ति ७ प्रवृत्तिहोय
children.translated_text: the effort of speech (1), intellect (2), and body (3) — these three — is <s>pravṛtti</s> (activity) (7). When activity occurs,

children.text: जाते सो दोष ८ सो दोष प्रीति द्वेष मोह रूपहै अरु मरिकै जन्म लेनो
children.translated_text: that is <s>doṣa</s> (defect) (8). That defect is in the form of attachment, aversion, and delusion. And dying and being reborn

children.text: प्रेत्यभावहै ९ प्रीति द्वेष मोहते सुख दुःखका जो साक्षात्कारसोफलहै १०
children.translated_text: is <s>pretyabhāva</s> (afterlife state) (9). The direct experience of pleasure and pain [resulting] from attachment, aversion, and delusion — that is <s>phala</s> (fruit) (10).

children.text: दुःख कहिये पीड़ा ११ दुःखनाश मोक्षहै १२ एकर्में अनेक विरोध धर्मका
children.translated_text: <s>Duḥkha</s> (suffering) means pain (11). The destruction of suffering is <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation) (12). The knowledge of many contradictory properties in a single [thing]

children.text: जो ज्ञान सो संशय ३ जाके हेतु प्रवृत्तिहोय सो प्रयोजन ४ बादी अरु
children.translated_text: is <s>saṃśaya</s> (doubt) (3). That for which activity is undertaken as a cause — that is <s>prayojana</s> (purpose) (4). That in which there is no contradiction of meaning between the proponent and

children.text: प्रतिवादी का जो अर्थमें विरोध न होय सो दृष्टान्त ५ सिद्धान्त चारहैं
children.translated_text: the opponent — that is <s>dṛṣṭānta</s> (example) (5). <s>Siddhānta</s> (established conclusion) is of four kinds:

children.text: सबशास्त्र १ एकशास्त्र २ नवीन ३ अधिकरण ४ जाके सिद्धिके अनन्तर
children.translated_text: [accepted by] all <s>śāstras</s> (1), [accepted by] one <s>śāstra</s> (2), novel (3), and topical (4). That upon whose establishment

children.text: और अर्थकी सिद्धिहोय सो अधिकरणसिद्धान्तहै ६ अवयवपांचहैं प्रतिज्ञा १
children.translated_text: another meaning is also established — that is the <s>adhikaraṇa-siddhānta</s> (topical conclusion) (6). The members [of a syllogism] are five: <s>pratijñā</s> (proposition) (1),

children.text: हेतु २ उदाहरण ३ उपनय ४ निगमन ५ पर्वतमें वह्निहै ई ज्ञान प्रति
children.translated_text: <s>hetu</s> (reason) (2), <s>udāharaṇa</s> (example) (3), <s>upanaya</s> (application) (4), <s>nigamana</s> (conclusion) (5). 'There is fire on the mountain' — this knowledge is the propo-

children.text: ज्ञान ३१ धूमते ई ज्ञानहेतु २ जहां धूम तहां वह्नि जैसे रसोर्ह घर मों
children.translated_text: sition (1). 'Because of smoke' — this knowledge is the <s>hetu</s> (reason) (2). 'Where there is smoke, there is fire, as in a kitchen' —

children.text: ई उदाहरण ३ रसोर्ह के घर सादृश्य पर्वत है ई ज्ञान उपनय ३ धूम
children.translated_text: this is the <s>udāharaṇa</s> (example) (3). 'The mountain is similar to the kitchen' — this knowledge is the <s>upanaya</s> (application) (4). 'From the knowledge of smoke,

children.text: ज्ञानते पर्वत मों वह्निहै ई ज्ञान निगमन है ७अरु कार्य अश् कारणका
children.translated_text: there is fire on the mountain' — this knowledge is the <s>nigamana</s> (conclusion) (7). And the investigation of cause and effect is <s>tarka</s> (reasoning) (8). <s>Nirṇaya</s> means certainty (9). A debate between proponent and

children.text: बिचार सो तर्क ८ निर्णय कहिये निश्चय ९ सिद्धान्ततें अविरुद्ध जोबादी
children.translated_text: opponent that does not contradict the <s>siddhānta</s> (established conclusion), involving refutation and embellishment — that is <s>vāda</s> (debate) (10). When a defect in the means [of proof arises] through sophistry and the like — that gives rise to

children.text: प्रतिबादीका दूषणभूषण सोबाद१० छलादिकतेजोसाधनमें दूषण सोजन्म
children.translated_text: [defeat] (11). Being deficient in the establishment of one's own position — that defect is <s>vitaṇḍā</s> (cavil) (12). <s>Hetvābhāsa</s> (fallacious reasons)

children.text: ११ अपने पक्षके स्थापनो मों हीन जो दूषण सो वितण्डा १२ हेत्वाभास
children.translated_text: are of five kinds: erratic reason (1), contradictory (2), counter-balanced (3), unestablished (4) reason (5), and

children.text: पांचहैं व्यभिचारीहेतु १ विरोधी २ सत्प्रतिपक्ष३ असिद्ध ४ हेतु ५ बाधित
children.translated_text: contradicted reason (5) (13). <s>Chala</s> (quibble) is of three kinds: verbal (1), general (2), and figurative (3). The fabrication

children.text: हेत ५ । १३ छल तनिहैं बाक् १ सामान्य २ उपचार ३ वक्ताके अभि-
children.translated_text: of a different meaning from the speaker's intended meaning — that is verbal quibble (1). A quibble pertaining to the general [class] —

children.text: प्रायते अन्यअर्थकी जो कल्पनासो बाक् छल १ जाति विषयक जोछल सो
children.translated_text: that is the general [quibble] (2). A quibble [arising] from a figurative expression in the primary meaning — that is figurative [quibble] (14). The stating of a defect based on a common property or

children.text: सामान्य२ मुख्यार्थ में लक्षणतें जो छल उपचार १४ सामान्य धर्मते अरु
children.translated_text: a contradictory property — that is <s>jāti</s> (futile objection) (15). The proponent's silence when [confronted with] a contradictory meaning —

children.text: विरुद्ध धर्मते जो दूषण कथन सो जाति १५ बादी का विरुद्धार्थ के चुप
children.translated_text: that is <s>nigrahasthāna</s> (point of defeat) (16). (3) Now, the fourth: <s>Yoga Śāstra</s> (Science of Yoga). Its teacher is <s>Patañ-</s>

children.text: रहना सो निग्रहस्थान १६ । ३ अथ चतुर्थ योगशास्त्र यकेआचार्य पातं-
children.translated_text: <s>jali</s> Muni. In this, the restraint of the modifications of the mind (<s>cittavṛtti</s>) is the subject matter of <s>Yoga</s>. The modifications (<s>vṛttis</s>) are five:

children.text: जलि मुनि यामों चित्तबृत्ति का रोकनो योगमों विषयहै बृत्ति पांच हैं
children.translated_text: valid cognition (<s>pramāṇa</s>) (1), error (<s>viparyaya</s>) (2), conceptual construction (<s>vikalpa</s>) (3), sleep (<s>nidrā</s>) (4), and memory (<s>smṛti</s>). By division, valid cognition is of three kinds:

children.text: प्रमाण १ विपर्यय २ विकल्प ३ निद्रा ४ स्मृति भेदते प्रमाण तीन हैं
children.translated_text: perception (<s>pratyakṣa</s>) (1), inference (<s>anumāna</s>) (2), and verbal testimony (<s>āgama</s>) (3). Error is called false knowledge — for example,

children.text: प्रत्यक्ष १ अनुमान २ आगमन ३ भेदते विपर्यय कहिये मिथ्या ज्ञान जैसे
children.translated_text: the cognition of a snake in a rope (2). That which follows from verbal knowledge and is devoid of [real] object — that is concep-

children.text: रस्सी में सर्पज्ञान २ शब्दज्ञानते पाछे होय अरु अर्थते शून्य होय सो वि-
children.translated_text: tual construction (<s>vikalpa</s>) (3), such as the knowledge of a sky-flower and so forth. The modification pertaining to the absence of cognized objects is sleep (<s>nidrā</s>) (4). Not

children.text: कल्प ३ जैसे खपुष्पादि अभाव ज्ञान विषयक वृत्ति निद्राहै ४ अनुभूति
children.translated_text: forgetting an experienced object is memory (<s>smṛti</s>) (5). Restraining all five through practice (<s>abhyāsa</s>) and detachment (<s>vairāgya</s>)

children.text: विषय को न भूलना स्मृतिहै ५ अभ्यासते अरुवैराग्यते पांचोंको रोकनो
children.translated_text: — <s>samādhi</s> (meditative absorption) is of two kinds: one is <s>savīja</s> (with seed), the other is <s>nirvīja</s> (without seed). Through devotion to <s>Īśvara</s> (the Lord), <s>samādhi</s> is

children.text: समाधि द्वै हैं एक सवीज दूसरा निर्वीज ईश्वरकी भक्तिते समाधि सिद्ध
children.translated_text: accomplished. Affliction (<s>kleśa</s>) (1), action (<s>karma</s>) (2), fruit of action (<s>karmaphala</s>) (3), latent impression (<s>vāsanā</s>) (4) — a <s>Puruṣa</s> (Person)

children.text: होतहै क्लेश १ कर्म २ कर्मफल ३ बासना ४ ई चारोंते रहित जो पुरुष
children.translated_text: who is free from these four, that special being, is <s>Īśvara</s> (the Lord). Through the repetition (<s>japa</s>) of <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ) and through devotion to <s>Īśvara</s>, the attainment of <s>samādhi</s>

children.text: विशेष सो ईश्वरहै प्रणवके जपते अरु ईश्वरकी भक्तितें समाधिकालाभ
children.translated_text: and the destruction of obstacles occur. Disease (1), abandonment of good deeds (2), doubt (3), heedlessness (4),

children.text: अरु बिघ्नका नाश होतहै व्याधि १ सत्कर्म त्याग २ संशय ३ प्रमाद ४
children.translated_text: laziness (5), lack of detachment (6), confusion (7), dullness (8), instability (9) — these are the distractions; the mind

children.text: आलस्य ५ अवैराग्य ६ भ्रम ७ जड़ता ८ अश्वस्थता ९ ये बिक्षेप चित्त
children.translated_text: does not remain [steady]. Pain (1), agitation of mind (2), trembling of limbs (3), inhalation and exhalation of breath (4) —

children.text: मोंनाहीं रहत दुःख १ चित्तकी चंचलता२ अंगकंप ३ पूरकरेचकश्वास ४
children.translated_text: these are the accompaniments of distraction. For the purpose of removing them: applying the mind properly to <s>Īśvara</s> (the Lord),

children.text: ये बिशेपके संगीहैं याके दूर करनेके हेतु ईश्वरमों चित्त भलीभांति लगा
children.translated_text: not thinking ill of anyone, the cessation of sense objects, through anguish and contemplation,

children.text: वनो काहूको बुरो न माननो विषयके निवृत्ति होने संताप अरु बिचार ते
children.translated_text: and through <s>prāṇāyāma</s> (breath control) — the mind becomes one-pointed. By this method, in a stable mind, through [gradual] measure,

children.text: अरु प्राणायामते चित्त एकाग्र होतुहै या उपायते स्थिर चित्तमें परिमाण
children.translated_text: from the minute to space — everything becomes under control. Thereafter, when through discrimination the mind is

children.text: ते लैकै आकाश पर्यंत सब बश्य होतहैं याके अनन्तर जब विचारते शुद्ध
children.translated_text: pure, then the mind is stable. In a stable mind, true reasoning and wisdom (<s>prajñā</s>) arise. From that wisdom,

children.text: चित्तहै तब स्थिर चित्तहै स्थिर चित्तमों सत्य युक्ति प्रज्ञा होतहै ताप्रज्ञाते
children.translated_text: one sees everything — this is <s>savīja samādhi</s> (absorption with seed). From restraining that, <s>nirvīja samādhi</s> (seedless absorption) occurs.

children.text: सबको देखतुहै ईसवीजसमाधि है याके रोकनेते निर्बींज समाधि होतहै
children.translated_text: At that time, only the <s>Puruṣa</s> (pure self) remains. Vows (1), <s>mantra</s>-repetition (2), relinquishing desire for fruits in relation to <s>Īśvara</s> (the Lord)

children.text: वा कालमें पुरुषमात्रै रहतुहैं ब्रत १ मंत्रजप २ ईश्वर विषे फल कामना
children.translated_text: and complete surrender (3) — these three constitute <s>kriyā-yoga</s> (yoga of action). And from <s>kriyā-yoga</s>, the mind enters <s>samādhi</s>,

children.text: त्यागि सर्व समर्पण ३ ये तीन क्रिया योगहैं अरु क्रिया योगते समाधि
children.translated_text: and afflictions (<s>kleśas</s>) are diminished. Ignorance (<s>avidyā</s>) (1), ego (<s>ahaṃkāra</s>) (2), attachment (<s>rāga</s>) (3), aversion (<s>dveṣa</s>) (4),

children.text: में चित्त लगतुहै अरुक्लेश कम होतहै अबिद्या १ अहंकार २ राग ३ द्वेष४
children.translated_text: clinging (<s>āgraha</s>) (5) — these are the five afflictions. <s>Avidyā</s> means ignorance (1). The identification of <s>Puruṣa</s> (self) and the inner organ

children.text: आग्रह ५ ये पांच क्लेशहैंअविद्या कहियेअज्ञान १ पुरुष अरु अन्तःकरण की
children.translated_text: as one — that is <s>ahaṃkāra</s> (ego) (2). Craving for pleasure — that is <s>rāga</s> (attachment) (3). The hostile disposition arising from the memory of previously experienced pain —

children.text: एकता अहंकार २सुखमें तृष्णाराग ३ पूर्व अनुभूत दुःख स्मरण ते विरोध
children.translated_text: that is <s>dveṣa</s> (aversion) (4). Craving for the permanence of the body and other things — that is <s>āgraha</s> (clinging) (5). The abandonment through meditation

children.text: बृत्ति द्वेष ४ शरीर आदि बस्तुके स्थिरतगमों तृष्णा आग्रह ५स्थूल सूक्ष्म
children.translated_text: of the gross and subtle afflictions and of their modifications in the form of pleasure, pain, and delusion —

children.text: क्लेशनका अरु ताक्लेशंनकी सुखदुःखमोहरूपवृत्तिनकाध्यानते त्यागकरनो
children.translated_text: and the fruit of inauspicious <s>karma</s> born of afflictions — whether it be in this birth or in future births — for the discriminating person,

children.text: अरु क्लेशजन्य अशुभ कर्मको फल याजन्ममोहै वा जन्मांतरमोहै विवेकी
children.translated_text: everything is suffering. The conjunction of <s>buddhi</s> (intellect) and <s>Puruṣa</s> (self) is the cause of <s>saṃsāra</s> (worldly existence). <s>Buddhi</s> (intellect)

children.text: को सब दुःखहीहै बुद्धि अरु पुरुषका जो संयोग सो संसारको हेतुहै भोग
children.translated_text: is the producer of both enjoyment and liberation. <s>Puruṣa</s> is pure consciousness alone, and the self is of the nature of a reflection

children.text: अरु मोक्षकी उत्पादक बुद्धिहै पुरुष चेतनमात्रहै अरु बुद्धिरूप दर्पणमों
children.translated_text: in the mirror that is <s>buddhi</s>. The destruction of <s>avidyā</s> (ignorance) of one discriminating <s>Puruṣa</s>

children.text: प्रतिबिंबसंबंध स्वरूप आत्माहै एक बिबेकी पुरुषकी अविद्या नष्ट होनेते
children.translated_text: does not destroy the <s>avidyā</s> of all other <s>Puruṣas</s>. The non-discrimination of <s>buddhi</s> and <s>Puruṣa</s>

children.text: और सब पुरुषोंमें अविद्या नष्ट नहीं होत बुद्धि अरु पुरुषका अविवेक
children.translated_text: occurs from ignorance, and through discriminative knowledge, ignorance is destroyed — this itself is the liberation of <s>Puruṣa</s>.

children.text: अज्ञानते होतहै अरु बिबेक ज्ञानते अज्ञानको नाश होतहै यही पुरुष की
children.translated_text: And from discriminative knowledge, up to <s>savīja samādhi</s> (absorption with seed), seven <s>prajñās</s> (wisdoms) are produced

children.text: मुक्तिहै अरु बिबेक ज्ञानते पुरुषकेसवीज समाधि पर्यंत सात प्रज्ञाउत्पन्न
children.translated_text: for <s>Puruṣa</s>: 'I have now known the category of reality' (1); 'My afflictions such as <s>avidyā</s> (ignorance) have been destroyed' (2); 'I have known the means of renunciation' (3);

children.text: होतहैं हमतब पदार्थ जान्यो १ हमारे अविद्यादि क्लेश नाश भयो २ त्याग
children.translated_text: 'I have attained discriminative knowledge' (4); 'My <s>buddhi</s> (intellect) has become fulfilled;

children.text: को उपाय जान्यो ३ हमको विवेक ज्ञान भयो ४ मेरी बुद्धि कृतार्थ भई
children.translated_text: the modification of <s>buddhi</s> has dissolved into its cause and will not arise again' (5); 'I have

children.text: बुद्धिवृत्ति अपने कारण मोंलयह्वैगई पुनः उत्पन्न नहीं होयगी ५ हमारे
children.translated_text: self-mastered <s>samādhi</s>' (6); 'Now my essential nature has become free of modification' (7) — these are the seven <s>prajñās</s>. Through the practice of

children.text: स्वाधीनसमाधि है ६ अब निर्विकार स्वरूप भयो ७ईसात प्रज्ञाहैं संयोग
children.translated_text: union (<s>saṃyoga</s>), afflictions are destroyed and the light of knowledge shines forth. <s>Yama</s> (restraints) (1), <s>Niyama</s> (observances) (2),

children.text: करनेते क्लेश क्षय होत हैं अरु ज्ञानको प्रकाश होतहैं यम १ नियम २
children.translated_text: <s>Āsana</s> (posture) (3), <s>Prāṇāyāma</s> (breath control) (4), <s>Pratyāhāra</s> (withdrawal of senses) (5), <s>Dhāraṇā</s> (concentration) (6), <s>Dhyāna</s> (meditation) (7), <s>Samādhi</s> (absorption) (8) — these

children.text: आसन ३ प्राणायाम ४ प्रत्याहार ५ धारणा ६ ध्यान ७समाधि ८ ई
children.translated_text: are the eight limbs of <s>Yoga</s>. Non-violence (<s>ahiṃsā</s>) (1), truth (<s>satya</s>) (2), non-stealing (<s>acaurya</s>) (3), celibacy (<s>brahmacarya</s>) (4), non-possessiveness (<s>asaṃgraha</s>) (5) —

children.text: आठौ योगांगहैं अहिंसा १ सत्य २ अचौर्य ३ ब्रह्मचर्य ४ असंग्रह ५
children.translated_text: these five are the <s>Yamas</s> (restraints). Purity (<s>śauca</s>) (1), contentment (<s>santoṣa</s>) (2), austerity (<s>tapa</s>) (3), <s>mantra</s>-repetition (4), devotion to <s>Īśvara</s> (5) — these

children.text: ईपांच यमहैं शौच १ संतोष २ तप ३ मंत्रजप ४ ईश्वर निष्टा ५ ई
children.translated_text: five are the <s>Niyamas</s> (observances). A steady and comfortable [posture] is <s>Āsana</s>. From <s>Āsana</s>, the pairs of opposites such as pleasure and pain are destroyed.

children.text: पांच नियमहैं स्थिर सुख आसनहै आसनते सुख दुःखादि द्वंद्वको नाश
children.translated_text: The regulated interruption of the movement of inhalation and exhalation — that is <s>Prāṇāyāma</s> (breath control). From this,

children.text: होतुहै श्वास अह श्वासका जोगतिविच्छेद सो प्राणायाम है सो याते
children.translated_text: the light in the mind increases (4). Withdrawing the senses from their objects and fixing them on the mind —

children.text: चित्तमों प्रकाश होतहै ४ इंद्रियनके विषयते निबृत्त करके चित्तमों लगा
children.translated_text: that is <s>Pratyāhāra</s> (withdrawal) (5). Fixing the mind on a particular object such as the tip of the nose or the navel center —

children.text: वनो प्रत्याहारहै ५ नासिकाके अग्रभागमो अरु नाभि चक्रादि बस्तुबिशेष
children.translated_text: that is <s>Dhāraṇā</s> (concentration) (6). The unbroken flow of the mind's modification toward the object of meditation —

children.text: में चित्तकास्थिरकरना धारणाहै६चित्तका ध्येय विषयक जो बृतप्रवाह सो
children.translated_text: that is <s>Dhyāna</s> (meditation) (7). When the awareness is of the object alone, devoid of the distinction of modification and the rest —

children.text: ध्यान है ७वृत्ति आदि भेद शून्य अर्थ मात्रका भान होय जेहि मों सो स-
children.translated_text: that is <s>Samādhi</s> (absorption) (8). When <s>Dhāraṇā</s>, <s>Dhyāna</s>, and <s>Samādhi</s> — these three — occur together in one, that is <s>Saṃyama</s> (complete discipline). And from the <s>saṃyama</s> on sound,

children.text: माधिहै८ धारणा ध्यान समाधि ये हीन एकमोंहोहिं सोसंयमहै अरुशब्द
children.translated_text: knowledge of the sounds of all living beings arises. And from the <s>saṃyama</s> on latent impressions (<s>saṃskāras</s>), through direct perception of the <s>saṃskāras</s>,

children.text: के संयमते सब प्राणीका शब्दज्ञान होतहै अरु संस्कार संयमते संस्कार
children.translated_text: knowledge of previous births arises. From the <s>saṃyama</s> on another's mind, knowledge of that other's mind arises.

children.text: साक्षात्कार करनेसे पूर्वजन्मको ज्ञानहोतहै परचित्त विषे संयमते परचित्त
children.translated_text: And from the <s>saṃyama</s> on the form of the body, the <s>yogin</s> becomes invisible. From <s>saṃyama</s> on <s>Puruṣa</s>,

children.text: का ज्ञान होतहै अरुशरीरके रूपमें संयमते योगी अन्तर्द्धान होतहै पुरुष
children.translated_text: knowledge of <s>Puruṣa</s> arises. And <s>Prakṛti</s> (primordial nature) (1), <s>Buddhi</s> (intellect) (2), <s>Ahaṃkāra</s> (ego) (3), form (4),

children.text: में संयमते पुरुषको ज्ञान होतहै अरु प्रकृति १ बुद्धि २ अहंकार ३ रूप ४
children.translated_text: taste (5), smell (6), touch (7), sound (8), eyes (9), tongue (10), ears (11), nose (12),

children.text: रस ५ गन्ध ६ स्पर्श ७ शब्द ८ चसु ९ रसना १० कर्ण ११ नासिका १२
children.translated_text: skin (13), speech (14), hands (15), feet (16), anus (17), generative organ (18), mind (19),

children.text: त्वचा १३ बाक् १४ पाणि १५ पाद १५ पायु १७ उपस्थ १८ मन १९
children.translated_text: earth (20), water (21), fire (22), air (23), space (24), <s>Puruṣa</s> (25) — these are the twenty-five <s>tattvas</s> (principles).

children.text: पृथ्वी २० जल २१ तेज २२पायु २३ आकाश२४ पुरुष २५ ई पचीसतत्त्व
children.translated_text: And from <s>Prakṛti</s> arises <s>Buddhi</s>; from <s>Buddhi</s>, <s>Ahaṃkāra</s>; from <s>Ahaṃkāra</s>, beginning from form up to

children.text: हैं अरु प्रकृतिते बुद्धिकी उत्पत्ति बुद्धिते अहंकार अहंकारते रूपते लेके
children.translated_text: mind — the sixteen arise. From smell arises earth; from taste, water; from form, fire; from touch,

children.text: मनलों सोरहकी उत्पत्तिहैं गन्धते फृथ्वी रसते जल रूपते तेज स्पर्श ते
children.translated_text: air; from sound, space — these arise. And the abiding in one's own unconditioned essential nature —

children.text: बायु शब्दते आकाशकी उत्पत्तिहै अरु अपने निरुपाधिक स्वरूपमें जो
children.translated_text: that is the category of <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation) (4). Now, the fifth: <s>Sāṅkhya Śāstra</s> (the Science of Enumeration). Its teacher is <s>Ka-</s>

children.text: स्थिति सो मोक्ष पदार्थहै ४ अथ पञ्चम सांख्य शास्त्र याके आचार्य क-
children.translated_text: <s>pila</s> Muni. In this, the discrimination between <s>Prakṛti</s> (nature) and <s>Puruṣa</s> (self) is the subject matter. And the complete cessation of the threefold suffering

children.text: पिलमुनि यामें प्रकृति पुरुषको विवेक विषयहै अरु अत्यन्त दुःख त्रयकी
children.translated_text: is the purpose. From the knowledge of the twenty-five <s>tattvas</s> (principles), discrimination arises. <s>Puruṣa</s> (1), <s>Prakṛti</s> (2),

children.text: निवृत्ति प्रयोजनपच्चीस तत्त्वके ज्ञानते विवेक होतहै पुरुष १ प्रकृति २
children.translated_text: <s>Buddhi</s> (3), <s>Ahaṃkāra</s> (4), form (5), taste (6), smell (7), touch (8), sound (9), eyes (10),

children.text: बुद्धि ३ अहंकार ४ रूप ४ रस ६ गन्ध ७ स्पर्श ८ शब्द ९ चक्षु १०
children.translated_text: tongue (11), nose (12), skin (13), ears (14), speech (15), hands (16),
feet (17), anus (18), generative organ (19), mind (20), earth (21), water (22), fire (23),

children.text: पाद १७गुद १८ उपस्थ १९ मन २० पृत्वी २१ जल २२ तेज २३
children.translated_text: air (24), space (25) — these are the twenty-five <s>tattvas</s>. From <s>Prakṛti</s> arises <s>Buddhi</s>; from <s>Buddhi</s>,

children.text: बायुः २४ आकाश २५ ई पचीस तत्त्वहैं प्रकृतिते बुद्धिकी उत्पति बुद्धिते
children.translated_text: <s>Ahaṃkāra</s>; from <s>Ahaṃkāra</s>: form (1), taste (2), smell (3), touch (4), sound (5) — these five

children.text: अहंकार अहंकारते रूप १ रस २ गन्ध ३ स्पर्श ४ शब्द ४ ई पञ्च
children.translated_text: <s>tanmātras</s> (subtle elements); and eyes (1), tongue (2), nose (3), skin (4), ears (5), speech (6),

children.text: तन्मात्राकी अरु चक्षु १ जिह्वा २ नासिका ३ त्वचा ४ कर्ण ५वाक् ६
children.translated_text: hands (7), feet (8), anus (9), generative organ (10), mind (11) — the production of these eleven sense organs

children.text: पाणी ७पाद ८ गुद ९ उपस्थ १० मन ११ ईग्यारह इन्द्रियहूकी उत्प-
children.translated_text: arises. And from the five <s>tanmātras</s>: fire (1), water (2), earth (3), air (4), space (5) —

children.text: तिहै अरु पंच तन्मात्राते तेज १ जल २ पृष्वी ३वायु ४ आकाश ४
children.translated_text: the production of these five gross elements arises in sequence. And direction (1), time (2), space —

children.text: ईक्तञ्चस्थूल भूतनकी क्रमते उत्पतिहै गरु दिशा १ काल २ आकाश
children.translated_text: from the <s>sāttvika</s> (pure) <s>ahaṃkāra</s>, the eleven sense organs arise; and from the <s>tāmasa</s> (dark) <s>ahaṃkāra</s>, the five <s>tanmā-</s>

children.text: तेंसात्त्विक अहंकारतें एकादशइंद्रिय की अरु तामस अहंकारतें पंच तन्मा-
children.translated_text: <s>tras</s> arise. All these senses arise from <s>ahaṃkāra</s>, not from the elements. And the body is not the <s>Puruṣa</s>;

children.text: त्रा की ई सब इंद्रिय अहंकारतें उत्पन्नहैं भूतनसे नहीं हैं अरु शरीरपुरुष
children.translated_text: the body exists for the enjoyment of <s>Puruṣa</s>. And waking (1), dream (2), deep sleep (3) — these three

children.text: नहीं है पुरुषको भोग हेतु शरीरहै अरु जाग्रत् १ स्वप्न२ सुषुप्ति ३ ईतीन
children.translated_text: states belong to <s>buddhi</s>; <s>Puruṣa</s> is their witness. Birth (1), death (2), pleasure (3), pain (4),

children.text: अवस्था बुद्धि निष्टहैं पुरुषइनको साक्षीहै जन्म १मरण २ सुख ३ दुःख ४
children.translated_text: bondage (5), liberation (6) — all these being separately arranged for each <s>Puruṣa</s>, [it follows that] <s>Puruṣas</s> are many. And

children.text: बंध ४ मोक्ष ६ ईसब पुरुषके भिन्न भिन्न ब्यवस्था तें पुरुष बहुत हैं अरु
children.translated_text: no <s>dharma</s> (property) abides in <s>Puruṣa</s>; <s>Puruṣa</s> is of the nature of light, and is unattached. There is no <s>Īśvara</s> (God);

children.text: पुरुषमें कोई धर्म नहीं रहतु पुरुष प्रकाश रूपहै अरु असंग है ईश्वरनहीं
children.translated_text: if one accepts <s>Īśvara</s>, then <s>Īśvara</s> is either bound — in that case, the foolishness of creation-agency

children.text: है जो ईश्वर मानेगो तौईश्वर वद्धहै वह भयो तो मूड़त्वमैसृष्टिकर्तृत्वका
children.translated_text: would be impossible. If you accept me [<s>Prakṛti</s> as the cause], even then, due to the absence of attachment and aversion, the agency of creation

children.text: असंभवहोयगो जो मुझे मानोगेतौ भी राग द्वेषकेअभावतें सृष्टि कर्तृत्वका
children.translated_text: is impossible. Therefore there is no <s>Īśvara</s>. And whatever <s>Śruti</s> (revealed scripture) and <s>Smṛti</s> (traditional text) propound <s>Īśvara</s> —

children.text: असंभव है यातें ईश्वर नहींहै अरु ईश्वरप्रतिपादक जेती श्रुति स्मृति हैं
children.translated_text: all of those are in praise of the liberated <s>Puruṣa</s>. And <s>sattva</s> (1), <s>rajas</s> (2), <s>tamas</s> (3) — the three <s>guṇas</s> (qualities) — their state of

children.text: सो सब मुक्तपुरुषके प्रशंसापरहैं अरुसत्व१ रज२तमोगुण३इनकी जोमान
children.translated_text: equilibrium is <s>Prakṛti</s>. <s>Prakṛti</s> is extremely subtle and subject to transformation. Due to its extreme subtlety,

children.text: अवस्था सो प्रकृति है प्रकृति अतिसूक्ष्म है अरु परिणामी है अति सूक्ष्मत्व
children.translated_text: <s>Prakṛti</s> is not perceptible; however, it is inferrable from its effects such as <s>buddhi</s> and the rest. The creation of <s>buddhi</s> and the rest

children.text: मै प्रकृति प्रत्यक्ष नहीं है किंतु वुद्ध्यादिकार्यतें अनुमेयहै बुद्ध्यादि सृष्टि
children.translated_text: is for the sake of <s>Puruṣa's</s> enjoyment and liberation. Creation occurs from attachment (<s>prīti</s>), and liberation occurs from detachment (<s>vairāgya</s>).

children.text: पुरुषके भोगमोक्ष केहेतुहै प्रीतितें सृष्टि होतहै अरु बैराग्यतें मुक्ति होत
children.translated_text: Liberation does not come from sacrifices and the like; liberation comes from the discrimination between <s>Prakṛti</s> and <s>Puruṣa</s>. From <s>buddhi</s>

children.text: है यज्ञादिकतें मोक्ष नाहीं होत मोक्ष प्रकृति पुरुषके बिबेकतें होतहै बुद्धि
children.translated_text: arise knowledge (1), detachment (2), <s>dharma</s> (virtue) (3), and sovereignty (4) — these four. And the <s>buddhi</s> of animals and the like

children.text: तें ज्ञान १ बैराग्य२धर्म ३ ऐश्वर्य ४ ई चार उत्पन्न होतहैं अरु पशु आदि-
children.translated_text: becomes inverted due to the association of <s>rajas</s> and <s>tamas</s>; therefore in the <s>buddhi</s> of animals and the like,

children.text: क की बुद्धिरजतम के संबंधतें विपरीत होतहै याते पश्वादिकके बुद्धिमों
children.translated_text: <s>adharma</s> (vice) (1), ignorance (2), non-detachment (3), and lack of sovereignty (4) — these four properties abide. And from the subtle

children.text: अधर्म १ अज्ञान २ अबैराग्य३ अनैश्वर्य ४ईचारोंधर्म रहतुहैं अरु सूक्ष्म
children.translated_text: [elements], the gross elements are produced; from the gross elements, the body. According to some, the body is of five

children.text: में महाभूत उत्पन्नहोत है महा भूततें शरीर अरु काहू के मतमों पंच
children.translated_text: elements; according to others, it is of four elements without space; according to yet others, of earth (1), water (2),

children.text: भूतको शरीरहै काहूके आकाश रहित चार भूतको काहूके पृथ्वी १ जल २
children.translated_text: fire (3) — three elements; according to some, of earth (1) and water (2) — two elements; according to yet others, of earth alone —

children.text: तेज ३ तीन भूतको काहूके पृथ्वी १ जल२ है भूतको काहूके वलपृथ्वीको
children.translated_text: that is the body. And the five elements do not have consciousness as an inherent property; and in each [element] individually too,

children.text: शरीरहै अरुपंच भूतको स्वाभाविक चैतन्य धर्मनहीं है अरु प्रत्येक में भी
children.translated_text: there is no property of consciousness. Therefore, through the subtle body, pain and pleasure are experienced. As long as discriminative

children.text: चैतन्य धर्म नहीं यातें सूक्ष्मशरीरतें दुःख सुख जानिपरतहै जबलों बिबेक
children.translated_text: knowledge does not arise, so long the agency of beginning remains in the subtle elements. The production of the non-existent

children.text: ज्ञान नहीं होत तबलों सूक्ष्मभूतमें आरंभ कत्वरहतहै असत्की उत्पति
children.translated_text: does not occur; the production of the existent occurs. And dissolution into the cause — that is called destruction.

children.text: नहीं होत सत्की उत्पत्ति होतहै अह कारण में जो लयसो नाश कहावत
children.translated_text: At the time of creation, <s>Puruṣa</s> becomes bound through both <s>dharma</s> (virtue) and <s>adharma</s> (vice). At the time of dissolution, <s>dharma</s> and <s>adharma</s> —

children.text: है सृष्टि कालमों धर्म अधर्म दोऊतें पुरुषवद्ध होतहैप्रलय में धर्म अधर्म
children.translated_text: both <s>dharma</s> and <s>adharma</s> — <s>Puruṣa</s> becomes bound. At the time of dissolution, <s>dharma</s> and <s>adharma</s>

children.text: दोऊते पुरुष बद्ध होतहै प्रलय में धर्म अधर्म दोऊ सूते रहतहैं अरु सृष्टि
children.translated_text: both remain dormant. And in creation

children.text: कालमें पुनः फलोन्मुख होइकै अधर्म धर्म दोऊ शरीरका आरंभ करतहैं
children.translated_text: At the time [of maturation], becoming ready to bear fruit, both <s>adharma</s> (unrighteousness) and <s>dharma</s> (righteousness) initiate the body,

children.text: अरु मुक्तकालमें धर्म अधर्मका नाश ह्वै जातहै सच्चिदानन्दई आत्माका
children.translated_text: and at the time of liberation, <s>dharma</s> and <s>adharma</s> are destroyed — <s>saccidānanda</s> (existence-consciousness-bliss) alone is the nature

children.text: रूपहै आत्माहै ई सब जानतहैं और चिदंशमें भी काहू को संदेह नहीं
children.translated_text: of the <s>ātman</s> (soul). The <s>ātman</s> — all know this. And in the aspect of consciousness (<s>cit</s>), no one has any doubt.

children.text: होत अनंदांशमें सब को संदेहहै सांख्यके अभ्यास से क्रमतेझटितिआ-
children.translated_text: Regarding the aspect of bliss (<s>ānanda</s>), everyone has doubt. Through the practice of <s>Sāṃkhya</s>, either gradually or suddenly,

children.text: नंद लाभ होय जातहै कोई ऐसा मानत हैं सांख्य शास्त्र में आदि में अर्थ
children.translated_text: the attainment of bliss occurs — some hold this view. In the <s>Sāṃkhya</s> scripture, at the beginning, the word '<s>artha</s>'

children.text: शब्दका प्रयोगहै यातें सांख्य मतमें ईश्वर नित्य सिद्धहै ५ अथषष्ठ
children.translated_text: (purpose) is employed; therefore in the <s>Sāṃkhya</s> view, <s>Īśvara</s> (God) is eternally established. 5. Now the sixth:

children.text: बेदांत शास्त्र।। याके आचार्य वेदब्यास मुन्ति यामें जीवब्रह्मैक्य शुद्ध चैत-
children.translated_text: The <s>Vedānta</s> scripture. Its <s>ācārya</s> (teacher) is the sage <s>Vedavyāsa</s>. In this, the unity of <s>jīva</s> (individual soul) and <s>Brahman</s>, pure consciousness,

children.text: न्य बिषे है अज्ञान निवृत्ति आनंद प्राप्ति प्रयोजनहै अरुसाधन चार बैराग्य
children.translated_text: is the subject. The removal of ignorance and the attainment of bliss is the purpose. And the fourfold means [are]: renunciation (<s>vairāgya</s>),

children.text: १ बिबेक २ शमादिषट् ३ मुमुक्षुता ४ ब्रह्माइंद्राद्रि लोकके सुखको काक
children.translated_text: 1. discrimination (<s>viveka</s>), 2. the six [qualities] beginning with <s>śama</s> (tranquility), 3. the desire for liberation (<s>mumukṣutā</s>), 4. Knowing the pleasures of the worlds of <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Indra</s>, and others to be like

children.text: बिष्ठादिवत् जाननौ बैराग्य १ ब्रह्म नित्य और सब अनित्य यह बिबेक २
children.translated_text: crow-droppings — that is <s>vairāgya</s> (renunciation), 1. <s>Brahman</s> is eternal and everything else is impermanent — this is <s>viveka</s> (discrimination), 2.

children.text: अरु शम १ दम २ उपरति ३ तितिक्षा ४ श्रद्धा ५ समाधान ६ सदा बास-
children.translated_text: And: <s>śama</s> (tranquility) 1, <s>dama</s> (self-control) 2, <s>uparati</s> (withdrawal) 3, <s>titikṣā</s> (forbearance) 4, <s>śraddhā</s> (faith) 5, <s>samādhāna</s> (concentration) 6. The constant

children.text: ना कात्याग सो शम बाह्यइन्द्रियनका बिषयतेनिरोधदम २ विषयतेपीठ
children.translated_text: abandonment of desires is <s>śama</s>. The restraint of the external senses from their objects is <s>dama</s>, 2. Turning away from objects is

children.text: उपरति ३ शीत उष्णसहन तितिक्षा४ गुरुबेदांत बाक्यमों बिश्वास श्रद्धा
children.translated_text: <s>uparati</s>, 3. Enduring cold and heat is <s>titikṣā</s>, 4. Faith in the words of the <s>guru</s> and <s>Vedānta</s> is <s>śraddhā</s>,

children.text: ५चित्तएकाग्रता समाधान ६ संसार बंधनतेंकबमैं छुटिहों यहदृढनिश्चय
children.translated_text: 5. One-pointedness of mind is <s>samādhāna</s>, 6. 'When shall I be freed from the bondage of <s>saṃsāra</s> (worldly existence)?' — this firm determination is

children.text: मुमुक्षुता ७ ये सब साधन युक्तशांतचित्त जितेंद्रिय श्रद्धावान्याको अ-
children.translated_text: <s>mumukṣutā</s> (desire for liberation), 7. One who possesses all these means, who is peaceful-minded, sense-controlled, and faithful — such a person is the

children.text: धिकारीहै वस्तु में अबस्तुको आरोपसो अध्या रोपहै जैसे रज्जूमों सर्पको
children.translated_text: qualified aspirant. The superimposition of the unreal upon the real is <s>adhyāropa</s> (superimposition) — just as the superimposition of a snake upon a rope,

children.text: आरापेह वैसेही ब्रह्ममों जगत्को सच्चिदानंद ब्रह्म बस्तुहै अज्ञानादि स-
children.translated_text: so too the superimposition of the world upon <s>Brahman</s>. <s>Saccidānanda Brahman</s> (existence-consciousness-bliss) is the real; ignorance and the entire

children.text: कल जड़ समूह अवस्तुहै सत् असत् करके अकथनीय त्रिगुणात्मक ज्ञान
children.translated_text: inert aggregate is unreal. Being neither existent nor non-existent, indescribable, consisting of the three <s>guṇas</s> (qualities), having the nature of being opposed to knowledge —

children.text: का बिरोधीभाव रूप होय सो अज्ञान कहिये सो अज्ञान ब्यष्टिअभिप्राय
children.translated_text: that is called <s>ajñāna</s> (ignorance). That ignorance, from the individual (<s>vyaṣṭi</s>) perspective,

children.text: ते अनेक है अरु समष्टितें एक है ब्यष्टि कहिये अनेक प्रकार समष्टि
children.translated_text: is many, and from the collective (<s>samaṣṭi</s>) perspective, it is one. <s>Vyaṣṭi</s> means of many kinds; <s>samaṣṭi</s>

children.text: कहिये समूह जैसे बनमों ब्यष्टिअभिप्रापतें अनेक ब्रह्मई व्यवहार होत
children.translated_text: means aggregate. Just as in a forest, from the individual perspective there are many individual trees,

children.text: अरु अनेक वृक्षमें समष्टि अभिप्रायतें वन तैसे अनेकत्व करिकै भास
children.translated_text: and in the many trees, from the collective perspective there is 'forest' — similarly, that which makes the one [<s>Brahman</s>] appear

children.text: मान जो जीवन को अज्ञान वाके नानात्वकरिकै अनेकत्व ब्यवहार होतहै
children.translated_text: as many individual souls (<s>jīva</s>), their ignorance, through its manifoldness, creates the appearance of multiplicity.

children.text: है अरु जीवन को जो अनेक अज्ञान वामें समूहत्व अभिप्राय ते एकत्व
children.translated_text: And in the many instances of ignorance of individual souls, from the perspective of aggregate-ness, there is a unity

children.text: ब्यवहार होतहै समष्टि उत्कृष्टि उपाधिकरके शुद्धसत्वप्रधान जो चैतन्य
children.translated_text: of operation. With the collective, superior limiting adjunct (<s>upādhi</s>), being predominantly <s>śuddha sattva</s> (pure goodness), the consciousness

children.text: है सो सर्वज्ञ सबको नियामक अंतर्यामी जगत्को कारण ईश्वरहै याको
children.translated_text: that is omniscient, the ruler of all, the inner controller (<s>antaryāmī</s>), the cause of the world — that is <s>Īśvara</s> (God). His

children.text: आनंदमयकोशसुषुप्तिहै और कोशपांचहै५अन्नमय १ प्राणमय २मनोमय३
children.translated_text: <s>ānandamaya kośa</s> (bliss-sheath) is <s>suṣupti</s> (deep sleep). And there are five sheaths (<s>kośa</s>): <s>annamaya</s> (food) 1, <s>prāṇamaya</s> (vital breath) 2, <s>manomaya</s> (mind) 3,

children.text: बिज्ञानमय ४ आनंदमय ५ब्यष्ट निकृष्ट उपाधिकरके मलिनसत्व प्रधान
children.translated_text: <s>vijñānamaya</s> (intellect) 4, <s>ānandamaya</s> (bliss) 5. With the individual, inferior limiting adjunct, being predominantly impure <s>sattva</s>,

children.text: जो चैतन्यहै सो अल्पज्ञअनीश्वर प्राज्ञहै वाकेहूं आनन्दमयकोशसुषुप्ति है
children.translated_text: the consciousness that is of limited knowledge and not God is <s>prājña</s> (the knower in deep sleep). His <s>ānandamaya kośa</s> is also <s>suṣupti</s>.

children.text: अरु सुषुप्तिकालमोंचैतन्यकरिके प्रकाशितजोअतिसूक्ष्मअज्ञानवृत्तिसा करि
children.translated_text: And in the state of deep sleep, that which is illuminated by consciousness — that extremely subtle modification of ignorance, by means of which

children.text: केईश्वरअरु प्राज्ञयेदोऊआनन्दका अनुभव करतेहैं जैसे बनकेबृक्षका अभे
children.translated_text: <s>Īśvara</s> and <s>prājña</s> — both of these experience bliss. Just as the trees of a forest are non-different [from the forest],

children.text: द तैसे ससष्टिव्यष्टिको अभेदहै अरुजैसे बनके आकाशको अरुवृक्षके आ-
children.translated_text: so too the collective and the individual are non-different. And just as the space within the forest and the space within a tree

children.text: काशकोअभेदहै तैसे समष्टि उपाधि विशिष्ट ईश्वरको अरु व्यष्टि उपाधि
children.translated_text: are non-different, so too the consciousness qualified by the collective limiting adjunct (<s>Īśvara</s>) and the consciousness qualified by the individual limiting adjunct

children.text: विशिष्ट प्राज्ञको अभेदहै अज्ञान अरु अज्ञानोपाधि विशिष्ट चैतन्य ये
children.translated_text: (<s>prājña</s>) are non-different. Ignorance and the consciousness qualified by ignorance — the substratum of

children.text: दोऊका आधार जो उपाधि रहित चैतन्य सोतुरीय है अज्ञानकी द्वैशक्तिहै
children.translated_text: both of these, the consciousness free from all limiting adjuncts, is <s>Turīya</s> (the Fourth). Ignorance has two powers:

children.text: एक आवरण दूसरी विक्षेप जैसे अल्पमेघ सूर्य मण्डलको आवरण करत
children.translated_text: one is <s>āvaraṇa</s> (concealment) and the second is <s>vikṣepa</s> (projection). Just as a small cloud conceals the orb of the sun,

children.text: है तैसेई अज्ञान आत्माको आवरण शक्ति विशिष्ट जो आरमाहै वाको
children.translated_text: so too ignorance [conceals] the <s>ātman</s>. The <s>ātman</s> that is qualified by the concealing power —

children.text: कर्तृत्वभोक्तृत्व सुख दुःखादि संसारका संभवहै जैसे अपने अज्ञानते ढांपी
children.translated_text: for it, the sense of doership, enjoyership, happiness, suffering, and the entire <s>saṃsāra</s> (worldly existence) becomes possible. Just as in a rope concealed by one's own ignorance,

children.text: जो रस्सी है वामें सर्पको संभवहै अरु जैसे रस्तीको अज्ञान अज्ञानसों
children.translated_text: the appearance of a snake becomes possible. And just as the ignorance of the rope — the rope concealed by ignorance —

children.text: ढांपी जो रस्तीहै वामें विक्षेप शक्तिते सर्पका उत्पादिक है जैसे ईअज्ञान
children.translated_text: in that, through the projecting power (<s>vikṣepa śakti</s>), a snake is produced. Similarly, in the <s>ātman</s> concealed by this ignorance,

children.text: ते ढांपे आत्मामों विक्षेप शक्तिते आकाशादि प्रपञ्चको उत्पादक है २
children.translated_text: through the projecting power, the manifestation (<s>prapañca</s>) of space and the rest is produced. 2.

children.text: अरु तम प्रधान जो विक्षेप शक्ति विशिष्ट अज्ञानताद्विशिष्ट जो चैतन्य
children.translated_text: And the ignorance that is predominantly <s>tamas</s> (darkness), qualified by the projecting power — the consciousness qualified by that,

children.text: ताते आकाश उत्पन्न होतहै आकाशते बायु बायुते अग्नि अग्निते जल
children.translated_text: from it space (<s>ākāśa</s>) is produced; from space, wind; from wind, fire; from fire, water;

children.text: जलते पृथ्वी इन्हीं आकाशादि सूक्ष्म भूतनते पञ्च महाभूत और
children.translated_text: from water, earth. From these subtle elements of space and the rest, the five great elements (<s>mahābhūta</s>) and

children.text: सूक्ष्म शरीरकी उत्पत्तिहै सूक्ष्म शरीर जो है सोई लिंग शरीर यामें
children.translated_text: the subtle body are produced. The subtle body is itself the <s>liṅga śarīra</s> (subtle body), in which

children.text: सत्रह १७ अवयव रहतहैं पांच ज्ञानेंद्रिय ५ पांच कर्मेंद्रिय ५ पांचप्रा-
children.translated_text: seventeen components reside: five organs of knowledge (<s>jñānendriya</s>) 5, five organs of action (<s>karmendriya</s>) 5, five

children.text: णादि बुद्धि १६ मन १७ निश्चयात्मक अन्तःकरणकी जो वृत्तिसोबुद्धि
children.translated_text: vital breaths (<s>prāṇa</s>) and the rest, intellect (<s>buddhi</s>) 16, mind (<s>manas</s>) 17. The modification of the inner instrument (<s>antaḥkaraṇa</s>) that is of the nature of determination is <s>buddhi</s>;

children.text: है संकल्पात्मक जो अन्तःकरणकी बृत्ति सो मनहै चित्तको बुद्धिमें अन्त-
children.translated_text: the modification of the inner instrument that is of the nature of volition is <s>manas</s>. <s>Citta</s> (memory) is included within <s>buddhi</s>;

children.text: र्भावहै अहंकारको मनमें अन्तर्भावहै १ बुद्धि अरु मन आकाशादिकों के
children.translated_text: <s>ahaṃkāra</s> (ego) is included within <s>manas</s>. 1. <s>Buddhi</s> and <s>manas</s> are produced from the combined <s>sāttvika</s> (pure) portions of space and the rest.

children.text: मिलतसात्विक अंशते उत्पन्नहैं ई जो बुद्धिहै सो ज्ञानेंद्रिय के संयुत
children.translated_text: This <s>buddhi</s>, combined with the organs of knowledge,

children.text: विज्ञानमयकोश होतहै २ अरु विज्ञानमयकोश जो है सो कर्तृत्वभोक्तृ-
children.translated_text: constitutes the <s>vijñānamaya kośa</s> (intellect-sheath). 2. And the <s>vijñānamaya kośa</s> is the one that identifies with

children.text: त्वका अभिमानीहै यह लोक परलोक गामीहै सो व्यवहारमें जीवकहा
children.translated_text: doership and enjoyership. It traverses this world and the next. In common parlance, it is called <s>jīva</s> (the individual soul).

children.text: वतहै अरु मन ज्ञानेन्द्रियके सहित मनोमयकोश होतहै ३ अरु प्राणबायु
children.translated_text: And <s>manas</s> together with the organs of knowledge constitutes the <s>manomaya kośa</s> (mind-sheath). 3. And the vital breaths

children.text: पांचहैं प्राण १ अपान २ व्यान ३ उदान ४ समान ५ हृदयको बायु प्राण
children.translated_text: are five: <s>prāṇa</s> 1, <s>apāna</s> 2, <s>vyāna</s> 3, <s>udāna</s> 4, <s>samāna</s> 5. The breath of the heart is <s>prāṇa</s>;

children.text: गुदाको अपान मन सब शरीरको व्यान कंठको उदान नाभिको समान
children.translated_text: of the anus is <s>apāna</s>; of the entire body is <s>vyāna</s>; of the throat is <s>udāna</s>; of the navel is <s>samāna</s>.

children.text: पांचां प्राण कर्मेन्द्रियसहित प्राणमयकोश होत है १ आनन्दमयकोशमें
children.translated_text: The five <s>prāṇas</s> together with the organs of action constitute the <s>prāṇamaya kośa</s> (vital breath sheath). 1. In the <s>ānandamaya kośa</s> (bliss sheath)

children.text: अरु कर्तृत्वहैं मनोमयकोशमें इच्छा ग्ररु कर्णत्वहै प्राणमयकोशमें क्रिया
children.translated_text: there is also doership. In the <s>manomaya kośa</s> there is desire and agency. In the <s>prāṇamaya kośa</s> there is action

children.text: अरु कर्मत्वहे ई तीनोंको सूक्ष्मरूप कहावतहैंसूक्ष्मरूप समूहमें एकबुद्धि
children.translated_text: and instrumentality. These three are called the subtle form. In the aggregate of subtle forms, by being the object of one intellect,

children.text: विषयत्व करिकै बनतादृश्य समष्टिहै अहु सब सूक्ष्म शररि में अनेक बुद्धि
children.translated_text: [they become] like a visible forest — that is <s>samaṣṭi</s> (collective). And in all the subtle bodies, by being the objects of many intellects,

children.text: विषयत्व करिकै व्यष्टिजै अरु समष्टि उपाधि विशिस्ट जो चैतन्य है सो
children.translated_text: [they are] <s>vyaṣṭi</s> (individual). And the consciousness qualified by the collective limiting adjunct is

children.text: सूत्रात्मा अरु हिरण्यगर्भ कहावतुहै तहां ज्ञान १ इच्छा २ क्रिया ३
children.translated_text: called <s>sūtrātman</s> (the thread-self) and <s>hiraṇyagarbha</s> (the golden embryo). There, knowledge 1, desire 2, action 3 —

children.text: ई तीनों शक्तिहैं विज्ञानमयादिकोश तीन जो हैं ३ सो जाग्रत् अवस्थाके बास
children.translated_text: these are the three powers. The three sheaths beginning with <s>vijñānamaya</s> constitute the dream state (<s>svapna</s>) through the impressions of the waking state.

children.text: नासे स्वप्नहैस्वप्नकालमें सूत्रात्मा जो है सो मनकी वृत्तिते सूक्ष्मविषय
children.translated_text: In the dream state, the <s>sūtrātman</s>, through the modifications of the mind, experiences subtle objects.

children.text: को अनुभव करतहै आकाशमें शब्द बायुमें शब्द स्पर्श तेजमें शब्द स्पर्श
children.translated_text: In space there is sound; in wind there is sound and touch; in fire there is sound, touch, and

children.text: रूप जलमें शब्द स्पर्श रूपरस पृथ्वीमें शब्द स्पर्श रूपरस गन्ध हैं अरु
children.translated_text: form; in water there is sound, touch, form, and taste; in earth there is sound, touch, form, taste, and smell. And

children.text: पञ्चभूततें भूर्लोक १ भुवः २ स्वर ३ महर४ जन ५ तप६ सत्य७ईसात
children.translated_text: from the five elements, the seven upper worlds are produced: <s>Bhūḥ</s> 1, <s>Bhuvaḥ</s> 2, <s>Svar</s> 3, <s>Mahar</s> 4, <s>Jana</s> 5, <s>Tapa</s> 6, <s>Satya</s> 7.

children.text: लोक ऊपरके उत्पन्न होतहैं अरु अतल १वितल २ सुतल ३ तलातल ४
children.translated_text: And the seven lower worlds are produced: <s>Atala</s> 1, <s>Vitala</s> 2, <s>Sutala</s> 3, <s>Talātala</s> 4,

children.text: महातल ५ रसातल ६ पाताल ७ ईसात लोक नीचे के उत्पन्न होतहैं
children.translated_text: <s>Mahātala</s> 5, <s>Rasātala</s> 6, <s>Pātāla</s> 7.

children.text: एतत्स मूहोपाधि विशिष्ट चैतन्य विराट् है अरु स्थूल शरीर जो है सो
children.translated_text: The consciousness qualified by this aggregate-adjunct is <s>Virāṭ</s> (the cosmic form). And the gross body

children.text: अन्नको विकार है याते अन्नमें कोशहै सो स्थूल भोगतें जाग्रत् है स्थूल
children.translated_text: is a modification of food; hence the <s>annamaya kośa</s> (food-sheath). Gross experience constitutes the waking state (<s>jāgrat</s>). The gross

children.text: देहकी जो अनेक उपाधितद्विशिष्ट जो चैतन्य सो विश्वहै अरु अज्ञान
children.translated_text: body's many limiting adjuncts — the consciousness qualified by those is <s>viśva</s> (the waker). And the consciousness qualified by ignorance

children.text: विशिष्ट जो चैतन्य सो जीवहै ज्ञान विशिष्ट चैतन्य ईश्वरहै भाग त्याग
children.translated_text: is <s>jīva</s> (the individual soul). The consciousness qualified by knowledge is <s>Īśvara</s> (God). Through the method of <s>bhāga-tyāga-lakṣaṇā</s>

children.text: लक्शणातें अज्ञान का त्याग करो अरु ईश्वर लक्षण में ते ज्ञानको त्याग
children.translated_text: (partial indication by abandonment), abandon the ignorance [from the <s>jīva</s>'s definition], and from <s>Īśvara</s>'s definition, abandon the knowledge —

children.text: करो तो दोऊ चैतन्य एकहै ब्रह्म सत्यहै और सब मिथ्याहै ऐसी दृष्टि
children.translated_text: then both [are seen as] one consciousness. <s>Brahman</s> is real and everything else is illusory. With such vision,

children.text: समुझते जीवहै सो ब्रह्महै इति शास्त्र ।। अथ वेद ।। सो बेद अनादि सर्ब
children.translated_text: understanding, the <s>jīva</s> is <s>Brahman</s>. Thus [ends] the scripture. Now, the <s>Vedas</s>. The <s>Vedas</s> are beginningless, the root of all

children.text: पुराण शास्त्र संहितादि औयावत् व्यवहारपरिमाणको मूलहै अरु सब
children.translated_text: <s>Purāṇas</s>, scriptures, <s>Saṃhitās</s>, and so forth, and of all transactional knowledge. And they are

children.text: आस्तिक सम्मत अपौरुषेय अगाध आशय अनन्तहै तेहि हेतु कह संक्षेप
children.translated_text: accepted by all believers (<s>āstikas</s>), not of human authorship (<s>apauruṣeya</s>), of unfathomable meaning, and infinite. For this reason, I write [about them] briefly.

children.text: से लिखा वेदके भेद चार ऋग्वेद १ यजुर्वेद २ सामवेद ३ अथर्बणवेद ४

children.text: ऋग्वेदकी मुख्यशाखा आठ सोसाकल १ वाष्कल २ ऐतरेय ३ ब्राह्मणा
children.translated_text: The main branches (<s>śākhā</s>) of the <s>Ṛgveda</s> are eight: <s>Śākala</s> 1, <s>Vāṣkala</s> 2, <s>Aitareya</s> 3, <s>Brāhmaṇāraṇya</s>

children.translated_text: 4, <s>Sāṃkhyāyana</s> 5, <s>Māṇḍūka</s> 6, <s>Kauṣītakīya</s> 7, <s>Āraṇyaka</s> 8. And there are eight

children.translated_text: 6, <s>Kramajaṭā</s> 7, <s>Kramadaṇḍa</s> 8. The meaning of the eight stages in sequence: <s>Carcā</s> means study
