children.translated_text: (<s>adhyayana</s>) 1. He who teaches the study is the <s>guru</s> — <s>Śrāvaka</s> 2. <s>Carcaka</s> means the student (<s>śiṣya</s>) 3. The completion of the <s>Veda</s>

children.text: समाप्ति सो श्रवणीयपार ४ क्रमपार संज्ञा कहिये संहिता५संहिताकापद-
children.translated_text: is <s>Śravaṇīyapāra</s> 4. <s>Kramapāra</s> is the designation for <s>Saṃhitā</s> 5. The word-splitting of the <s>Saṃhitā</s>,

children.text: संहिताका दंड सो क्रमदंड ८ क्रभपारादि चार स्थानके चार पारायहैं
children.translated_text: The <s>daṇḍa</s> (staff recitation) of the <s>Saṃhitā</s> is <s>Kramadaṇḍa</s> 8. The four stages beginning with <s>Kramapāra</s> have four recitations (<s>pārāyaṇa</s>).

children.text: १०५८० ऋचाका एक पारायण होत है संहिताका १ औ पदका २ ई
children.translated_text: One recitation consists of 10,580 <s>ṛcas</s> (hymn verses) — that is the <s>Saṃhitā</s> recitation 1. And the <s>pada</s> [recitation] 2 —

children.text: दोई प्रकृति पारायण जटाका १ औ दण्डका २ ई दुई विकृति पारायण
children.translated_text: these two are <s>prakṛti pārāyaṇa</s> (natural recitations). The <s>jaṭā</s> 1 and the <s>daṇḍa</s> 2 — these two are <s>vikṛti pārāyaṇa</s> (modified recitations).

children.text: विकृति नवहैं ९ क्रम १ जटा २ माला ३ शिखा ४ लेखा ५ ध्वज६ दंड७
children.translated_text: The modified forms (<s>vikṛti</s>) are nine: <s>krama</s> 1, <s>jaṭā</s> 2, <s>mālā</s> 3, <s>śikhā</s> 4, <s>lekhā</s> 5, <s>dhvaja</s> 6, <s>daṇḍa</s> 7,

children.text: रथ ८ घन ९ इनके लक्षण संहिताके पदनको अनुलोम विलोम पढ़ना
children.translated_text: <s>ratha</s> 8, <s>ghana</s> 9. Their characteristics: Reading the words of the <s>Saṃhitā</s> in forward and reverse order

children.text: सो क्रम १ दुइ पदको वा तीनपदको आदि औ अंतमों अनुलोम अरु मध्य
children.translated_text: is <s>krama</s> 1. Reading two or three words in forward order at the beginning and end, and in reverse with <s>sandhi</s> (junctions) in the middle,

children.text: मों संधि सहित विलोम पठना सो जटा २ जटा कहिये उसके आगेके पद
children.translated_text: is <s>jaṭā</s> 2. <s>Jaṭā</s> means: after pronouncing the succeeding word once, reading the three words with <s>sandhi</s> in reverse, and then again at the end

children.text: को एकबार उच्चारण कर तीनपद ससंधिक विलोम पढ़के पुनः अन्तमों
children.translated_text: reading all three words in forward order

children.text: तीनोंपद अनुलोम पठना सोघन ३ इत्यादि ।। ऋग्वेदके अध्याय ६४
children.translated_text: is <s>ghana</s> 3. And so forth. The <s>Ṛgveda</s> has 64 chapters (<s>adhyāya</s>),

children.translated_text: 10 <s>maṇḍalas</s> (books) — <s>maṇḍala</s> means division. <s>Vargas</s> (sections): 2,006. <s>Sūktas</s> (hymns): 1,017. Words (<s>pada</s>): 153,792.

children.text: इतिऋग्वेद ।। अथ यजुर्वेद ।। यजुर्वेदकीशाखा ८६ बेचरक १ आह्वारक २

children.translated_text: <s>Mādhyandīnīya</s> 14, and so forth. The divisions of the <s>Maitrāyaṇīya</s> branch are 7: <s>Mānava</s> 1, <s>Dundubheya</s> 2,

children.translated_text: <s>Caikeya</s> 3, <s>Vārāha</s> 4, <s>Hāridavedya</s> 5, <s>Śyāmā</s> 6, <s>Śyāmāyavīya</s> 7. The

children.text: शाखाके भेद १७ का एव १ माध्यंदिनीय २ शावीय ३ स्थापायनीय ४
children.translated_text: divisions of the <s>Vājasaneya</s> branch are 17: <s>Kāṇva</s> 1, <s>Mādhyandīnīya</s> 2, <s>Śāvīya</s> 3, <s>Sthāpāyanīya</s> 4,

children.translated_text: are 5: <s>Āpastambī</s> 1, <s>Baudhāyanī</s> 2, <s>Satyāṣāḍhī</s> 3, <s>Hiraṇyakeśī</s> 4, <s>Audheyi</s> 5.

children.translated_text: The ten <s>saṃskāras</s> (purificatory rites) of <s>mantras</s>: <s>janana</s> (birth) 1, <s>jīvana</s> (enlivening) 2, <s>tāḍana</s> (striking) 3, <s>bodhana</s> (awakening) 4, <s>abhiṣeka</s> (consecration) 5,

children.text: विमलीकरण ६ आप्यायन ७ तर्यन ८ दीपन ९ गुप्ति १० मातृका
children.translated_text: <s>vimalīkaraṇa</s> (purification) 6, <s>āpyāyana</s> (nourishment) 7, <s>tarpana</s> (propitiation) 8, <s>dīpana</s> (illumination) 9, <s>gupti</s> (protection) 10. The extraction of a <s>mantra</s>

children.text: से मन्त्रका उद्धार सो जनन १ प्रणवयुत जपसो जीवन २ मंत्राक्षर
children.translated_text: from the <s>Mātṛkā</s> (alphabet) is <s>janana</s> (birth) 1. Recitation (<s>japa</s>) together with <s>praṇava</s> (Oṃ) is <s>jīvana</s> (enlivening) 2. Writing the <s>mantra</s> letters,

children.text: लिख चंदन जलसे मतिअक्षर छिरकनो सोताड़न ३ इत्यादि ईदश सं-
children.translated_text: sprinkling with sandalwood water to erase impure letters — that is <s>tāḍana</s> (striking) 3. And so forth. Through such

children.text: स्कारसे अवश्य मन्त्र सिद्धहोतु है कूर्म चक्रते सिद्ध असाध्यादि भेद
children.translated_text: purificatory rites, the <s>mantra</s> necessarily becomes accomplished (<s>siddha</s>). Through the <s>Kūrma-cakra</s> (tortoise diagram), the distinctions of <s>siddha</s> (accomplished), <s>asādhya</s> (unaccomplishable), and the like

children.text: बिचार करनो मन्त्र जपके स्थान तीर्थ नदी तीर पवित्र बन देवता मंदिर
children.translated_text: are to be determined. The places for <s>mantra</s> recitation: sacred sites (<s>tīrthas</s>), riverbanks, pure forests, temples of deities,

children.text: आदि । गुरुलक्षण कुलीनसर्वागमशास्त्रको तत्त्वजानै जितेंद्रिय सत्यवादी
children.translated_text: and the like. Characteristics of the <s>guru</s> (teacher): of good family, knows the essence of all <s>āgama-śāstras</s> (scriptures), with controlled senses, truthful,

children.text: आदि । शिष्य लक्षण कुलीन शुद्धमन पुरुषार्थयुत वेदपठित जितेंद्रिय
children.translated_text: and the like. Characteristics of the disciple (<s>śiṣya</s>): of good family, pure-minded, endowed with purposefulness, learned in the <s>Vedas</s>, with controlled senses,

children.text: आदि। तन्त्रशास्त्रमोंदीक्षाको ग्रहण मुख्य इष्टदेवताका गुस्से मंत्रोपदेश
children.translated_text: and the like. In the <s>Tantra-śāstra</s>, the reception of <s>dīkṣā</s> (initiation) is primary — the instruction of the <s>mantra</s> of the chosen deity (<s>iṣṭadevatā</s>) from the <s>guru</s>

children.text: सो दीक्षा । पापनाश करि दिव्य ज्ञान देतहै याते दीक्षानाम भयो याके
children.translated_text: is <s>dīkṣā</s> (initiation). It destroys sins and bestows divine knowledge; hence the name '<s>dīkṣā</s>' arose. Its

children.text: भेद ४ चार क्रियामयी १ वर्णमयी २ कलामयी ३ बेधमयी ४ चारों के
children.translated_text: divisions are four: <s>kriyāmayī</s> (ritual-based) 1, <s>varṇamayī</s> (letter-based) 2, <s>kalāmayī</s> (phase-based) 3, <s>vedhamayī</s> (penetrative) 4. The performer of all four

children.text: कर्ता गुरु नित्य कर्म कुंडमंडपादिकरनो क्रियामयी१ शिष्य देहमोंबर्णादि
children.translated_text: is the <s>guru</s>. The daily rites of constructing the fire-pit, pavilion, and the like constitute <s>kriyāmayī</s> [initiation] 1. The <s>nyāsa</s> (placement) of letters and the like on the disciple's body

children.text: न्यास २ निवृत्त्यादि पांच कलाको तेहि३ अंगनमों योजनकदी०३ शिष्य
children.translated_text: is [<s>varṇamayī</s>] 2. The assignment of the five <s>kalās</s> (phases) beginning with <s>nivṛtti</s> on those very limbs is [<s>kalāmayī</s> initiation] 3. The meditation of the all-pervading conscious power (<s>cetana-śakti</s>) in the disciple's

children.text: शरीरमों चेतनशक्तिकाव्यापकध्यानसोवेधमयीदी०४ अध्वाक्षहैं कलाध्वा
children.translated_text: body is <s>vedhamayī</s> (penetrative) initiation 4. The six <s>adhvans</s> (paths) are: <s>kalādhvā</s> (path of phases)

children.text: १ तत्त्वाध्वा २ भुवनाध्वा ३ वर्णाध्वा ४ पलाध्वा ५ मंत्राध्व ६ अध्वा
children.translated_text: 1, <s>tattvādhvā</s> (path of principles) 2, <s>bhuvanādhvā</s> (path of worlds) 3, <s>varṇādhvā</s> (path of letters) 4, <s>padādhvā</s> (path of words) 5, <s>mantrādhvā</s> (path of mantras) 6. <s>Adhvā</s>

children.text: कहिये रास्ता गुरु को ईषट् अध्वाका साधन उचितहै देवता पूजा का
children.translated_text: means 'path.' The practice of these paths is proper for the <s>guru</s>'s chosen [deity]. Deity worship has

children.text: सात वा पांच आवरण है यही सब रास्ता से जीवको मोक्ष होत है ।।
children.translated_text: seven or five coverings (<s>āvaraṇas</s>). Through all these paths, liberation of the soul (<s>jīva</s>) is attained.

children.text: इतितंत्रशास्त्रसंक्षेपः ।।
children.translated_text: Thus ends the summary of <s>Tantra-śāstra</s>.

children.text: इतिमानसदीपिकायांपुराणादिशास्त्रनिगमागमवर्णतेद्वितीयःप्रकाशः२ ।।
children.translated_text: Thus ends the second illumination (<s>prakāśa</s>) in the <s>Mānasadīpikā</s>, describing the <s>Purāṇas</s> and other scriptures, <s>Vedas</s>, and <s>Āgamas</s>.

children.text: अथकाव्यअंग ।। या रामायणमों श्रीगोसाईं जी यावत् काव्य के अंग
children.translated_text: Now, the elements of poetry (<s>kāvya-aṅga</s>): Whatever elements of poetry Śrī <s>Gosvāmī</s> jī has employed in this <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s>,

children.text: धरेहैं अरु बिना काव्यजाने बहुतजन बहुत ठौर शंका करतुहैं तातेलक्षण
children.translated_text: and since many people in many places raise doubts without knowing poetry, therefore the definitions

children.text: और और काव्यके ग्रन्थनके अरु उदाहरण या रामायणके सरलरातिते
children.translated_text: and examples from this <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s> and other poetic works are written in simple fashion.

children.text: लिखेजातेहैं ।। अथकाव्यलक्षण ।। शब्द अर्थ सुन्दर गुणयुत दोष रहित
children.translated_text: Now, the definition of poetry (<s>kāvya-lakṣaṇa</s>): Beautiful in word and meaning, endowed with qualities, free from defects.

children.text: अथकाव्यप्रयोजन ।। यश सम्पत्ति आनन्द दारिद्रनाश चातुरता संसार
children.translated_text: Now, the purpose of poetry (<s>kāvya-prayojana</s>): Fame, prosperity, bliss, destruction of poverty, cleverness, [knowledge of] the world,

children.text: अरु रामबश होवो ।। अथकाव्यकोकारण ।। चित्तताके कारण तीनशक्ति १
children.translated_text: and becoming subject to <s>Rāma</s>. Now, the cause of poetry (<s>kāvya-kāraṇa</s>): Its causes are three: <s>śakti</s> (innate talent) 1,

children.text: व्युत्पत्ति २ अभ्यास ३ शक्तिदेव कृपा ।। यथा जेहिपरकृपाकरहिंजनजानी ।
children.translated_text: <s>vyutpatti</s> (learning) 2, <s>abhyāsa</s> (practice) 3. <s>Śakti</s> is divine grace. As [the verse says]: 'He upon whom the one known to the people bestows grace —

children.text: कविउर अजिरनचावहिं बानी १ व्युत्पत्ति पठन ।। यथा गुरुगृहगये पठन
children.translated_text: from his mouth flows the speech of a poet and sage.' 1. <s>Vyutpatti</s> is study. As: 'The lord of the <s>Raghus</s> went to the guru's house to study.'

children.text: रघुराई २ अभ्यास करे सिद्धहोय २ यथा उलटानाम जपतजगजाना ।
children.translated_text: 2. Practice makes perfect. As: 'By repeating the reversed name, the world came to know.' 2.

children.text: सो काव्य ३ भांति उत्तम १ मध्यम २ अधम ३ अथ उत्तम जीव व्यम
children.translated_text: Poetry is of three kinds: excellent (<s>uttama</s>) 1, middling (<s>madhyama</s>) 2, inferior (<s>adhama</s>) 3. Now, the excellent — the suggested meaning (<s>vyaṅgya</s>) is predominant.

children.text: प्रधान ।। यथा नीक दीन हरि सुन्दरताई १ टी० नीकको बुरो समझनो
children.translated_text: As: 'He sees the beauty of <s>Hari</s> as lowly and wretched.' 1. Commentary: Understanding good as bad

children.text: लक्षण तातें नारदको अनुचित व्यंग अथ मध्यम व्यंग वच्यवरावर यथा
children.translated_text: is the characteristic; hence <s>Nārada</s>'s improper suggestion. Now, the middling — the suggested meaning and the literal meaning are equal. As:

children.text: कहँ कुम्भज कहँ सिंधु अपारा २ टी० इनको तेज देखाय रामका तेज
children.translated_text: 'Where is the pot-born (<s>Agastya</s>)? Where is the boundless ocean?' 2. Commentary: By showing their power, <s>Rāma</s>'s power

children.text: सूचित कर संदेह दूरहोवो व्यंग अथ अधम जामों व्यंग नहीं सो द्वैभांति
children.translated_text: is hinted at, removing doubt — that is the suggestion. Now, the inferior — where there is no suggestion; it is of two kinds:

children.text: एकशब्द चित्र यथा मारुमारु धरुधरु धरु मारू १ दूसरो अर्थ चित्र यथा
children.translated_text: one is word-ornamentation (<s>śabda-citra</s>), as: '<s>māru māru dharu dharu dharu māru</s>' 1. The second is meaning-ornamentation (<s>artha-citra</s>), as:

children.text: नील सरोरुह नील मणि नील नीर धरश्याम टी० उपमातें चमत्कार
children.translated_text: 'Blue lotus, blue gem, blue — the cloud-dark bearer of water.' Commentary: The wonder is in the comparison —

children.text: अर्थ है । अथशब्द अर्थ निर्णय सुनाय सो शब्द बुझाय सो अर्थ शब्दद्वै
children.translated_text: that is the meaning. Now, the determination of word and meaning: What is heard is word (<s>śabda</s>); what is understood is meaning (<s>artha</s>). Words are

children.text: भांति ध्वन्यात्मक बाजातें १ वर्णात्मक मूखतें २ सो तीन भांति बाचक १
children.translated_text: of two kinds: sound-based (from instruments) 1, letter-based (from the mouth) 2. These are of three kinds: denotative (<s>vācaka</s>) 1,

children.text: लक्षक २ व्यंजक ३ अरु अपरसब चारिभांति प्रभु सम्मति बेदादि १ मित्र
children.translated_text: indicative (<s>lakṣaka</s>) 2, suggestive (<s>vyañjaka</s>) 3. And otherwise, all are of four kinds: authoritative like the <s>Vedas</s> and the like 1, friendly

children.text: सम्मित स्मृत्यादि २ कांता सम्मित पुराणादि सर्वोपकारक आगम ४ अथ
children.translated_text: like the <s>Smṛtis</s> and the like 2, beloved like the <s>Purāṇas</s> and the like, benefiting all — <s>Āgamas</s> 4. Now,

children.text: बाचक जो सुनतहीं जानै यथा जलतें पानीको बोध सो चारिभांति जाति
children.translated_text: the denotative (<s>vācaka</s>): that which is known upon hearing — as when one understands water from '<s>jala</s>.' It is of four kinds: generic (<s>jāti</s>)

children.text: १ देवादि इच्छा २ भैया आदि गुण ३ श्यामादि क्रिया ४ स्वरारि आदिअथ
children.translated_text: 1 — gods and the like; volitional (<s>icchā</s>) 2 — 'brother' and the like; qualitative (<s>guṇa</s>) 3 — 'dark' and the like; active (<s>kriyā</s>) 4 — 'enemy' and the like. Now,

children.text: लक्षक सुधे शब्द मोटेढ़ो भाव यथा धिकधर्मध्वज धंधकधोरी टी० है
children.translated_text: the indicative (<s>lakṣaka</s>): a word with a straight [literal] meaning but a curved [implied] sense. As: 'Fie upon the banner of dharma, the terrible deceiver!' Commentary:

children.text: ऊंचो पैनीचो बोधकहै। अथ व्यंजक अधिक अर्थ बोधतें यथा मोर मनो-
children.translated_text: It is high [literally] but indicates lowness. Now, the suggestive (<s>vyañjaka</s>): that which conveys a deeper meaning. As: 'Know my heart's desire well;

children.text: रथ जानहु नीके । बसहु सदाउरपुर सबहीके।।टी० उरपुरतें सबके हृदयसों
children.translated_text: May you always dwell in the city of the heart of all.' Commentary: From 'city of the heart' (<s>urapura</s>) — 'in everyone's heart' —

children.text: हमारी ऐसी मति देहु । अथ अभिधालक्षण बहुत अर्यके शब्दमों योगादिक
children.translated_text: 'Grant us such understanding.' Now, the definition of <s>abhidhā</s> (denotation): From a word with many meanings, through context (<s>yoga</s>) and the like,

children.text: तें एक अर्थ प्रतीतिहोय यथा काक पक्ष शिरतें जुलुफमाथ को अरु भाल
children.translated_text: one meaning is understood. As: '<s>kākapakṣa</s>' (crow-feather) from the head means a lock of hair on the forehead; and

children.text: तिलकसे ललाटको अथ लक्षणालक्षण मुख्यार्थ स्यागि और अर्थ करे सो
children.translated_text: '<s>tilaka</s>' (forehead mark) on the forehead means the forehead itself. Now, the definition of <s>lakṣaṇā</s> (indication): abandoning the primary meaning and making another meaning — it is

children.text: द्वैप्रकार एकानरूढ़ी ध्वनिरहित यथा रामगवन मंडपतबकीन्हा टी० मं-
children.translated_text: of two types: one is <s>rūḍhi</s> (conventional), devoid of suggestion. As: '<s>Rāma</s> had a pavilion (<s>maṇḍapa</s>) built for the departure.' Commentary: '<s>Maṇḍapa</s>'

children.text: डपरूढ़ि अथ योगरूढ़ि यथा पंकजकोकलोक सुख दाता टी० पकज योग
children.translated_text: is conventional (<s>rūḍhi</s>). Now, <s>yogarūḍhi</s> (etymologically conventional): As: '<s>Paṅkaja</s>' (lotus, lit. 'mud-born'), the sun that gives happiness to the world.' Commentary: '<s>Paṅkaja</s>' is <s>yogarūḍhi</s>.

children.text: रूढ़िहै अथयौगिकयथा जापकजनप्रहलाद जिमिपालहि दलसुरसाल ।।
children.translated_text: Now, <s>yaugika</s> (etymological): As: '<s>Jāpaka</s> (one who recites) — he protected the people like <s>Prahlāda</s>, crushing the army of demons.'

children.text: जापक यौगिकलक्षणा निरूढ़िरूढ़ैमों होतहै अथ पूजै प्रयोजनवती यामें
children.translated_text: <s>Jāpaka</s> is etymological (<s>yaugika</s>). <s>Lakṣaṇā</s> occurs in <s>nirūḍhi</s> (non-conventional) and <s>rūḍhi</s> (conventional) [forms]. Now, further, <s>prayojanavtī</s> (purposeful [indication]), in which

children.text: धुनि होय यथा ब्याकुल नगर दोखि तब आयेउ बालिकुमार टी० नगरते
children.translated_text: <s>dhvani</s> (suggestion) is present. As: 'Seeing the city distraught, then <s>Bāli</s>'s son (<s>Aṅgada</s>) arrived.' Commentary: From 'city' (<s>nagara</s>),

children.text: नगरबासीसो प्रयोजनवतीछःप्रकारकी प्रथमउपादान परगुण लीन्हे यथा
children.translated_text: [the indication is] 'the city-dwellers' — this is <s>prayojanavatī</s>. It is of six kinds. First, <s>upādāna</s> (material): taking another's quality. As:

children.text: तब चले बाण कराल टी० चलावनहारको गुणलीन्हो अथ लक्षित २ जिन
children.translated_text: 'Then the terrible arrows flew.' Commentary: The quality of the one who releases is attributed [to the arrows]. Now, <s>lakṣita</s> 2: where the indication points elsewhere. As:

children.text: लक्षण औरैदेई यथा बीचबासकरि यमुनहिं आये टी० यमुनाते यमुनातट
children.translated_text: 'Making their way through the middle, they came to the <s>Yamunā</s>.' Commentary: From '<s>Yamunā</s>', [the indication is] 'the bank of the <s>Yamunā</s>.'

children.text: अथ सारोपा और थापिये और को यथा चिंता सांपिनि को नहिं खायाटी०
children.translated_text: Now, <s>sāropā</s> (superimposition): one thing is placed upon another. As: 'The serpentess of worry has not eaten [him].' Commentary:

children.text: चिंताको सांपिनि में आरोप अथ साध्य वसाना ४ उपमान तें उपमेयको
children.translated_text: Worry is superimposed upon a serpentess. Now, <s>sādhyavasānā</s> 4: knowledge of the <s>upameya</s> (object of comparison) from the <s>upamāna</s> (standard of comparison).

children.text: बोध यथा मुकरमलिन अरु नयन बिहीना टी० मुकुरमन नयन ज्ञान वै-
children.translated_text: As: 'A mirror that is dirty and without eyes.' Commentary: Mirror [stands for] mind, eyes [for] knowledge and

children.text: राग्य अथ गौणी सारोपा ५ गुण लखि आरोपतें यथा रामचन्द्र मुखचन्द्र
children.translated_text: dispassion. Now, <s>gauṇī sāropā</s> 5: superimposition based on perceived quality. As: '<s>Rāmacandra</s> — the moon-face's

children.text: छबि लोचन चारु चकोर टी० मुखचन्द्रके आरोपतें सारोपा अरु चन्द्रमा
children.translated_text: beauty, and the eyes are lovely <s>cakora</s> (partridge) birds.' Commentary: From the superimposition of the moon on the face — that is <s>sāropā</s>; and from

children.text: के प्रकाशत्व गुणते गौनी अथ गौणी साध्यवसाना ६ केवल उपमान यथा
children.translated_text: the quality of luminosity of the moon — that is <s>gauṇī</s>. Now, <s>gauṇī sādhyavasānā</s> 6: only the standard of comparison [is stated]. As:

children.text: अरुणपराग जलज भरि नीके टी० अरुणपराग सिंदूर जलज हाथ अथ
children.translated_text: 'Filled well with red pollen and lotuses.' Commentary: Red pollen [stands for] vermilion; lotuses [for] hands. Now,

children.text: व्यंजना जो शब्द अर्थतें अधिक अर्थ व्यंगमें सो द्वैभांति की शाब्दी १ आ-
children.translated_text: <s>vyañjanā</s> (suggestion): where from the word-meaning, a deeper meaning is suggested. It is of two kinds: <s>śābdī</s> (verbal) 1,

children.text: र्थीसो शाब्दी २ अभिधामूल ३ लक्षणामूल २ अथ अभिधामूल व्यंग
children.translated_text: <s>ārthī</s> (meaning-based) 2. <s>Śābdī</s> [is of two kinds]: <s>abhidhā-mūla</s> (denotation-based) 1, <s>lakṣaṇā-mūla</s> (indication-based) 2. Now, <s>abhidhā-mūla vyaṅgya</s> (denotation-based suggestion):

children.text: बहुत अर्थके शब्दमो एककी प्रतीति सों संयोग २ प्रसंग ३ विरोध ४ देश५
children.translated_text: From a word with many meanings, through the understanding of one [meaning], by conjunction 2, context 3, contradiction 4, place 5,

children.text: समय इत्यादितें अरु लक्षणाको फल लक्षणामूल व्यंगमों अथ संयोगतें
children.translated_text: time, and the like; and the fruit of <s>lakṣaṇā</s> [is] in <s>lakṣaṇā-mūla vyaṅgya</s>. Now, from conjunction:

children.text: यथा जनकपाट महिषी जगजानी टी० महिषी अनेकार्थ जनक अयोग तें
children.translated_text: As: '<s>Janaka</s>'s queen, known throughout the world.' Commentary: '<s>Mahiṣī</s>' has many meanings; from conjunction with '<s>Janaka</s>',

children.text: रानी १ बियोगतें यथा कहेउ राम वियोग तब सीता टी० सीता अनेकार्थ
children.translated_text: [it means] queen 1. From separation: As: 'Then <s>Sītā</s> spoke of <s>Rāma</s>'s separation.' Commentary: '<s>Sītā</s>' has many meanings; from

children.text: राम बियोगते जानकी २ प्रसंगतें यथा हरिहित सहि व राम जब जोहे टी०
children.translated_text: separation from <s>Rāma</s>, [it means] <s>Jānakī</s> 2. From context: As: 'When <s>Rāma</s> looked for <s>Hari</s>'s good.' Commentary:

children.text: हरि अनेकार्थ प्रसंगतें बाजी ३ विरोध ते यथा मत्तनाग तम कुम्भ बिदारी।
children.translated_text: '<s>Hari</s>' has many meanings; from context, [it means] horse 3. From contradiction: As: 'The intoxicated elephant tore open the darkness-pot;

children.text: शशि केशरी गगन वनचारी।।टी० सिंह विरोधतें हाथी ४ देशतें यथा जीवन
children.translated_text: the moon-lion roams in the sky-forest.' Commentary: From contradiction with 'lion,' [it means] elephant 4. From place: As: 'Like <s>Kāśī</s>, the cause of liberation in life.'

children.text: मुक्तिहेतु जनुकाशी टी० मुक्ति अनेकार्थ काशीदेशते मोक्ष ५ समयते यथा
children.translated_text: Commentary: '<s>Mukti</s>' has many meanings; from the place <s>Kāśī</s>, [it means] <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation) 5. From time: As:

children.text: चकई सांझसमय जनुमोही टी० चकई अनेक सांझसमयते चकवाकी ६
children.translated_text: 'Like me at evening time, the <s>cakavī</s> (ruddy sheldrake).' Commentary: '<s>Cakavī</s>' has many meanings; from evening time, [it means] the female <s>cakravāka</s> bird 6.

children.text: साहचर्थते यथा यहिविधि आइविलोकी बेनी।सुमिरत सकलसुमंगलदेनी।।
children.translated_text: From association: As: 'Coming thus, she beheld the <s>Veṇī</s> (confluence). Remembering, it bestows all auspiciousness.'

children.text: टी० बेनी अनेकार्थ सुमिरत मंगल देनी साहचर्यते तीरथ बेनी ७ उचितते
children.translated_text: Commentary: '<s>Veṇī</s>' has many meanings; from association with 'bestowing auspiciousness upon remembrance,' [it means] the sacred confluence (<s>tīrtha veṇī</s>) 7. From propriety:

children.text: यथा थनपय श्रवहिं नयनजलछाये टी० पय अनेकार्थ थन उचिततेंदूध ८
children.translated_text: As: 'Milk flowed from the breasts, tears shadowed the eyes.' Commentary: '<s>Paya</s>' has many meanings; from propriety with breasts, [it means] milk 8.

children.text: सामर्थ्यते यथा तनमहँप्रविशि निसरिशरजाहीं टी० अनेकार्थ प्रविशिनि-
children.translated_text: From capability: As: 'Entering and exiting the body, the arrows go.' Commentary: [The word] has many meanings; from the capability of entering

children.text: सरिसामर्थ्यते बान ९ चिन्हते यथा कामकुसुम धनुशायक लीन्हे टी०
children.translated_text: and exiting, [it means] arrow 9. From sign: As: '<s>Kāma</s> (Love) took the flower-bow and arrow.' Commentary:

children.text: काम अनेकार्थ कुसुम धनु चिह्न ते मन्मथ १० अथ लक्षणा मूल द्वै
children.translated_text: '<s>Kāma</s>' has many meanings; from the sign of the flower-bow, [it means] <s>Manmatha</s> (the Love-god) 10. Now, <s>lakṣaṇā-mūla</s> (indication-based [suggestion]) is of two

children.text: भांनि एक छिप्योगूढब्यंन यथा तुमरहिं भाग राम बनजाहीं टी० तुम्हरे
children.translated_text: kinds: one is hidden (<s>gūḍha-vyaṅgya</s>). As: 'It is your fortune that <s>Rāma</s> goes to the forest.' Commentary: From 'yours' (<s>tumhāre</s>),

children.text: पदतें गौर द्विभुज ताको मुख्यार्थ बाधशेषमों लक्षणाभार उतारबो व्यंग
children.translated_text: [one understands] the fair, two-armed [form] — the obstruction of that primary meaning, and the burden of <s>lakṣaṇā</s> being cast off in the remainder — that is hidden suggestion.

children.text: गूढ़ दूसरो प्रभट व्यंग यथा रघुवंशिनकर सहज सुभाऊ टी० रघुवंशिनकी
children.translated_text: The second is manifest suggestion (<s>prakaṭa-vyaṅgya</s>). As: 'The natural disposition of the descendants of <s>Raghu</s>.' Commentary: The greatness of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty

children.text: बड़ाई प्रगटै व्यंग है यातें अगूढ़ अथ तीनों शब्दतें ब्यंगबाचकते यथा वर
children.translated_text: is manifestly suggested — hence it is not hidden (<s>agūḍha</s>). Now, from all three words, suggestion: from the denotative, as: 'The bridegroom's

children.text: अनुहार बरातन भाई टी० बरकी क्रुद्रूपता बरातिनकी सुन्दरता ब्यंम १
children.translated_text: appearance [matches] the wedding party's, O brother!' Commentary: The ugly appearance of the groom, the beauty of the wedding party — that is the suggestion 1.

children.text: लक्षकते यथा कह अंगद सलज्ज मनमाहीं टी० सलज्जतें निर्लज्जता
children.translated_text: From the indicative, as: '<s>Aṅgada</s> said, with shame in his mind.' Commentary: From 'with shame' [is suggested] shamelessness —

children.text: व्यंग २ व्यंजकते यथा सेवत तोहिं सुलभ फलचारी टी० देवीकी स्तुति
children.translated_text: that is the suggestion 2. From the suggestive, as: 'Serving you, the fruits are easily obtained.' Commentary: In the praise of the Goddess,

children.text: में कृपाकराइबो ब्यंग आपनो कार्य्य साधनो दूजो व्यंग इति शाब्दी अथ
children.translated_text: the suggestion is to obtain her grace; the second suggestion is accomplishing one's own purpose. Thus ends verbal suggestion (<s>śābdī</s>). Now,

children.text: अर्थ व्यंजक व्यंजकते जो अर्य अधिकहोइ ताको भेद वक्ताबोध व्यादि
children.translated_text: meaning-based suggestion (<s>artha-vyañjaka</s>): where the meaning exceeds [the literal] — its divisions include the speaker's understanding and the like.

children.text: वक्ता यथा कतसिखदेइ हमहिं कोइमाई टी० बक्तामंथरा वचनतें राम
children.translated_text: The speaker: As: 'Who is the mother who instructs us thus?' Commentary: The speaker is <s>Mantharā</s>; from her words, the act of

children.text: राज नाश करिबो क्रिया छपावतिहै बोधव्यते यथा पुनि आउब यहिबेरि
children.translated_text: destroying <s>Rāma</s>'s kingship is concealed. From the thing to be understood: As: 'I shall come again at this time

children.text: आकाली टी० आउब जानकी पयबोधव्य २ व्यंगहै काकु यथा बालमरा-
children.translated_text: when <s>Ākālī</s>.' Commentary: 'I shall come' — the thing to be understood is <s>Jānakī</s>'s feet 2. The suggestion is <s>kāku</s> (intonation). As: 'Look! The boy is dead;

children.text: लकि मन्दरलेहीं टी० काकु प्रगटै है अरु वाक्य विशिष्ट प्रस्ताव विशिष्ट
children.translated_text: take the <s>Mandara</s> [mountain]!' Commentary: <s>Kāku</s> (ironic intonation) is manifest here. And there are many more: sentence-specific, context-specific,

children.text: अन्य सन्निधि देश समय चेष्टा इत्यादि बहुत हैं हति ब्यंग अथध्वनि
children.translated_text: proximity of another [word], place, time, gesture, and the like — these are many suggestions. Now, <s>dhvani</s> (resonance):

children.text: मूललक्षणा मूढ़ब्यंग प्रधान होय सो ध्वांने है द्वै भांति अविवक्षित १
children.translated_text: when the suggestion rooted in <s>lakṣaṇā</s> and hidden suggestion become predominant, that is <s>dhvani</s> (resonance). It is of two kinds: <s>avivakṣita</s> (unintended [literal meaning]) 1

children.text: विवक्षित २ अथ अविवक्षित कह वैयानचा है आपुहि तें ध्वनि होय यथा
children.translated_text: The second is <s>vivakṣita</s> (intended). Now, <s>avivakṣita</s> (unintended) is explained: its characteristic is that <s>dhvani</s> (suggestion) arises spontaneously, as for example:

children.text: कहहि सुसेवक बारहिंबारा अरु सब सेवक गणगरहिं गलानी टी०
children.translated_text: "The good servants say again and again, and all the servants feel remorse in their hearts." Commentary:

children.text: गलानि अविवक्षित बाक्यहै । अविवक्षितमों भेद द्वै एक अर्थंतर संक्रमत
children.translated_text: The expression of remorse is an <s>avivakṣita vākya</s> (unintended statement). In <s>avivakṣita</s>, there are two subdivisions: the first is <s>arthāntara-saṅkramita</s> (transferred to another meaning),

children.text: वाच्य ध्वनि जो अर्य औरसे मिलके रहैं यथा जन युग जामिक प्रजाप्राण
children.translated_text: <s>vācya dhvani</s> (denotative suggestion), where one meaning merges with another, as for example: "The life-breath of the people for ages" —

children.text: के टी० एक प्रजाप्राण भरतहू जो रकार मकारहू जो अत्यंत तिरस्कृत
children.translated_text: Commentary: <s>Bharata</s> alone is the life-breath of the people; even the letters 'ra' and 'ma' are utterly condemned —

children.text: वाच्यध्वनि व्यंगकी अधिकाई कहिबे को वाचक अपनो अर्थ छोड़्यो यथा
children.translated_text: <s>vācya dhvani</s>: to express the predominance of the suggested meaning, the denoting word abandons its own meaning, as for example:

children.text: कुन्द कली दाड़िम दामिनि । इन्होंसे अरु हर्षे सकल पाइ जनुराजू दी०
children.translated_text: "<s>Kunda</s> (jasmine) buds, pomegranate blossoms, lightning — from all these, all rejoiced as if kingship were bestowed." Commentary:

children.text: हरष ह्वैबो असंभव वाचक ने अपनो अर्थ छोड़्यौ अरु तिहारे वैरिन को
children.translated_text: Rejoicing is impossible [for inanimate objects]; the denoting word has abandoned its own meaning, and [the suggested meaning is:] "The joy of your enemies was unbearable to us."

children.text: हर्ष हमतें नाहीं सह्यो जातु यह ध्वनि इति लक्षणामूल ध्वनि अथ अभि-
children.translated_text: This is the <s>dhvani</s> [of that type]. Thus ends <s>lakṣaṇā-mūla dhvani</s> (suggestion based on secondary signification). Now, <s>abhi-</s>

children.text: धायमूल ध्वनि विवक्षित जामों इच्छित अर्थ ध्वनितहोय यथा बहुरि
children.translated_text: <s>dhā-mūla dhvani</s> (suggestion based on primary denotation): <s>vivakṣita</s> is that in which the intended meaning is suggested, as for example: "Again,

children.text: गौरिकर ध्यान करेहू विवक्षितमों भेदद्वै असंलक्ष क्रम १ संलक्ष क्रम २
children.translated_text: meditate upon the hand of <s>Gaurī</s>." In <s>vivakṣita</s>, there are two subdivisions: <s>asaṃlakṣya-krama</s> (imperceptible sequence) (1) and <s>saṃlakṣya-krama</s> (perceptible sequence) (2).

children.text: अमलक्ष ध्वनि में रसभावादिक अनेकप्रकार अरु संलक्षमों भेद तीन
children.translated_text: In <s>asaṃlakṣya dhvani</s>, there are many varieties such as <s>rasa</s>, <s>bhāva</s>, etc. And in <s>saṃlakṣya</s>, there are three subdivisions:

children.text: शब्द शक्ति अर्थ शक्ति २ शब्दार्थ शक्ति ३ यथा इहां कुम्हड़ बतिया कोउ
children.translated_text: <s>śabda-śakti</s> (word-power) (1), <s>artha-śakti</s> (meaning-power) (2), <s>śabdārtha-śakti</s> (word-and-meaning-power) (3). As for example: "Here there are no pumpkins or gourds,

children.text: नाहीं । जो तरजनि देखतमरिजाहीं टी० इहां व्यंग सबबिनासहाय जानो
children.translated_text: nor anyone who would die upon seeing a pointed finger." Commentary: Here the suggested meaning is understood without any support;

children.text: जातुद्वै अरु क्रमनाहीं यातें असंलक्षक्रम अरु अलंकार जहां और परमधाम
children.translated_text: there are two [elements] and no sequence, hence it is <s>asaṃlakṣya-krama</s>. And <s>alaṅkāra</s> (figure of speech): where something else is the supreme goal

children.text: होय अह रसमुख्य होयतो रसवत् अलंकार और जहां भाव अंग होइ
children.translated_text: and <s>rasa</s> is predominant, it is the <s>rasavat</s> (rasa-possessing) <s>alaṅkāra</s>. And where <s>bhāva</s> (emotion) is a subordinate element

children.text: मुख्य और होयतही प्रोषित अलंकार अरु जहां भाव अंग होय मख्य और
children.translated_text: and something else is predominant, that is the <s>proṣita</s> (absent) <s>alaṅkāra</s>. And where <s>bhāva</s> is a subordinate element and something else is predominant,

children.text: होय तहां उर जस अलंकार अरु जहां भाव शांतिकादिक अंग होय मुख्य
children.translated_text: there it is the <s>ūrjasvi</s> (vigorous) <s>alaṅkāra</s>. And where <s>bhāva</s> of the <s>śāntika</s> (pacifying) type and others are subordinate and something else is predominant,

children.text: और होय तहां समाहित अलंकार रसन कहिये जानै रस ध्वनिहै येगुनी
children.translated_text: there it is the <s>samāhita</s> (composed) <s>alaṅkāra</s>. Know that <s>rasa</s> is <s>dhvani</s>; these are <s>guṇī-</s>

children.text: भूत व्यंगहै सो मध्यम के प्रसंगमों उदाहरण कहैंगे अब रसको स्वरूप
children.translated_text: <s>bhūta vyaṅgya</s> (subordinated suggested meaning), which belongs to the middle [category]. Examples will be given in that context. Now the nature of <s>rasa</s>

children.text: कहत हैं रसको मूलभाव है तातें प्रथमहि भावको लक्षण कहियतु है
children.translated_text: is being described. The foundation of <s>rasa</s> is <s>bhāva</s> (emotional state); therefore, first the definition of <s>bhāva</s> is stated.

children.text: भावतबतें बड़ोहै बासना रूप जानिये सो चारप्रकार विभाव१अनुभाव २
children.translated_text: <s>Bhāva</s> is greater than that; know it as being of the nature of <s>vāsanā</s> (latent impression). It is of four kinds: <s>vibhāva</s> (determinant) (1), <s>anubhāva</s> (consequent) (2),

children.text: संचारी३अस्थायी४ अरुभाव भेदसों सात्विक भाव जोहै सो अनुभावही
children.translated_text: <s>sañcārī</s> (transitory emotion) (3), and <s>sthāyī</s> (permanent emotion) (4). And among the subdivisions of <s>bhāva</s>, the <s>sāttvika bhāva</s> (involuntary emotion)

children.text: मों गनिये अथ विभाव लक्षण जातें अस्थायीभाव होइ सो विभाव १ अथ
children.translated_text: should be counted under <s>anubhāva</s> itself. Now the definition of <s>vibhāva</s>: that from which the <s>sthāyī bhāva</s> (permanent emotion) arises is <s>vibhāva</s> (1). Now,

children.text: अनुभाव लक्षण थिरभाव कोप्रगटै जोसो अनुभाव अरुसंचारीलै सबरत
children.translated_text: the definition of <s>anubhāva</s>: that which manifests the <s>sthira bhāva</s> (stable emotion) is <s>anubhāva</s>. And <s>sañcārī</s>: that which moves through all <s>rasas</s>.

children.text: में संचरे सो विभाव द्वैभांति आलंबन १ जो थिरभावको स्थान यथा
children.translated_text: <s>Vibhāva</s> is of two kinds: <s>ālambana</s> (foundational) (1), which is the locus of the <s>sthāyī bhāva</s>, as for example:

children.text: सीतहिं पहिराये प्रभुसादर ।। दूसरो उद्दपिन सुधिआयेतें सोद्वैभांति दैवी

children.translated_text: anger arises — these are the <s>vibhāvas</s>. Crooked glances, reddened eyes, quivering lips — these are the <s>anubhāvas</s>. Pride,

children.text: चपलता इत्यादि संचारी रुद्रदेवता अरुणरंग यथा जो शत शंकर करहिं
children.translated_text: fickleness, and so forth are the <s>sañcārīs</s>. The deity is <s>Rudra</s>, the color is red. As for example: "Even if a hundred <s>Śaṅkaras</s> come to his aid,

children.text: सहाई । तदपि हतब रघुबीर दोहाई ।। टीइहां ईद्रजीत बिभाव भुजादि
children.translated_text: still I shall slay him, by the glory of <s>Raghuvīra</s>!" Commentary: Here <s>Indrajīt</s> is the <s>vibhāva</s>; the quivering of arms and such is the <s>anubhāva</s>; pride and such are the <s>sañcārīs</s>; anger is the <s>sthāyī</s> — therefore it is <s>Raudra</s>. Now <s>Vīra rasa</s> (the heroic sentiment) (5): the <s>sthāyī</s>

children.text: फरकन अनुभाव गर्वसंचादि क्रोधथायी तातें रौद्र अथ बीररस ५ थायी
children.translated_text: is <s>utsāha</s> (enthusiasm). It is of four kinds: <s>yuddha</s> (battle) (1), <s>dāna</s> (generosity) (2), <s>dayā</s> (compassion) (3), and <s>dharma</s> (righteousness) (4). The enemy's strength and battle

children.text: उत्साह सो चार प्रकार युद्ध १ दान २दया ३ धर्म्म ४ शत्रुका बल समर
children.translated_text: are the <s>vibhāvas</s>. And those who live fiercely — fierce words, reddened face, expanded limbs are the

children.text: ये बिभाव अरु जो उग्रजीवहैं वचन उग्रबदन लाल अंग प्रफुल्लित अनु
children.translated_text: <s>anubhāvas</s>. Pride, ferocity, and envy are the <s>sañcārīs</s>. The deity is <s>Indra</s>, the color is yellow. Up to the point of equanimity,

children.text: भाव गर्व उग्रता असूया संचारी इंद्र देवता पीत रंग समताकी सुधिलौ
children.translated_text: it is <s>Vīra</s>; when equanimity is lost, it becomes <s>Raudra</s> — this is the distinction between them. As for example, <s>Yuddha-vīra</s> (heroism in battle): "Saying this much,

children.text: बीर समसुध भूलेतें रौद्र इनमोभेद हतनो यथा युद्ध बीर इतना कहत
children.translated_text: he forgot the sentiment of propriety; the tree of <s>raṇa-rasa</s> (battle-sentiment) sprouted forth with horripilation as its blossoms." <s>Dāna-vīra</s> (heroism in generosity): "Whatever wealth <s>Śiva</s>

children.text: नीति रस भूला।रनरस बिटप पुलक मिसकूला।।दान बीर जोसंपतिशिव
children.translated_text: gave to <s>Rāvaṇa</s>, the ten-headed one gave; that same wealth <s>Raghu-</s>

children.text: रावणहि दीन्ह दिये दशमाथ ।। सोई संपदा बिभीषणहिं सकुचि दीन्ह
children.translated_text: <s>nātha</s> gave to <s>Vibhīṣaṇa</s> with modesty." <s>Dayā-vīra</s> (heroism in compassion): seeing another's suffering is the <s>vibhāva</s>; removing it is the <s>anubhāva</s>;

children.text: रघुनाथ।।दयाबीर और को दुःख देखि बिभाव वाको दूर करिबो अनुभाव
children.translated_text: pride and fortitude are the <s>sañcārīs</s>. As for example: "Hearing of his servant's suffering, the compassionate Lord —

children.text: गर्व धीरज संचारी यथा सुनि सेवक दुख दीन दयाला । फरकि उठी
children.translated_text: both his mighty arms quivered." <s>Dharma-vīra</s> (heroism in righteousness), as for example: "<s>Śibi</s>, <s>Dadhīci</s>, <s>Bali</s> — whatever they promised,

children.text: द्वैभुजा बिशाला ।। धर्मबीर यथा शिविदधीचि बलि जो कछुभाखा ।
children.translated_text: they sacrificed body and wealth to keep their word." Now <s>Bhayānaka rasa</s> (the terrible sentiment) (6): fear is the <s>vibhāva</s>; trembling, horripilation,

children.text: तन धन तजेउ वचनप्रणराखा।।अथ भयानकरस६भय विभाव कंपरोमांच
children.translated_text: and perspiration are the <s>anubhāvas</s>; delusion, fainting, and wretchedness are the <s>sañcārī bhāvas</s>. The deity is <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the color is white.

children.text: प्रस्वेद अनुभाव मोह मूर्च्छा दीनता संचारीभाव बिष्णु देवता श्वेतरंग
children.translated_text: As for example: "He became frightened hearing the words reach his ears." Now <s>Vībhatsa rasa</s> (the odious sentiment) (7): <s>glāni</s> (disgust) is the <s>bhāva</s>;

children.text: यथा डरपेगधि बचन सुनि काना । अथ वीभत्स रस ७ ग्लानि नि भाव
children.translated_text: seeing something forbidden or base is the <s>anubhāva</s>; condemning, trembling, distress, and envy

children.text: निषिद्ध कादर्यको दीखबो अनुभाव निंदा करिबो रोम कंप दुःख आसूया
children.translated_text: are the <s>sañcārīs</s>. The deity is <s>Mahākāla</s>, the color is blue. As for example: "Ghosts, <s>piśācas</s>, and <s>vetālas</s> are immersed; and

children.text: संचारि महाकाल देवता नीलरंग यथा मज्जहिं भूत पिशाच वेताला अरु
children.translated_text: as if <s>vaṃśī</s> (flute) players were playing upon the funeral pyres" — up to this point. Now <s>Adbhuta rasa</s> (the marvelous sentiment) (8): seeing something wondrous — the teacher sees the

children.text: जनुवंशी खेलहि चितदये इहांतक अथ अद्भुत रस ८ आचार्य दोखि अन-
children.translated_text: impossible — is the <s>vibhāva</s>; stammering words, trembling, and horripilation are the <s>anubhāvas</s>; joy, fear, and delusion are the <s>sañcārīs</s>. The deity is <s>Brahmā</s>,

children.text: होनी विभाव बचन कंपरोमांच अनुभाव हर्ष डरमोह संचारी ब्रह्म देवता
children.translated_text: the color is yellow. As for example: "He showed His mother His wondrous form —

children.text: पीतरंग यथा देखरावा मातहि निज अद्भुतरूप । अखंड रोम रोम प्रति
children.translated_text: infinite, in every pore of His body were contained millions upon millions of universes." Now <s>Śānta rasa</s> (the peaceful sentiment) (9): assemblies of <s>siddhas</s> (perfected beings), groves of asceticism, narratives of

children.text: लागे कोटि कोटि ब्रह्मंड अथ शांतरस ९ सिद्धनकी मंडली तपोबन कथा
children.translated_text: the worthlessness of the world — these are the <s>vibhāvas</s>; equanimity and knowledge are the <s>anubhāvas</s>; fortitude and joy are the <s>sañcārīs</s>. The deity is <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: संसार तुच्छयेविभाव समताज्ञान अनुभाव धीर्यहर्ष संचारी बिष्णुदेवता
children.translated_text: the color is white. As for example: "Abandon all [other supports] and worship <s>Rāma</s>;

children.text: श्वेतरंग यथा परिहर सकल भरोत रामहिं भजहिं ते चतुरनर औरहूं
children.translated_text: those who do so are the wisest of people." Furthermore, three more <s>rasas</s> are enumerated: <s>Dāsya</s> (servitude) (1), <s>Sakhya</s> (friendship) (2), and <s>Vātsalya</s> (parental affection) (3). <s>Dāsya</s>, as for example: "Serving the lotus feet

children.text: तीन रस गनायेहैं दास्य १ सख्य २ बात्सल्य ३ दास्य यथा चरण कमल
children.translated_text: in various ways ordained by Providence." <s>Sakhya</s>, as for example: "O friend, you have considered the right course well." <s>Vātsalya</s>, as for example:

children.text: चापत विधिनाना सख्य यथा सखानीति तुम नीक विचारी बात्सल्य यथा
children.translated_text: "Dear brother, tell me — are the two boys well?" Now, the generation of <s>rasa</s> from <s>rasa</s>: from <s>Śṛṅgāra</s> arises <s>Hāsya</s>;

children.text: भइया कहहु कुशल दोउ बारे अथ रसनतें रस उत्पत्ति शृंगारतें हास्य
children.translated_text: from <s>Karuṇā</s> arises <s>Raudra</s>; from <s>Vīra</s> arises <s>Adbhuta</s>; from <s>Vībhatsa</s> arises <s>Bhaya</s>. Now, the enemies and friends [among the <s>rasas</s>]: the enemy of <s>Śṛṅgāra</s> is

children.text: करुणातें रौद्रबीरतें अद्भुत विभत्सते भय अथ शत्रु मित्र शृंगाररिपुर वी-
children.translated_text: <s>Vībhatsa</s>; the enemy of <s>Vīra</s> is <s>Bhaya</s>; the enemy of <s>Adbhuta</s> is <s>Raudra</s>; the enemy of <s>Karuṇā</s> is <s>Hāsya</s>. And the opposite

children.text: भत्सबीर रिपुभय अद्भुत रिपुरौद्र करुणा रिपु हस्य अरु इनहीके विपरीत
children.translated_text: of these gives friendship. Thus ends <s>rasa dhvani</s>. Now <s>bhāva dhvani</s> (suggestion through emotional states): the transitory emotions suggest the <s>devarāja</s>

children.text: तें मित्रता जानो इतिरस ध्वनि अथ भावध्वनि संचारीतें व्यंग देवराज
children.translated_text: <s>rati</s> (love of the divine king); where these have predominance, there is <s>bhāva dhvani</s>. Now <s>sañcārī bhāva dhvani</s> (suggestion through transitory emotions),

children.text: रत इनकी जहां प्रधानता होय तहां भावध्वनि अथ संचारी भ्रावध्वनि
children.translated_text: as for example: "Dense clouds thunder terribly in the sky;

children.text: यथा घनघमण्ड नभ गर्जत घोरा । प्रियाहीन डरपत मनमोरा ।। अथदेव
children.translated_text: without my beloved, my heart trembles with fear." Now <s>deva-rati</s> (devotion to God), as for example: "I bow to the son of <s>Pavana</s> (the Wind God), fire to the forest of the wicked, cloud of <s>jñāna</s> (knowledge)." Now <s>rāja-rati</s> (royal devotion), as for example:

children.text: रति यथा प्रणवौं पवनकुमार खल बनपावक ज्ञान घन अथ राजरतियथा
children.translated_text: "Hear, O crown-jewel among kings — none is as fortunate as you.

children.text: सुनहु महीपति मुकुट मणि तुम समधन्यन कोउ।राम लषण जाकेतनय
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s> and <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, who are your sons, are the ornaments of the entire world." And similarly, a sage's affection for his son is also <s>bhāva dhvani</s>. Now <s>rasā-</s>

children.text: बिश्व विभूषण दोउ ।। अरु ऐलही मुनि पुत्र स्नेहतें भावध्वनि अथ रसा-
children.translated_text: <s>bhāsa</s> (semblance of <s>rasa</s>) and <s>bhāvābhāsa</s> (semblance of <s>bhāva</s>): when <s>rasa</s> is improper, it is <s>rasābhāsa</s>; and when <s>bhāva</s> is improper, it is <s>bhāvābhāsa</s>.

children.text: भास भावाभासरस अनुचिततें रसाभास अरु भाव अनुचिततें भावाभास
children.translated_text: Now <s>rasābhāsa</s>, as for example: "The Lord sent [<s>Hanumān</s>] to <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> again." Now <s>bhāvābhāsa</s>, as for example:

children.text: अथ रसाभास यथा प्रभु लक्ष्मण पहँ बहुरि पठाई । अथ भासाभास यथा
children.translated_text: "She pondered again and again in her heart: 'How was the lord of <s>Laṅkā</s> slain?'" Commentary: Here

children.text: हृदय बिचारति बारहिंबारा । कवन भांति लंकापति मारा ।। टी० इह
children.translated_text: the anxiety is improper. Now <s>bhāvodaya</s> (emergence of emotion), as for example: "At that time, hearing the news, <s>Sītā</s>

children.text: चिन्ता अनुचितहै अथ भावोदय यथा समाचार तेहि समय सुनि सीय
children.translated_text: rose up agitated, went and bowed at the lotus feet of her mother-in-law, and sat down with head bowed." Commentary: Here

children.text: उठी अकुलाय । जाइ सासु पद कमलयुग वंदि बैठिशिरनाय ।।टी० इहां
children.translated_text: is the emergence of the <s>bhāva</s> of apprehension (<s>śaṅkā</s>). Now <s>bhāva-sandhi</s> (junction of emotions), as for example: "Due to modesty, she could not speak before the elders;

children.text: शँकाभावको उदय अथ भावसंधि यथा सकुचन कहि न सकत गुरुपाहीं ।
children.translated_text: [yet] in her heart was the longing for the sight of her father." Commentary: Here is the junction (<s>sandhi</s>) of <s>lajjā</s> (modesty) and <s>harṣa</s> (joy). Now <s>bhāva-</s>

children.text: पितु दरशन लालच मनमाहीं ।। टी० इहां लाज हर्षकी संधिहै अथभाव
children.translated_text: <s>śabalatā</s> (mixture of emotions): "The composition of the messenger's words was pleasing;

children.text: सबलता दूतबचन रचना प्रियलागी । प्रेम प्रताप बीररसपागी ।। अथभाव
children.translated_text: it was steeped in love, glory, and <s>Vīra rasa</s> (the heroic sentiment)." Now <s>bhāva-</s>

children.text: शान्ति यथा जनक लहेउ सुखशोच बिहार्ह । पैरत थके थाह जनु पाई।।
children.translated_text: <s>śānti</s> (cessation of emotion), as for example: "<s>Janaka</s> found happiness and abandoned grief — as one who, tired of swimming, finds solid ground."

children.text: टी० शंकाभावको शान्तिरस सबठौर प्रधान बड़ोहै अरु कहूं भावो गुरुता
children.translated_text: Commentary: [This illustrates] the cessation of the <s>bhāva</s> of apprehension (<s>śaṅkā</s>). <s>Śānta rasa</s> is predominant and greatest everywhere. And sometimes <s>bhāvas</s> gain weight,

children.text: पावतहै जैसो सेवकके घर स्वामीजाय यथाशम्भु मये कुम्भज ऋषि पाहीं ।
children.translated_text: as when the master goes to the servant's house, as for example: "<s>Śambhu</s> went to the sage <s>Kumbhaja</s> (Agastya)."

children.text: इति असंलक्ष क्रध्वनि।।शब्द अर्थदोऊते झांइसी प्रतीति व्यंग होतु तेहि
children.translated_text: Thus ends <s>asaṃlakṣya-krama dhvani</s>. When from both word and meaning there arises an image-like cognition, the suggested meaning occurs

children.text: साथही जहां क्रम ध्वनिअलंकारवस्तु व्यंग शब्दते शब्दध्वनि अथ शब्दते
children.translated_text: simultaneously. Where the sequence [involves] <s>dhvani</s>, <s>alaṅkāra</s>, and <s>vastu</s> (content) as the suggested [element], from word it is <s>śabda-dhvani</s> (word-suggestion). Now from word —

children.text: अलंकार यथा निशिचर अधम मलाय तन ताहि दीन्हनिजधाम।अरुइहां
children.translated_text: Ornament (<s>alaṅkāra</s>): for example, 'The vile demon — destroying his body, he gave him his own abode.' And here,

children.text: इन शब्दनके अर्थन व्याज स्तुति व्यंगहै यथा धर्महेतु अब तरेहु गोसाईं
children.translated_text: the meanings of these words contain ironic praise (<s>vyāja-stuti</s>) as suggested meaning (<s>vyaṅgya</s>): for example, 'For the sake of <s>dharma</s>, now save yourself, O Lord —

children.text: मारेहु मोहिं व्याधकी नाईं ।। अथ शब्दते विरोध भास व्यंग जहां शब्द
children.translated_text: slay me like a hunter.' Now, where there is apparent contradiction from the words — word-based suggestion (<s>vyaṅgya</s>) — where the word

children.text: सो व्यंव होइ बस्तु सों बस्तु ध्वनि है यथा गुरु विवेकसागर जगजाना ।
children.translated_text: itself is the suggestion, there is thing-to-thing <s>dhvani</s> (resonance): for example, 'The <s>guru</s> (teacher), an ocean of discrimination, renowned in the world —

children.text: तिनहिं विश्व कर बदर समाना ।। टी० गुरु विवेक सागर विश्वकर बदर
children.translated_text: to him, the universe was equal to a berry.' Commentary: '<s>Guru</s>,' 'ocean of discrimination,' 'universe,' 'berry' —

children.text: शब्दनते व्यंग होतुहै कि ऐसो गुरुइनकी का कहिये ये बड़ो हैं यह बस्तु
children.translated_text: from these words, the suggestion arises: such is the <s>guru</s> — what can be said of him? He is great. This is <s>vastu</s> (content).

children.text: अथ अर्थ ध्वनि अर्थ शक्तिते बारह प्रकार स्वतः सम्भवीते वस्तु अलंकार
children.translated_text: Now, meaning-based <s>dhvani</s> — through the power of meaning, twelve types: from the naturally arising (<s>svataḥ-sambhavī</s>), content and ornament,

children.text: चारिप्रकार अरु कविमोहोक्तितें चारि भांति अरु कवि निबद्धतें चारियों
children.translated_text: four types; from the poet's bold expression (<s>kavi-prauḍhokti</s>), four kinds; and from the poet's bound [expression] (<s>kavi-nibaddha</s>), four —

children.text: बारह भेद अथ बस्तु लक्षण ।। सूधो कहना उततें अलंकार न ठहरे ताको
children.translated_text: twelve varieties. Now, the definition of <s>vastu</s> (content): straightforward statement from which no ornament stands — that is called <s>vastu</s>.

children.text: बस्तु कहिये अथ स्वतः सम्भवी लक्षण । ख्यात अर्थते उचित व्यंगहोइ
children.translated_text: Now, the definition of the naturally arising: from a well-known meaning, appropriate suggestion arises.

children.text: अथ स्वतः सम्भवी बस्तुततें बस्तु १ यथा शुरसमर करणीकरहिं कहि न
children.translated_text: Now, naturally arising content from content (Type 1): for example, 'Heroes perform deeds in battle but do not proclaim

children.text: जनावहिं आप । बिद्यमानरण पाइ रिपु कायर करहिं प्रलाप टी० शूरको
children.translated_text: themselves. Finding a ready battlefield, cowards make lamentations.' Commentary: A hero not boasting from his own mouth — that is inherent content; and the exposure of cowardice —

children.text: अपने मुख बड़ाई न करनो स्वतः बस्तु अरु कायरता जनाइबो परशुराम
children.translated_text: that is the second suggestion [regarding] <s>Paraśurāma</s>.

children.text: को दूसरो व्यंग अथ स्वतः सम्भवी बस्तुते अलंकार २ यथा तहां
children.translated_text: Now, naturally arising content yielding ornament (Type 2): for example, 'There,

children.text: राम रघुवंश मणि सुनिय महा महिपाल । भंजेउ चाप प्रयास बिनु
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s>, the jewel of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty — hear, O great king — broke the bow without effort,

children.text: जिमिगज पंकजनाल टी० भजिबो प्रयास बिनु बड़ाई बस्तुतें उत्प्रेक्षा
children.translated_text: as an elephant [breaks] a lotus stalk.' Commentary: Breaking without effort — the greatness is content; from that, <s>utprekṣā</s> (poetic fancy) is the suggestion.

children.text: ब्यंगहै अथ अलंकारतें अलंकार ३ यथा देखा भरत बिशाल अति
children.translated_text: Now, ornament from ornament (Type 3): for example, 'Seeing <s>Bharata</s>, most mighty,

children.text: निशिचर मन अनुमानि । बिनु फरशायक मारेहु चाप श्रवण लगि
children.translated_text: the demons estimated in their minds: he will slay without axe or arrow — [merely] drawing the bowstring to the ear.'

children.text: तानि टी० अनुमानते दूसरो विभावना व्यंग अथ अलंकारत बस्तु
children.translated_text: Commentary: From inference (<s>anumāna</s>), the second suggestion is <s>vibhāvanā</s> (poetic impossibility). Now, ornament yielding content

children.text: ४ यथाचंद किरण रस रसिक चकोरी रविरुख नयनसकै किमि जोरी ।
children.translated_text: (Type 4): for example, 'The <s>cakora</s> bird, lover of moonbeam nectar — how can its eye bear the sun-face?'

children.text: टी० इहां दृष्टान्त अलंकारनें सुकुमारता बस्तु अथकबि प्रौढ़ोक्ति
children.translated_text: Commentary: Here, from the <s>dṛṣṭānta</s> (illustration) ornament, the content of delicacy is suggested. Now, poet's bold expression —

children.text: बस्तुतें बस्तु ५ यथा नवपल्लव फल सुमन सोहाये । निज संपति सुर
children.translated_text: content from content (Type 5): for example, 'New leaves, fruits, and flowers were resplendent — seeing their own wealth,

children.text: रूखलजाये टी० सोहाइबो बस्तु दूसरी बस्तु व्यंगकबिप्रौढ़ोक्ति करसुर
children.translated_text: the divine trees were ashamed.' Commentary: Resplendence is content; the second content-suggestion — through the poet's bold expression, the divine trees' shame.

children.text: रूखको लजाइबो अथ बस्लुतें अलंकार ६ यथा लता भवनते प्रगटभे
children.translated_text: Now, content yielding ornament (Type 6): for example, 'From the bower-house emerged

children.text: जेहि अवसर दोउभाइ । निकसे जनु युगविमल बिधुजलद पटलविल
children.translated_text: at that moment the two brothers — as if two spotless moons came forth from the veil of clouds.'

children.text: गाइ टी० लताते प्रगट होबो बस्तु करि उत्प्रेक्ष्या ब्यंग युगशशि कबि
children.translated_text: Commentary: Emerging from the bower is content; the suggestion of <s>utprekṣā</s> (fancy) — the twin moons — is poet's invention.

children.text: कल्पित अथ अलंकारतें अलंकार ७यथा आश्रम सागर शांतरस पूरणपा
children.translated_text: Now, ornament from ornament (Type 7): for example, 'The hermitage is an ocean; <s>śānta-rasa</s> (the sentiment of peace) is full; the path of wind [is the waves] —

children.text: वनपाथ । सैनमनहुं करुणासरित लियेजात रघुनाथ टी० इहां रूपकतें
children.translated_text: as if the river of compassion were carrying <s>Raghunātha</s> (Lord <s>Rāma</s>) away.' Commentary: Here, from <s>rūpaka</s> (metaphor), the suggestion of <s>utprekṣā</s> (fancy).

children.text: उत्प्रेक्षा लंकार अथ अलंकारते बस्तु ८ यथा नृप भुजबल बिधुशिव धनु
children.translated_text: Now, ornament yielding content (Type 8): for example, 'The king's arm-strength was the moon; <s>Śiva</s>'s bow was <s>Rāhu</s>;

children.text: राहू।।गुरुअकठोर बिदित सबकाहू टी० समतद रूप रूपक करि कठोरता
children.translated_text: heavy and harsh — this is known to all.' Commentary: Through similar-form <s>rūpaka</s> (metaphor), harshness is suggested as content; the moon-<s>Rāhu</s> is poet's invention.

children.text: सूचित कराइबो बस्तु शशिराहु कबि कल्पित अथ कबिनि बद्ध बस्तुते
children.translated_text: Now, poet-bound content from content (Type 9): for example, 'I salute the lotus feet of those —

children.text: बस्तु ९ यथा चरण कमल बंदौं तिन्ह केरे । पूरहु सकल मनोरथ मेरे
children.translated_text: may they fulfill all my desires.'

children.text: टी० बंदना बस्तुते मनोरथ पूरब बस्तु चरण कमल कबि निबद्ध अथ
children.translated_text: Commentary: From the content of salutation, the content of desire-fulfillment [arises]; 'lotus feet' is poet-bound.

children.text: बस्तु ते अलंकार यथा शंभुप्रसाद सुमति हिय हुलसी ।रामचरित मान-
children.translated_text: Now, content yielding ornament (Type 10): for example, 'By the grace of <s>Śambhu</s> (Śiva), with good intellect, the heart rejoiced — <s>Tulasī</s>,

children.text: स कबि तुलसी टी० इहां हुलसबो बस्तु रामचरित्र मानस रूपक ब्यंग
children.translated_text: the poet of the <s>Rāmacaritamānasa</s>.' Commentary: Here, rejoicing is content; '<s>Rāmacaritamānasa</s>' — <s>rūpaka</s> (metaphor) is the suggested ornament.

children.text: अरु अलंकारतें अलंकार ११ यथा अरुण चरण पंकजमय जोती । कमल
children.translated_text: And ornament from ornament (Type 11): for example, 'The reddish luster of the lotus feet — upon the lotus petals,

children.text: दलन्ह बैठे जनु मोती टी० समरूपकते उत्प्रेक्षा ब्यंग अथ अलंकारतें
children.translated_text: as if pearls were seated.' Commentary: From equal-form <s>rūpaka</s>, the suggestion of <s>utprekṣā</s>.

children.text: बस्तु १२ यथा करि मुनि चरण सरोज प्रणामा । आयसुपाइ कीन्ह बि-
children.translated_text: Now, ornament yielding content (Type 12): for example, 'Having bowed to the lotus feet of the sage,

children.text: श्रामा टी० इहां मुनि चरण सरोज समरूपकालंकार आयसुपाइ बिश्राम
children.translated_text: receiving his command, he rested.' Commentary: Here, 'sage's lotus feet' is a <s>rūpaka</s> ornament; 'receiving command and resting' is content.

children.text: करिबो बस्तु अथ शब्दार्थभूल ब्यंग शब्द अर्थ दोउ शक्ति मिल ब्यंग
children.translated_text: Now, word-and-meaning-based suggestion: where both word and meaning powers combine to produce suggestion —

children.text: कढ़ै याहूको न भय शक्तिहूं कह तहैं यथा कबितबिबेक एक नहिं मोरे । सत्य
children.translated_text: there is no fear even from the power [of analysis]. For example, 'I have not even a single poetic skill — truly

children.text: कहौं लिखकागजकोरे टी० इहां शब्दार्थ के चमत्कार तें अपनी नवनता
children.translated_text: I speak, writing on blank paper.' Commentary: Here, from the charm of word and meaning, one's own novelty is the suggestion.

children.text: ब्यंग अरु ध्वनिके ५१ भेद शुद्ध हैं और गनेते बहुत होत हैं सब भेदमों
children.translated_text: And the 51 varieties of <s>dhvani</s> are pure; when enumerated, they become very many. In all varieties,

children.text: संकर संसृष्ट बिस्तर भयानहीं लिख्यो इतिउत्तम काब्य अथ मध्यम
children.translated_text: <s>saṅkara</s> (mixed) and <s>saṃsṛṣṭa</s> (compound) are possible but have not been written in detail. Thus ends superior poetry (<s>uttama kāvya</s>).

children.text: गुनी भूत ब्यंग प्रकार ८ जहां बाच्यके चमत्कारते ब्यंग प्रधान न होइ
children.translated_text: Now, middling poetry: <s>guṇībhūta-vyaṅgya</s> (subordinated suggestion) — eight types. Where from the charm of the literal, suggestion does not become primary:

children.text: अगूढ़ १ अरु अरूपरंगु२ तुल्य प्रधन ३ ।। अस्फूट ४ काकु ५बाच्य सिद्धां-
children.translated_text: <s>agūḍha</s> (unconcealed) (1); <s>arūpa-raṅga</s> (formless color) (2); <s>tulya-pradhāna</s> (equally primary) (3);

children.text: ग ६ संदिग्ध ७ असुन्दर ८ अथ अपरांगको अंगरसवत् अलंकार यथा
children.translated_text: <s>asphūṭa</s> (indistinct) (4); <s>kāku</s> (tone) (5); <s>vācya-siddhāṅga</s> (literal-established limb) (6); <s>saṃdigdha</s> (doubtful) (7); <s>asundara</s> (unbeautiful) (8). Now, as subordinate limbs — <s>rasa</s> (sentiment) adorned with ornament:

children.text: कृपा वारिधर रामखरारी। पाहि पाहि प्रणतार तिहारी टी० इहां वीरको
children.translated_text: for example, 'O ocean of compassion, <s>Rāma</s>, enemy of <s>Khara</s> — save, save [me], a suppliant before you!'

children.text: अंगकरुणा रसहै सो राज रति भाव अंगहै अथ भावको अंगरस यथा श्री
children.translated_text: Commentary: Here, <s>vīra</s> (heroic sentiment) has <s>karuṇā</s> (compassion) as its limb, and that is the subordinate sentiment of <s>rāja-rati</s> (royal love).

children.text: रघुबीर प्रतापतें सिंधुतरे पाषान । तेंमतिमंद जेराम तजि भजहिं जाइ प्रभु
children.translated_text: Now, sentiment as limb of emotion: for example, 'By the prowess of the glorious <s>Raghuvīra</s> (hero of <s>Raghu</s>'s line), even stones crossed the ocean.

children.text: आन टी० इहां देव रति भावको अगं शांति रसहै अथ भाव अंग यथा
children.translated_text: Dull-minded are those who, abandoning <s>Rāma</s>, go and worship another Lord.' Commentary: Here, the emotion of <s>deva-rati</s> (love for God) has <s>śānti-rasa</s> (peace) as its limb.

children.text: आवा कपि लंका जेहि जारी टी० वैरिनको चिंता राज रतिभाव अंगहै
children.translated_text: Now, emotion as limb: for example, 'The monkey who had burned <s>Laṅkā</s> came.' Commentary: The worry of the enemies is the subordinate emotion of <s>rāja-rati</s>.

children.text: अथ रसाभास उरजस अलंकार यथा कबिबल बिपुल सराहन लागा ।।
children.translated_text: Now, <s>rasābhāsa</s> (semblance of sentiment) — as subordinate ornament: for example, 'Poets began to praise his great strength.'

children.text: टी० शत्रुबड़ाई करिबो अनुचित भावसो बरिरस अंगहै अथ भावको अंग
children.translated_text: Commentary: Praising the enemy is an inappropriate sentiment; that inappropriate <s>vīra-rasa</s> (heroic sentiment) is subordinate.

children.text: भास भागेभालु बली मुख यूथाटी०बीरको भागबो अनुचितभावको अंग
children.translated_text: Now, semblance of emotion as limb: 'The bears and powerful monkey chiefs fled' — Commentary: The flight of heroes is an inappropriate emotion; its limb is <s>śānti</s> (peace).

children.text: भाव शान्ति अथ समाहित अलंकार यथा देतचाप आपुहि चढ़ि गयऊ ।
children.translated_text: Now, settled ornament: for example, 'While being given, the bow mounted up by itself;

children.text: परशुराम मन विस्मय भयऊ टी० इहां गर्बकी शान्ति अथ भावको अंग
children.translated_text: <s>Paraśurāma</s>'s mind was filled with wonder.' Commentary: Here, the pacification of pride.

children.text: भाव उदय यथा रावणआवत सुनेउसकोहा । देवन्हतके मेरु गिरिखोहा।।
children.translated_text: Now, emotion as limb — the arising of emotion: for example, '<s>Rāvaṇa</s> is coming, hearing which, <s>Śiva</s> was enraged;

children.text: टी० त्रासको उदय अथ भावको अंग भावसंधि यथा दुहुं समाज हिय
children.translated_text: the gods hid in the caves of Mount <s>Meru</s>.' Commentary: The arising of terror.

children.text: हरष विषादू टी० हर्ष बिषादकी संधिं अथ भावको अंग भाव सबलता
children.translated_text: Now, emotion as limb — junction of emotions: for example, 'In both assemblies, the hearts felt both joy and sorrow.' Commentary: The junction of joy and sorrow.

children.text: यथा चले भाग कपि भालु भवानी । बिकल पुकारत आरत बानी ।। बि-
children.translated_text: Now, emotion as limb — strength of emotion: for example, 'The monkeys and bears fled, O <s>Bhavānī</s>,

children.text: कलता आरत इन भावनको सबलताहै सो राजरतिको अंगहै अरु अर्थ-
children.translated_text: calling out in distressed voices, agitated.' Agitation and distress — these emotions' strength is subordinate to the sentiment of <s>rāja-rati</s>.

children.text: हि देइ बताइ सो बाच्य सिद्धांग व्यंग कहावै यथा असकस कहहु मान
children.translated_text: And one that gives and shows meaning — that is called <s>vācya-siddhāṅga-vyaṅgya</s> (suggestion with literal-established limb): for example, 'Set aside pride, accept with your mind —

children.text: ३० मानसदीपिका रामायण टी० ।।
children.translated_text: <s>Mānasadīpikā Rāmāyaṇa</s> Commentary. 30.

children.text: मनऊना । सुख सुहाग तुम कहँ दिनदूना टी० इहां शब्द शक्ति बरि
children.translated_text: happiness and good fortune for you are doubled day by day.' Commentary: Here, the word-power is supportive of <s>ākṣepa</s> (objection).

children.text: आक्षेपको पोषकहै अथ स्फुट व्यंग लक्षणा कबि मित्रहू कठिन सो लखै
children.translated_text: Now, the definition of clear suggestion: that which even a poet's friend finds difficult to perceive —

children.text: यथा चकृत चितयसुंदरी पहिचानी । हर्षबिषाद हृदय अकुलानी टी० इहां
children.translated_text: for example, 'The beautiful one gazed in wonder, having recognized [him]; joy and sorrow agitated her heart.' Commentary: Here, from difficulty, the suggestion is greater — upon reflection, the <s>kilakiñcita</s> <s>hāva</s> (coquettish expression).

children.text: कठिनताते व्यंग अधिक बिचारते किलकिंचित्हाव अथ संदेही व्यंग
children.translated_text: Now, doubtful suggestion:

children.text: यथा की मैनाक कि खगपति होई टी० इहां एक जाने बिना संदेह प्र-
children.translated_text: for example, 'Is it <s>Maināka</s> [mountain] or the lord of birds?' Commentary: Here, without knowing one, doubt is primary; hence the suggestion.

children.text: धानते व्यंग अथ तुल्य प्रधान जहां बाच्य व्यंग बराबर यथा तोहि देखि
children.translated_text: Now, equally primary — where literal and suggested are equal: for example, 'Seeing you, my heart became cool;

children.text: शीतल भइ छाती ।पुनि मोकहँ सोदिन सो राती टी० इहां दिनराति
children.translated_text: and for me, that day became that night.' Commentary: Here, saying 'day became night' — the restlessness suggested and the literal are equal.

children.text: सो कहेते व्याकुलता ध्वनि वाच्य ध्वनि बराबरहै अथ काक पीछे कहि
children.translated_text: Now, <s>kāku</s> (tone) — said with ironic intent.

children.text: आये अथ असुंदर लक्षणध्वनिते बाच्यनिको होय यथा का बर्षा जब कृषी
children.translated_text: Now, unbeautiful — where the suggestion is inferior to the literal: for example, 'What use is rain when the crop has dried?

children.text: सुखाने।समय चूकि पुनिका पछताने टी० फेरचाप टूटे ऐसो समय मिले-
children.translated_text: Having missed the time, what use is repentance?' Commentary: [The suggestion] that an opportunity like the bow-breaking will come — that suggestion is not more beautiful than the literal. Thus ends middling poetry.

children.text: गा व्यंगसो वाच्यतें सुन्दर नाहीं इति मध्यमकाब्य अथदोष लक्षण शब्द
children.translated_text: Now, the definition of defects: when from the excess of word or meaning, the <s>rasa</s> (sentiment) cannot be grasped; when there are no proper limbs;

children.text: अर्थ के आधिक्यतासे रस न बूझपरै अंगनहीं न रसयतिभंगअर्थ श्रपार्थ
children.translated_text: when there is no <s>rasa</s>; when there is a breach of meter; when the meaning serves another purpose; when harsh words are used; repetition; blind contradiction; deaf, lame, naked, dead —

children.text: बनं प्रयोजन करन कटु पुनरुक्ति अंधबिरोधी बधिर पंगुनगन मृतक और
children.translated_text: and many more are the varieties of defect. This <s>Rāmacarita</s> — through a sympathetic intellect — has no defects.

children.text: हूं दूषण के प्रभेद बहुत हैं ई रामचरित्र है सुहृदय मतिते दूषण नहीं है
children.translated_text: Now, the definition of qualities (<s>guṇas</s>): the excellence of <s>rasa</s> (sentiment) in composition — that quality is of three kinds: <s>mādhurya</s> (sweetness) (1),

children.text: आथगुण लक्षण रसकी उत्कर्षता रचना सो गुण तीन भांति माधुर्य १
children.translated_text: <s>ojas</s> (vigor) (2), <s>prasāda</s> (clarity) (3). Now, <s>mādhurya</s>: where harsh syllables are absent and the mind is delighted: for example, 'The tinkling

children.text: औज २ प्रमाद३ अथमाधुर्यजामें कटुबर्णनहोइ मन रंजन करै यथा कं-
children.translated_text: of anklets, bracelets, and girdles was heard.' Now, <s>ojas</s>: where there are conjunct consonants and long compounds: for example, 'The monkeys roar, the bears make

children.text: कण किंकिणिनूपुर धुनिसुनि अथ ओज जामों संयोगी अक्षर होइ अरु
children.translated_text: deceptive maneuvers, by which the wicked are destroyed' — and so forth.

children.text: समासबड़ो यथा चिक्करहिं मर्कट भालु छलबल करहिं जेहि खलछीजहीं
children.translated_text: Now, <s>prasāda</s>: where upon hearing, the meaning is immediately grasped, and all qualities are present:

children.text: इत्यादि अथ प्रमाद जहां सुनतही अर्थ जानोजाय अरु सब गुणमों रहत
children.translated_text: for example, 'The wise, the ascetic, the hero, the skilled poet — a treasury of virtues — who has not been

children.text: है यथाज्ञानी तापसशूरकबि कोबिदगुण आगार केहिके लोभ विडम्बना
children.translated_text: mocked by greed in this world?'

children.text: कीन्हन यह संसार।।अथ तीन बृत्ति गुणतेंहेतुहै उपनागरिका मधुरगुण १
children.translated_text: Now, three styles (<s>vṛttis</s>) arise from qualities: <s>upanāgarikā</s> (urbane), from the sweet quality (1); <s>puruṣādṛḍha</s> (bold masculine) (2); <s>komalā</s> (gentle), with clarity (3).

children.text: पुरुषाडध्धत २ कोमला प्रसाद युत ३ अबगुणालंकार को भेद कहतुहैं
children.translated_text: Now the distinction between qualities and ornaments is stated: from both, greatness arises and one does not forget [the verse]. In this, how does one distinguish between quality and ornament?

children.text: दूनोंते बडाई होतहै अरु बिसरनहीं होत यामें गुणको अरु अलंकारको
children.translated_text: That which enhances <s>rasa</s> — <s>anuprāsa</s> (alliteration), <s>upamā</s> (simile), and the like — is an auspicious ornament.

children.text: भेद कैसो जानै रसको बढ़ावै अनुप्रास उपमादिदै अलंकार शुभ अथ
children.translated_text: Now, types of <s>nāyikā</s> (heroine): <s>Padminī</s> — extremely delicate (1); <s>Citrinī</s> — fond of sensual pleasures (2);

children.text: नायका जाति पद्मिनी अति सुकुमारी १ चित्रनी उपभोगनमों रुचिते २
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkhinī</s> — neither compassion nor anger (3); <s>Hastinī</s> — eating to the stomach's fill, chewing (4).

children.text: शंखिनी दयारोष नाहींतें ३ हस्तिनी उदरभरि भोजन चाबते ४ अथना-
children.translated_text: Now, types of heroines by relation: <s>Svīyā</s> — devoted to her own husband through love (1); <s>Parakīyā</s> — secretly devoted to another man

children.text: यका भेद स्वीया स्वामीमो अनुरागतें १ परिकीया छिपाय परपुरुष
children.translated_text: through love (2); <s>Sāmānyā</s> — for the desire of wealth (3).

children.text: अनुरागतें २ सामान्या धन लोभतें ३ अथ स्वीयात्रिधामुग्धा अंकुरित यौ-
children.translated_text: Now, <s>Svīyā</s> is of three kinds: <s>Mugdhā</s> — of budding youth (1); <s>Madhyā</s> — equal shame and desire (2);

children.text: बना १ मध्या समानलज्जा कामते २ प्रगल्भा केलिकला प्रबीण पतिमें
children.translated_text: <s>Pragalbhā</s> — skilled in the arts of love, [devoted] to her husband (3).

children.text: ३ अथ मुग्धा भेदद्वै ज्ञात १अज्ञात २अरु नवोढ़ा लज्जा भयपराधीन रति
children.translated_text: Now, <s>Mugdhā</s> is of two kinds: <s>Jñātā</s> (knowing) (1) and <s>Ajñātā</s> (unknowing) (2). And <s>Navoḍhā</s> (newly married) — subordinate to modesty and fear in love (1);

children.text: तें १ बिश्रब्ध नवोढ़ा पतिमें कछु बिश्ववासतें २ मध्या प्रगल्भामानवस्था
children.translated_text: <s>Viśrabdhā Navoḍhā</s> — having some trust in the husband (2). <s>Madhyā</s> and <s>Pragalbhā</s>, in the state of pride (<s>māna</s>) —

children.text: मों तीन प्रकार धीरा व्यंगकोप प्रकाशका १अधीरा कोय अव्यंग प्रकाशि-
children.translated_text: three types: <s>Dhīrā</s> — who manifests anger indirectly (1); <s>Adhīrā</s> — whose anger is undisguised

children.text: का २ धीराधीर व्यंगाव्यंग कोप प्रकाशिका ३ अरु ज्येष्ठा कनिष्ठा अधिक
children.translated_text: (2); <s>Dhīrādhīrā</s> — who manifests anger both directly and indirectly (3). And <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> (senior) and <s>Kaniṣṭhā</s> (junior) —

children.text: न्यून प्रीतिते धीरादि भेदयहिमोंहोतहै अथ परकीया भेदकन्या अनब्याही
children.translated_text: from greater and lesser love — the <s>Dhīrā</s> and other distinctions apply to them as well.

children.text: परपुरुष अनरागतें १ परोढ़ी जो परने विवाह लयो २ अथसुरथ गुप्ता तीन
children.translated_text: Now, the types of <s>Parakīyā</s>: <s>Kanyā</s> — an unmarried girl devoted to another man (1); <s>Parodhī</s> — one married to another (2).

children.text: भूत १ भविष्य २ वर्तमान ३ तेविदग्धाद्वै बचना चातुरीतेबचना विदग्धा१
children.translated_text: Now, the secret love-meeting (<s>suratha-guptā</s>) — three [temporal types]: past (1), future (2), present (3). The <s>Vidagdhā</s> (clever one) is of two kinds: <s>Vacanā-vidagdhā</s> — clever in speech (1);

children.text: कृपाचातुरीते कृपा विदग्धा २लक्षिता लक्षणनामेते कुलटा जोचाहे बहुना-
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛpā-vidagdhā</s> — clever in compassion (2). <s>Lakṣitā</s> (the one whose signs are known) — <s>Kulaṭā</s> (the wanton) — who goes with many lovers.

children.text: यकने अनुसयनाके तीनभेद संकेतना बास होबेते१संकेत नाशहोनिहार तें
children.translated_text: <s>Anusayanā</s> (the one who repents) — three types: from the meeting-place remaining (1); from the meeting-place being destroyed

children.text: २ संकेतते नायकह्वै आयो आयनगर्ह पछताय ३मुदिता लक्षण नामेते
children.translated_text: (2); from the hero having come to the meeting and then leaving in reproach (3). <s>Muditā</s> (the delighted one) — defined by its name.

children.text: इति अरु गणिका लक्षणपूर्ब लिखि आयेहैं अथ साधारण नायकाभेद अन्य
children.translated_text: Thus. And the <s>Gaṇikā</s> (courtesan) — her characteristics have been written above. Now, general types of heroines: <s>Anya-saṃbhoga-duḥkhitā</s> (grieved by the lover's enjoyment with another);

children.text: संभोग दुःखिता बक्रोक्तिगर्विताभेद प्रेमगर्बिता रूपगर्विता ता अरु मानवती
children.translated_text: <s>Vakrokti-garvitā</s> (proud of indirect speech); types of the proud: <s>Prema-garvitā</s> (proud of love); <s>Rūpa-garvitā</s> (proud of beauty).

children.text: भेद तीन लघुमध्यम गुरुमानते इनसबकीलक्षण नामेते प्रथमहि जो ना-
children.translated_text: And <s>Mānavatī</s> (the offended one) — three types: minor, middling, and severe pride. The definitions of all these are known from their names.

children.text: यका कहि आयेहैं सो सब आठ प्रकारकी होती हैं और बिरहनी भेद तीन
children.translated_text: All the heroines described earlier are of eight types. And the <s>Virahinī</s> (woman in separation) — three types:

children.text: प्रोषित पतिका १ जाको कंत विदेश गयो प्रोक्ष्यत पतिका जाको पति
children.translated_text: <s>Proṣita-patikā</s> (1) — whose husband has gone abroad; <s>Prokṣyat-patikā</s> — whose husband

children.text: बिदेश जायगो २ प्रोषित पतिका जाको पति विदेशको चलतुहै ३ अरु
children.translated_text: will go abroad (2); <s>Pravatsyat-patikā</s> — whose husband is about to depart (3). And

children.text: आगत पतिका लक्षण नामेते यहूको कोऊ बिरहनी मानतुहै पै यहै नहीं
children.translated_text: <s>Āgata-patikā</s> — defined by its name — some consider her too a woman in separation, but she is not.

children.text: खंडिता अन्योपभोग चिह्नित पति देखेते और कलहंतरिता अपमानकर
children.translated_text: <s>Khaṇḍitā</s> — upon seeing the husband bearing marks of enjoyment with another. <s>Kalahāntaritā</s> — after having insulted [the lover],

children.text: पीछे पछताय विप्र लब्धासंकेतमें पति न मिलेते ब्याकुलहोय उत्कण्ठ-
children.translated_text: she repents. <s>Vipralabdhā</s> — when the husband fails to come to the appointed meeting, she becomes agitated.

children.text: ता लक्षण नामेते बासकशय्या आजु हमारेपति आवेंगे जानि रति सामग्री
children.translated_text: <s>Utkaṇṭhitā</s> — defined by its name. <s>Vāsakasajjā</s> — knowing 'today my husband will come,' she prepares the bed with love-making accessories.

children.text: ते व्यारकरेते स्वाधीन पतिका लक्षणनामेते अभिसारिका अपने जाय
children.translated_text: <s>Svādhīna-patikā</s> — defined by its name. <s>Abhisārikā</s> — one who goes herself or sends for the beloved.

children.text: या पीय बोलायेते इति अष्टनायिका अथ उत्तमा मध्यमा अधमा नायका
children.translated_text: Thus, the eight <s>nāyikās</s> (heroines). Now, <s>Uttamā</s> (superior), <s>Madhyamā</s> (middling), <s>Adhamā</s> (inferior) heroines —

children.text: तीनोंका लक्षणनामते अरु अभयदिव्यअदिव्य दिव्यादिव्यविचारलिखतु
children.translated_text: the definitions of all three are known from their names. And the divine, non-divine, and divine-non-divine categories —

children.text: हों दिब्य इन्हानीआदिब्य नरतिय दिब्यादिब्यद्रौपदी आदि इन्हते भेद
children.translated_text: I write: divine — <s>Indrāṇī</s> and the like; non-divine — human women; divine-non-divine — <s>Draupadī</s> and the like. Many sub-divisions can be made from these.

children.text: किये बहुत भेद होतहैं इति नायकासखी प्रीय नरमादि सिखावन धर्म
children.translated_text: Thus, the heroine. <s>Sakhī</s> (friend), beloved, male and female confidantes, instructors in <s>dharma</s>,

children.text: दूती चुरहारिनि गोसार्हनि आदि अथ नायकभेद पति १ उत्पत्ति २ वैसि-
children.translated_text: <s>dūtī</s> (messenger), hairdresser, Go-keeper, and the like. Now, types of <s>nāyaka</s> (hero): husband (1), <s>upapati</s> (paramour) (2), <s>vaiśika</s> (libertine) (3).

children.text: क ३ इन्ह के लक्षण नामहि तेंसखा भेद चार पीठमर्द १ वीट२ चेटक३
children.translated_text: Their definitions are known from their names. Types of <s>sakhā</s> (friend) — four: <s>pīṭhamarda</s> (confidant) (1), <s>vīṭa</s> (gallant) (2), <s>ceṭaka</s> (servant) (3),

children.text: बिदूषक ४ अथ दर्शन चारि भांति श्रवण १ प्रत्यक्ष २ चित्र ३ स्वप्न ४
children.translated_text: <s>vidūṣaka</s> (jester) (4). Now, meeting (<s>darśana</s>) — four ways: through hearing (1), direct sight (2), picture (3), dream (4).

children.text: इति नायक मिलायबो चारि भांति साम १ दाम २ दंड ३ बिभेद ४ अथ
children.translated_text: Thus, winning the hero — four ways: <s>sāma</s> (conciliation) (1), <s>dāma</s> (gifts) (2), <s>daṇḍa</s> (force) (3), <s>bheda</s> (division) (4).

children.text: हाव दशप्रकार लक्षण तरुणिन के अंगनतें प्रगट जे भाव होतुहैं ताहीको
children.translated_text: Now, <s>hāva</s> (coquetry) — ten types. The definition: the sentiments that manifest from the limbs of young women —

children.text: हाव कहत हैं प्रथम लीला हाव लक्षण बोलनि चलनि चितवनिमों सब
children.translated_text: those are called <s>hāvas</s>. First: <s>Līlā-hāva</s> — the heroine charms in every way through speech, gait, and glances (1).

children.text: भांति अनुरागकरै नायका१ बिलासल०पियदेखतमन हरबे की भावकरै२
children.translated_text: <s>Vilāsa</s> — she expresses the sentiment of captivating the beloved's mind in his presence (2).

children.text: बिक्षिप्त लक्षण थोरा किये शृंगार पय शोभा अधिक होइ३ बिभ्रम लक्षण
children.translated_text: <s>Vikṣipta</s> — with little adornment, beauty increases (3). <s>Vibhrama</s> —

children.text: नामहिते ४ किलकिंचितल उरहंसिरोमहर्ष एकैबारहोय५मोयइतल०पिय
children.translated_text: defined by its name (4). <s>Kilakiñcita</s> — laughter, horripilation, and tears all arise at once (5). <s>Moṭṭāyita</s> —

children.text: कथा मिलनकी सुन चाहहोइ ६ कुटुम्मितल० अधर उरजके शनिन को
children.translated_text: hearing talk of the beloved's meeting, desire arises (6). <s>Kuṭṭamita</s> — she covers her lips and breasts,

children.text: धरै झूठी रूखी होय हियमें सुख पावै ७ बिंबोकल० आये आदर न करै
children.translated_text: feigns coldness, yet feels joy within (7). <s>Bimboka</s> — when he arrives, she shows no respect (8).

children.text: ललितल ० अंग अंग भूषण सोहै ९ विहितल ० लाजते न बोलि सकै
children.translated_text: <s>Lalita</s> — ornaments adorn each limb (9). <s>Vihita</s> — from modesty, she cannot speak (10).

children.text: १० अथ शब्दालंकार छेकानु प्राल यथा भये प्रगट कृपाला परमदयाला
children.translated_text: Now, <s>śabdālaṅkāra</s> (figure of sound): <s>Chekānuprāsa</s> (tasteful alliteration): for example, 'The compassionate, supremely merciful one appeared —

children.text: कौशल्या हितकारी अथ वृत्तानुप्रास एक बर्ण बहु यथा कहि जय जय जय
children.translated_text: the benefactor of <s>Kausalyā</s>.' Now, <s>Vṛttānuprāsa</s> (repeated alliteration) — one consonant repeated many times: for example, 'Say victory, victory, victory,

children.text: रघुकुलकेतु अथ नाटानुप्रास एक पद बहुत बेरआवै यथा भवभव विभव
children.translated_text: O banner of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty!' Now, <s>Lāṭānuprāsa</s> — one word repeated many times: for example, '<s>Bhava-bhava-vibhava-parābhava-kāriṇī</s>'.

children.text: पराभवकारिनि वैदरभी गौनी पंचाली यहू रीति क्वचित्मतेहै अथ यमक
children.translated_text: <s>Vaidarbhī</s>, <s>Gauṇī</s>, <s>Pāñcālī</s> — these styles are considered in some views. Now, <s>Yamaka</s> (punning):

children.text: एक शब्द द्वैवार आवै यथा भये बिदेह बिदेह बिशेषी अरु आर यमकभेद
children.translated_text: When one word appears twice, as in 'bhaye videha videha' — this is a special type; and another variety of <s>yamaka</s> (paronomasia)

children.text: चारों चरणा अर्ध अर्धको अर्ध इत्यादि अथ अर्थालंकार जाको बरणय सो
children.translated_text: is [found in] all four quarters, half, half of a half, and so forth. Now, <s>arthālaṅkāra</s> (figures of meaning): that which is described is

children.text: उपमेय जाको उपमादेइ सो उपमान समताकारक वाचक धर्म दूनो
children.translated_text: the <s>upameya</s> (object of comparison); that which provides the comparison is the <s>upamāna</s> (standard of comparison); the word indicating equality is the <s>vācaka</s> (indicator); the <s>dharma</s> (common property) that exists in both —

children.text: मो जोरहै चारोंहोइ तहां पूर्ण उपमा यथा तरुणअरुण अंबुजलम चरणा
children.translated_text: when all four are present, there is <s>pūrṇa upamā</s> (complete simile). For example: 'Feet [beautiful] like young, red lotuses.'

children.text: अरु एक द्वै तीन लुप्ततें आठ भेद अथ बाचक लुप्ता यथा नव अंबुज अंबक
children.translated_text: And when one, two, or three [elements] are absent, there are eight varieties. Now, <s>vācaka-luptā</s> (simile with omitted indicator): for example, 'The beauty of new lotus eyes is lovely.'

children.text: छबि नीकी अथ बाचक धर्म लुप्ता यथा बिधु बदनी मृग शावकलोचनि
children.translated_text: Now, <s>vācaka-dharma-luptā</s> (simile with omitted indicator and property): for example, 'Moon-faced, fawn-eyed.'

children.text: अथ बावकधर्म उपमान लुप्ता यथायूथ यूथ मिलि सुमुखि सुनैनी इत्यादि
