children.translated_text: Now, <s>vācaka-dharma-upamāna-luptā</s> (simile with omitted indicator, property, and standard): for example, 'Groups upon groups gathering, O fair-faced, beautiful-eyed one,' and so on —

children.text: लुप्ता अथ अनन्यौउपमेय उपमा एकयथा इनसमये उपमा उरआनी अथ
children.translated_text: these are the varieties of <s>luptā</s> (elliptical simile). Now, <s>ananyā upamā</s> (simile without another [standard]): when the <s>upameya</s> alone serves as its own comparison — for example, 'No comparison came to the heart for these.'

children.text: उपमानोपमेय परस्पर लगे यथा रामकथामुनिबर्य्यबखानी । सुनी महेश
children.translated_text: Now, when <s>upamāna</s> and <s>upameya</s> are mutually [compared]: for example, '<s>Rāma's</s> story, narrated by the best of sages, was heard by <s>Maheśa</s> (Śiva),

children.text: परमसुखमानी ।। ऋषिपूलीहरिभगतरोहाई । कहीशम्भुअधिकारीपाई ।।
children.translated_text: who deemed it the supreme joy. The sages rejoiced as devotees of <s>Hari</s>; <s>Śambhu</s> (Śiva) spoke, having found a worthy recipient.'

children.text: अथ प्रतीय प्रकार पांच उपमानेको उपमेय करै यथा उतरि नहाये यमुन
children.translated_text: Now, <s>pratīpa</s> (reversed simile) is of five kinds. [First:] when the <s>upamāna</s> is made into the <s>upameya</s>: for example, 'Having descended and bathed in the <s>Yamunā</s> waters,

children.text: जल जो शररिसम श्याम १ अथ उपमेयको उपमानते आदर न होय २
children.translated_text: which are dark like [his] body' (1). Now, [second:] when the <s>upameya</s> is not honored by the <s>upamāna</s> (2):

children.text: यथा नांघहिं खग अनेक बारीशा । शूर न हीतिंते सुनु शठकीशा अथ उप-
children.translated_text: for example, 'Many birds fly across the rainy season — but a hero does not [flee] from weapons, listen, O foolish lord.' Now, [third:] when the <s>upamāna</s>

children.text: मानको उपमेयते आदर न होय ३ यथा सियमुख समता पाव किमि चंद
children.translated_text: is not honored by the <s>upameya</s> (3): for example, 'How can the wretched moon attain equality with <s>Sītā's</s> face?'

children.text: बापुरोरंक । अथ उपमा जहां समता न करै ४ यथा सीयबदनसमहिमकर
children.translated_text: Now, [fourth:] where the simile does not make a comparison (4): for example, 'The moon is not equal to <s>Sītā's</s> face.'

children.text: नाहीं । अथ उपमान जहां वृथा होइ ५ यथाकोटिकाम उपमालघु सोऊ ।
children.translated_text: Now, [fifth:] where the <s>upamāna</s> becomes futile (5): for example, 'Even the comparison of ten million <s>Kāmas</s> (Love-gods) is trivial.'

children.text: अथ रूपकद्वै भांति एक तदरूप १ अभेद २ अधिक १ न्यून २ सम ३ दो
children.translated_text: Now, <s>rūpaka</s> (metaphor) is of two kinds: one is <s>tadrūpa</s> (of-the-same-form) (1), and <s>abheda</s> (non-difference) (2). [Each has] excess (1), deficiency (2), and equality (3) —

children.text: उनके तीना तीन भेदे होतुहैं अथ अधिक तद्रूप यथा विषबारुणी बन्धु
children.translated_text: thus each of the two has three varieties each, [making six]. Now, <s>adhika tadrūpa</s> (excessive same-form metaphor): for example, 'The friend of poison-liquor —

children.text: प्रियतेही । कहियरमासमकिमिवैदेही ।। अथन्यून तद्रूप यथा राममात्रलघु
children.translated_text: how can <s>Vaidehī</s> (<s>Sītā</s>) be said to be like <s>Ramā</s> (<s>Lakṣmī</s>)?' Now, <s>nyūna tadrūpa</s> (deficient same-form): for example, '<s>Rāma's</s> name is only slightly lesser than

children.text: नाम हमारा ।। परशुसहित बड़नाम तुम्हारा ।। अथसमतद्रूप यथा लषण
children.translated_text: ours; your name, with the axe, is greater.' Now, <s>sama tadrūpa</s> (equal same-form): for example, '<s>Lakṣmaṇa's</s>

children.text: उतर आहुति सरिस इत्यादि अथ अधिक अभेद रूपक यथा नव बिधु
children.translated_text: answer, like an oblation,' and so forth. Now, <s>adhika abheda rūpaka</s> (excessive non-difference metaphor): for example, 'The new moon —

children.text: बिमलतात यशतोरा । रघुबर किंकर कुमुद चकोरा ।। उदितयदा अथइहि
children.translated_text: your father's spotless fame, O <s>Raghuvara</s> (best of the Raghus); [your] servants are the water-lily and the <s>cakora</s> bird. When it rises,

children.text: कबहूंना घटिहि न जगनभ दिन दिनदूना ।। अथ न्यून अभेद यथा ।। अति
children.translated_text: it never diminishes; it increases day by day in the sky of the world.' Now, <s>nyūna abheda</s> (deficient non-difference): for example, 'The extremely

children.text: खलजे विषयीबककागा । अथ समभेद यथा । सम्पति चकई भरत चक
children.translated_text: wicked and sensual are like cranes and crows.' Now, <s>sama abheda</s> (equal non-difference): for example, '<s>Sampatī</s> is the <s>cakavī</s> (ruddy goose), <s>Bharata</s> is the <s>cakavā</s>;

children.text: मुनि आयसु खेल वार तेहि निशि आश्रम पिंजरा राखे भाभिनुसार ।।
children.translated_text: by the sage's command, that night the play continued — they kept [them] in the cage of the hermitage, following each other.'

children.text: अथ परिणाम उपमान कृपा करै उपमेयको यथा । मामवलोकय पंकज
children.translated_text: Now, <s>pariṇāma</s> (transformation): when the <s>upamāna</s> shows kindness to the <s>upameya</s> — for example, 'Look upon me, O Lotus-eyed One.'

children.text: लोचन । अथ उल्लेष द्वैभांति बहुतकै एकै उल्लेष यथा । रहंअसुर छल छोनि
children.translated_text: Now, <s>ullekhā</s> (description) is of two kinds: [first,] the description of one by many — for example, 'The demons remained in disguise throughout the land;

children.text: प्रदेशा तिन्ह प्रभु प्रगट कालसम दखे ।। पुरबासिन देखे दोउ भाई। नर
children.translated_text: the Lord appeared to them like Death. The city-dwellers saw the two brothers — ornaments of men, givers of delight to the eyes.'

children.text: भूषण लोचन सुखदाई ।। दूसरो यथा । जय रघुबंश बनजवन भानू । गहन
children.translated_text: The second: for example, 'Victory to the sun of the lotus-forest of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty,

children.text: दनुज कुल दहन कृशानू ।। अथ सुमरिन १ भ्रम २ संदेह इनको नामे ते
children.translated_text: the fire for burning the dense demon-clan!' Now, <s>smaraṇa</s> (remembrance) (1), <s>bhrama</s> (error) (2), <s>sandeha</s> (doubt) — their characteristics by name:

children.text: लक्षण सुमरिन यथा । सियमुख सरिस देखि सुख पावा ।भ्रम यथाबहुरि
children.translated_text: <s>Smaraṇa</s>: for example, 'Seeing [her face] resembling <s>Sītā's</s> face, he felt joy.' <s>Bhrama</s>: for example, 'Coming again,

children.text: आय देखा सुत सोर्ह । हृदयकम्प मन धीर न होई ।। संदेह यथा । कोतुम
children.translated_text: he saw his son with sixteen [qualities]; the heart trembled, the mind did not become steady.' <s>Sandeha</s> (doubt): for example, 'Who are you —

children.text: तीन देव महँ कोई । नर नारायणकी तुम दोई ।। अथ शुद्धापह्नुति और
children.translated_text: are you one of the three gods? Are you both <s>Nara</s> and <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>?' Now, <s>śuddhāpahṇuti</s> (pure concealment): attributing to another

children.text: की आरोप करि सांचो धर्म छिपावै बन्धुन होय मोर यहकाला । अथहेता
children.translated_text: and hiding the true property — 'This is not a relative of mine, this is [the demon] <s>Kāla</s>.' Now, <s>hetv-apa-</s>

children.text: पहनुति युक्तिते छिपावै बस्त यथा देखियत प्रगट गंगन अंगारा ।अवनिन
children.translated_text: <s>hṇuti</s> (concealment by reasoning): hiding the thing through reasoning — for example, 'One sees embers clearly visible in the sky,

children.text: आवत एकौतारा ।। अथ परजस्तापह्नुतिआनकेगुण आन मैं आरोपै यथा
children.translated_text: but not a single star descending to earth.' Now, <s>parastāpahṇuti</s> (concealment by attributing another's quality to another): for example,

children.text: मुकुट न होहिं भूप गुणचारी । अथ भ्राता पह्नुति भ्रम दूरकरै यथा कह
children.translated_text: 'Crowns do not make kings of good character.' Now, <s>bhrāntāpahṇuti</s> (concealment removing error): for example, '<s>Prabhu</s> said

children.text: प्रभु हंसि जनि हृदय डेराहू । लूकनि अशनिकेतुनहिंराहू ।। येकिरीटदश-
children.translated_text: with a smile: "Do not be alarmed at heart. These are not lightning or meteors, nor <s>Rāhu</s>;

children.text: कंधर केरे । आवत वालि तनयकेप्रेरे ।। अथ छेकापह्नुतियुक्तिसों जहांबात
children.translated_text: these are the crowns of ten-headed <s>Rāvaṇa</s>, coming at the urging of the son of <s>Vālin</s>."' Now, <s>chekāpahṇuti</s> (clever concealment): where one hides the matter with skill

children.text: दुरावै परसों यथा कछु न परीक्षा लीन्ह गोसाई । कीन्हप्रणाम तुम्हारिहि
children.translated_text: from another — for example, 'I took no test, O Lord; I merely bowed',

children.text: नाईं ।। अथ कैत वापह्नुति एकको बनाकरि बर्णै आन यथा लखी नरेश
children.translated_text: in your manner.' Now, <s>kaitavāpahṇuti</s> (deceptive concealment): describing one while creating another — for example, 'The king saw that all the matter was true;

children.text: बात सब सांची । तिय मिसुमीचु शीशपर नाची ।। अथ उत्प्रेक्षा संभावना
children.translated_text: death danced on the head of the woman in disguise.' Now, <s>utprekṣā</s> (poetic fancy): <s>sambhāvanā</s> (supposition)

children.text: भ्रांति बिन बस्तुहेतु फल ३ अथ बस्तुते २ यथा छत्रमेघडंबर शिरधारी
children.translated_text: <s>bhrānti</s> (illusion); [there are three types based on] thing, cause, and fruit (3). Now, [fancy based on] thing (2): for example, 'Wearing the canopy, [grand] like a cloud's display on the head —

children.text: सो जनु जलद घटा अतिकारी ।। हेतुते २ यथा प्रभु कह गरल बन्धुशशि
children.translated_text: as if a mass of cloud-formations exceedingly dark.' [Based on] cause (2): for example, '<s>Prabhu</s> said, "The poison is the brother of the moon;

children.text: केरा । अति प्रिय निज उरदीन्ह बसेरा ।। फलते ३ यथा चारु चरणनख
children.translated_text: being extremely dear, it has been given a dwelling in his own breast."' [Based on] fruit (3): for example, 'The beautiful toenails

children.text: लेखति धरनी । नूपुर मुखर मधुर कवि बरनी ।। मनहु प्रेमबश बिनती
children.translated_text: scratch the earth; the anklets, resonant and sweet, the poet described;

children.text: करहीं । हमहिं सीयपद जनि परि हरहीं ।। अथ अति शयोक्ति रूपक,
children.translated_text: as if, being overcome by love, they were entreating: "Do not take us away from <s>Sītā's</s> feet!"' Now, <s>atiśayokti</s> (hyperbole): <s>rūpaka</s> (metaphor),

children.text: जहां उपमानतें ।उपमेय प्रभटै यथा सिरत सुमन कत बेधइ हीरा अथ
children.translated_text: where the <s>upameya</s> surpasses the <s>upamāna</s> — for example, 'A flowing flower — why does the diamond pierce it?' Now,

children.text: अपह्नोक्ति और को गुन और पर ठहरावै यथा तव मूरति विधुउर बमत
children.translated_text: <s>apahṇokti</s> (denial): attributing one's quality to another — for example, 'Your form, O moon of the heart, that same

children.text: सोइ श्यामताभास अथ भेदकांति औरै पद जहांहोय यथा महिलरिसागर
children.translated_text: dark appearance is [merely] a reflection.' Now, <s>bhedakānti</s> (distinction-beauty): where [the predicate] falls on another subject — for example, 'Great [is] the ocean of wrath, the lake, the mountain, and many [things];

children.text: सर गिरि नाना । सब प्रपंचहै तहँ आनै आना ।। अथ सम्बन्धातिशयोक्ति
children.translated_text: all this expansion — there is something other [implied] in each.' Now, <s>sambandhātiśayokti</s> (hyperbole of relation):

children.text: योग को योगता देइ यथा धवल धाम ऊपर नभ चुम्बत ।अथ दूसरोवाके
children.translated_text: attributing capability to the connection — for example, 'The white palace, standing above, touching the sky.' Now, the second, opposite in statement:

children.text: विपरीत यथा नवपल्लव फल सुमन सुहाये ।निज संपति सुररूखलजाये।।
children.translated_text: for example, 'The beautiful new leaves, fruits, and flowers — the trees of the gods were ashamed by their own wealth.'

children.text: अथ क्रमातिशयोक्ति कारणकारजु संगैमोंहोय यथा संधानेउ प्रभु विशिख
children.translated_text: Now, <s>kramātiśayokti</s> (hyperbole of sequence): when cause and effect occur simultaneously — for example, 'The Lord fitted a terrible arrow;

children.text: कराला।उठी उदधि उर अन्तर ज्वाला।।अथ चपलातिशयोक्ति कारण तें.
children.translated_text: flames rose from the depths of the ocean.' Now, <s>capalātiśayokti</s> (hyperbole of swiftness): when merely from the cause

children.text: होतु नामै काज यथा बिमल कथाकर कीन्हअरम्भा । सुनत नशाइकाम
children.translated_text: the result occurs — for example, 'He commenced the pure narrative; merely upon hearing it, desire, pride, and hypocrisy were destroyed.' Now, <s>atyantātiśayokti</s> (absolute hyperbole): where the previous sequence does not hold — for example, '<s>Kapi</s> (Hanumān) said,

children.text: मद दम्भा । अथ अत्यन्तातिशयोक्ति पूर्वा पर क्रम नाहीं यथा कह कपि
children.translated_text: "O sage, first take the preceptor's fee; afterward give us the <s>mantra</s>."' Now, <s>trividha tulyayogitā</s> (threefold equal attribution):

children.text: मुनि गुरु दक्षिणालेहू । पाछे हमहिं मंत्र तमदेह।।अथ त्रिबिधतुल्ययोगता
children.translated_text: equal nature, beneficial, harmful — for example, 'Blame and praise are both equal,' and so forth. Second:

children.text: सम सभाव हित अहित यथा निन्दा स्तुति उभय सम इत्यादिदूसरोबहु
children.translated_text: one point among many — for example, 'Seeing the movement, the king of birds was ashamed.' Third: making equality among many

children.text: मों एकैबात यथागति विलोकि खगनायक लाजे । तीसरो बहुसो समता
children.translated_text: through qualities — for example, '<s>Prabhu</s> is capable, omniscient; <s>Śiva</s> is the abode of all arts and qualities; <s>Yoga</s>, knowledge,

children.text: गुनकरि यथा प्रभु समरथ रार्वज्ञ शिव सकलकला गुणधामायोग ज्ञान
children.translated_text: detachment — he is the treasure-house; for the supplicant, his name is the wish-fulfilling tree.' Now, <s>dīpaka</s> (illuminator): describes others through one's own qualities —

children.text: बैराग्य निधि प्रणत कल्षतरु नाम। अथ दीपक निज गुणन तें बर्णे इतर
children.translated_text: for example, 'The good attains goodness; the low attains lowness.' And from both word and meaning [combined],

children.text: यथा भलो भलाई पै लहै लहै निचाई नीच । अरु शब्दअर्थ दूनोंके फिरे
children.translated_text: there are three [varieties]. First, <s>śabdavṛtti</s> (verbal function): for example, 'O <s>Vidhi</s> (Creator)! By what <s>vidhi</s> (means) shall I meet the maiden?' Now,

children.text: ते तीन अथ प्रथम शब्द वृत्ति यथा हे बिधि मिलै कवन बिधि बाला।अथ
children.translated_text: <s>arthavṛtti</s> (meaning function): for example, 'The cuckoos coo, the bees hum.' Now, <s>padārthavṛtti</s> (word-meaning function): for example, '<s>Rāma</s>,

children.text: अर्थावृत्ति यथा कूजहिं कोकिल गुंजाहिं भृंगा । अथ पदार्थावृत्ति यथा राम
children.translated_text: you are virtuous (<s>sādhu</s>), you are virtuous and wise.' Now, <s>prativastūpamā</s> (counter-object simile): where both sentences are equal — for example,

children.text: साधु तुम साधु सयाने।अथ प्रतिबस्तु उपमा जहँ दूनों वाक्य बराबर यथा
children.translated_text: 'O King, <s>Rāma</s> has incomparable strength — just so. <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, the treasure of splendor, is likewise.' Now, <s>dṛṣṭānta-</s>

children.text: राजन राम अतुल बल जैसे।तेज निधान लषण पुनि तैसे।।अथ दृष्टान्ता-
children.translated_text: <s>alaṅkāra</s> (illustration figure): where there is an original and a reflection — for example, 'Between the two, <s>Sītā</s> appeared — how like

children.text: लंकार जहां बिंबप्रतिबिंबहोय यथा उभय बीच सियसोहति कैसी । ब्रह्म
children.translated_text: <s>Māyā</s> (illusion) between <s>Brahman</s> (the Absolute) and <s>Jīva</s> (the individual soul)!' Now, threefold <s>nidarśanā</s> (illustration): first, where both sentence and meaning

children.text: जीवबिव मायाजैसी ।अथत्रिबिधनि दर्शना प्रथम जहां वाक्य अर्थ दीनों
children.translated_text: are equal — for example, 'The saintly, like swans, grasp the milk [of goodness] and discard the external impurities.' Second: attributing one

children.text: सम यथा संतहंसगुन गहहिं पय परिहर बाह्य बिकार।दूसरो आनमों आ-
children.translated_text: thing to another — for example, 'He turned and gazed in that direction; his eyes became <s>cakoras</s> (partridge-birds)

children.text: न बस्तु आरोपै यथा असकहि फिरचितये तिहि ओरा । सिय मुख शशि
children.translated_text: to the moon of <s>Sītā's</s> face.' Third: seeing the effect — good or bad — and stating the result — for example, '<s>Rāma's</s> younger brother

children.text: भे नयन चकोरा ।। तीसरोकारज देखभलो बुरो फल कहै यथारामानुज
children.translated_text: drew a small line; he [<s>Rāvaṇa</s>] dared to cross it — such was [the consequence of] his arrogance.' Now, <s>sahokti</s> (co-statement): describes all together at once —

children.text: लधुरेखखिचार्ह । सो उनहिं नांधेउ अस मनुसाई ।। अथ सहोक्ति सवएकै
children.translated_text: for example, 'Strength, might, heroism, and glory — all departed along with the bow <s>Pināka</s>.'

children.text: साथ बरनै यथा बल प्रताप बीरता बड़ाई । नाकपिनाकहि संग सिधाई ।।
children.translated_text: Now, <s>vyatīreka</s> (distinction): describing one aspect differently while abandoning equality in assigning qualities — for example, '<s>Kāla-kūṭa</s> (deadly poison)

children.text: अथ ब्यतीक गुन दायगनि समता तजि एक ब्यंग बरनै यथा काल कूट
children.translated_text: [comes from] the mouth; but milk does not [come from] the mouth.' Now, twofold <s>vinokti</s> (clear statement): a good statement where nothing is hidden —

children.text: मुख पय मुख नाहीं।अथ द्विविध बिनोक्ति नीक बानि काम कछु दुरोवै
children.translated_text: for example, '<s>Rāma</s> told everything to <s>Kauśika</s> — of simple nature, no deception or guile.'

children.text: नहीं यथा राम कहा सब कौशिक पाहीं । सरल सुभाव छुवाछल नाहीं ।।
children.translated_text: Second: for example, 'The moon-faced one, adorned in every way — a beautiful woman made lovely even without fine garments.' Now,

children.text: दूसरो यथा बिधुबदनीसबभांति सवांरी । सोहनबसनबिनावरनारी ।।।अथ
children.translated_text: <s>samāsokti</s> (condensed statement): where knowledge of the implied (<s>aprastuta</s>) arises through the explicit (<s>prastuta</s>) — for example, 'Heroes perform their deeds in battle

children.text: समासोक्ति जहां प्रस्तुतमें अप्रस्तुत को ज्ञान होय यथा शूरसमर करनी
children.translated_text: and do not proclaim themselves.' Now, <s>parikara</s> (attendant): where the purpose is in the qualifier — for example,

children.text: करहि कहिन जनावहिं आप । अथ परि कर बिशेषनमों अभिप्राय यथा
children.translated_text: 'Among devoted wives whose husband is their deity, O mother, yours is the foremost reputation.' Now, <s>parikarāṅkura</s> (sprout of attendant): a purposeful

children.text: पति देवता सुतीय महँ मातु प्रथम तव रेख । अथ परिकरांकुर साभिप्राय
children.translated_text: qualifier — for example, 'Consider the qualities and character of the one who is angry at us.' Now, <s>śleṣa</s> (double meaning): many meanings in a single

children.text: बिशेष जहाँ यथा गुनहु लषण कर हम पर रोषूअथ श्लेष बहुत अर्थ एक
children.translated_text: word — for example, 'The conduct of saints and the nature of cotton are pure, clean, full of qualities (<s>guṇa</s>/threads),

children.text: शब्दमों होय यथा साधु चरित शुभ चरित कपासू । निरस बिशद गुनमय
children.translated_text: and [their] fruit (<s>phala</s>) is free from juice.' Now, <s>aprastuta praśaṃsā</s> (praise of the irrelevant) is of two kinds: first, <s>varṇa-prastuti</s> (description-presentation); second, <s>prastuti-</s>

children.text: फल जासू।।अथ अप्रस्तुत प्रशंसासो द्वै प्रकार एकबरणप्रस्तुति दूसरो प्रस्तु
children.translated_text: <s>aṃśa</s> (partial presentation). First: for example, 'In the four <s>yugas</s> (ages), in the three times, in the three worlds,

children.text: ति अंश प्रथम यथा चहुं युग तीन काल तिहुँ लोका । भये नाम जपि
children.translated_text: beings became free from sorrow by chanting [his] name.' Second: for example, 'Poets and the learned thus ponder in their hearts

children.text: जीव विशोका ।। दूजो यथा कबिकोबिद अस हृदय विचारी । गावहिं हरि
children.translated_text: and sing the glory of <s>Hari</s>, the remover of the impurities of <s>Kali</s> (the dark age).' Now, <s>prajā ukti</s> (statement of intention) has two varieties: speaking through the construction of words, and through

children.text: जस कलिमल हारी ।। अथप्रजा उक्तिके द्वै भेदबात रचनाते कहे अरु मन
children.translated_text: the desire of the mind, accomplishing one's purpose under a pretext. First: for example, 'How shall they recognize him, O Lord, to whom they say,

children.text: भावतोकाम बहानेतेंसाधिबोप्रथम यथातिन्हकहँकहिय नाथ किमिचीन्हें ।
children.translated_text: "Can one see [anything] by the light of a lamp [when the sun shines]?"' Second: for example, '<s>Lakṣmaṇa's</s> heart was longing specially —

children.text: देखिय रविकि दीप करलीन्द्रहें ।।दूसरो यथा लषण हृदय लालसा बिशेखी।
children.translated_text: 'Let us go to <s>Janaka's</s> city and see for ourselves.' Now, <s>vyājastuti</s> (praise under the guise of blame): for example, 'Even if the slaying of ten million <s>brāhmaṇas</s> attaches to you —

children.text: जाइ जनक पुर आइयदेखी।।अथ ब्याजस्तुति मिस निंदा यथा कोटि बिप्र
children.translated_text: having come to [my] shelter, I shall not abandon you.' Now, <s>vyājanindā</s> (blame under the guise of praise) — praise through the pretense of blame:

children.text: बध लागहिंजाहू । आयेशरण तजौं नहिं ताहू।।अथ व्याजनिंदा निंदा मिस
children.translated_text: for example, 'O mother, you became a mother — nothing is in the power of the Creator [Brahmā].' Now, <s>ākṣepa</s> (objection)

children.text: वड़ाई यथा जननी तूजननी भई बिधितन कछु न बसाय । अथ आक्षेप
children.translated_text: is of three kinds: first, a semblance of prohibition [used] to show the equality of virtue and fault; second, first stating something oneself

children.text: तीन प्रकार एक निषेधाभास गुण दोष समतातें दूसरो पहले आप कहे
children.translated_text: and then retracting it; third, hiding the prohibition by a prescriptive statement. First: for example, '<s>Rāma</s>, observe all restraint today —

children.text: पुनि वाको फेरेतीसरे निषेधको बिधिबचनते छिपावै प्रथम यथा राम करहु
children.translated_text: if fate brings the matter to a good end.' Second: for example, 'Even though

children.text: सबसंयम आजू । जौ बिधि कुशल निबाहइ काजू ।। दूसरो यथायदपि
children.translated_text: not a single poetic <s>rasa</s> (aesthetic sentiment) [is present] — may <s>Rāma's</s> glory manifest in the heart.' Third: 'The king said and gave me

children.text: कवित रस एकौनाहीं ।। रामप्रताप प्रगटहिय माहीं ।। तीसरो राजदेन कहि
children.translated_text: exile to the forest — for me there is no sorrow or pain whatsoever. Without you, for <s>Bharata</s>, for the king, and for the subjects, there would be terrible

children.text: दीन्हबन मोहिं न शोच दुखलेश । तुमबिनु भरतहिं भूपतेहिं प्रजहिं प्रचंड
children.translated_text: anguish.' Now, <s>virodhābhāsa</s> (semblance of contradiction): named and characterized thus — for example, 'A mote of dust equal to Mount <s>Meru</s>;

children.text: कलेश ।। अथ बिरोधाभास नामलक्षण यथा धूरिमेरु सम जन कयम ताहि
children.translated_text: to him a rope [as deadly] as a serpent.' Now, <s>vibhāvanā</s> (causation without cause) is of six kinds. [First:] the effect occurs without a cause (1) — for example,

children.text: ब्यालसम दाम । अथ बिभावना षट्प्रकार बिनाकारनैका रजहोइ १ यथा
children.translated_text: 'Without a mouth, the enjoyer of all <s>rasas</s> (flavors).' Second: the effect is fulfilled despite the cause being incomplete (2) — for example,

children.text: अननरहित सकलरसभोगी । दूसरोहेतु अपूरणतेकारज पूरणहोय २ यथा
children.translated_text: 'Taking a bow and arrows of flowers, <s>Kāma</s> (the God of Love) brought all worlds under his control.' Third:

children.text: काम कुसुम धनु सायक लीन्हें । सकल भुवन अपनेबश कीन्हें ।। तीसराप्र
children.translated_text: despite an obstructor, the effect is fulfilled (3) — for example, 'Having killed the guards, he ravaged the forest;

children.text: तिबंधक यद्यपि तऊ कारजकी पूरता३ यथा रखवारे हति विपिनउजारा।।
children.translated_text: seeing you, he is alive — him he slew.' Fourth: the effect occurs from a non-cause (4) — for example, 'He became

children.text: देखत तोहि अछै तेहि मारा ।। चौथो अहेतु तें काज होय ४ यथा भयउ
children.translated_text: the ornament of the <s>Niśācara</s> (demon) clan, O father.' Fifth: from some cause, the effect is contrary (5) — for example, 'The tree

children.text: तात निश्चरकुल भूषण । पांचवौ कौनौ कारणतें काजविरुद्ध ५ यथा जेहि
children.translated_text: in which I dwell — that [tree] causes it pain.' Sixth: from some effect, the cause arises — for example, '<s>Śambhu</s> (Śiva),

children.text: तरु रहों करत सो पीरा छठ्यों काहू काजतें कारनहोय यथा शंभु बि-
children.translated_text: <s>Viriñci</s> (Brahmā), and <s>Viṣṇu</s> — the Lord from whose portions many are born.' Now, <s>viśeṣokti</s> (special statement):

children.text: रंचि बिष्णु भगवाना । उपजहिं जासु अंशतें नाना ।। अथ विशेषोक्ति
children.translated_text: when despite the presence of a cause, the effect does not occur — for example, 'Having threatened, aimed, and taken hold of <s>Śiva's</s> bow,

children.text: कारणहोते काज न होय यथा तमकि ताकि तकि शिव धनु धरहीं । उठइ
children.translated_text: it does not rise, despite making effort in ten million ways.' Now, <s>asambhāvanā</s> (impossibility): stating an impossible effect

children.text: न कोटि भांति बल करहीं ।। अथ असम्भावना अनहोवे लायक कारज
children.translated_text: from the success of a result — for example, 'Pondering in the heart again and again.' Now, threefold <s>viṣama</s> (disparity):

children.text: कहे फल सिद्धितें यथा हृदय बिचारत बारहिवारा ।काज अरु कारन न्यारे
children.translated_text: cause and effect occur in different places (1); performing in one place accomplishes the work of another place (2); from doing good,

children.text: जहां होइ १ और ठौर करै और ठौरको काम २ हितकरते अहितको
children.translated_text: harm results (3). First: 'The loss and gain of those who seek others' welfare —

children.text: लाभहोइ ३ प्रथम परहित हानि लाभ जिनकेरे । उजरे हरष विषाद
children.translated_text: the settled ones rejoice; the sojourners are sorrowful.' Second: 'Whatever is pleasing to the mind, they take it;

children.text: बसेरे ।। दूसरो जोइ जोइ मनभावै सोइ लेहीं । मन मुख मेलि डारकपि
children.translated_text: mixing mind and mouth, the monkeys give up their bodies.' Third: 'Doing good, one reaps an unfavorable result.'

children.text: देहीं ।। तीसरो करत नीक फल अनइस पावा । अत्र त्रिबिध बिषम अन
children.translated_text: Now, threefold <s>viṣama</s> (another set): discordant combination (1), cause and effect being different (2), from doing good, [resulting in] bad (3). First: for example,

children.text: मिलतकौसंग १ कारन कारज भिन्नहोइ २ भलोकरते बुरो ३ प्रथम यथा
children.translated_text: 'Tender feet treading on hard ground.' Second: for example, 'Dark cow, exceedingly white milk;

children.text: कठिन भूमि कोमल पदगामी । दूसरो यथा श्यामसुरभि पय विशद अति
children.translated_text: [yet] they make [one] drink [its] good qualities.' Third: for example, 'Even speaking well, the misfortune of sorrow befell.'

children.text: गुणद करहिते पान । तीसरो यथा भलेउ कहत दुखरौरहि लागा ।
children.translated_text: Now, threefold <s>sama</s> (congruity): proportionate support and supported (1); from little effort, great accomplishment (2); describing one in many places (3).

children.text: अथ त्रिविधि सम दोऊ अनुरूपतें १ कारजमों कारन मिले २ बिना
children.translated_text: First: for example, 'Like the bridegroom, so was the beautiful wedding party adorned.'

children.text: श्रमै कारज सिद्धहोय ३ प्रथम यथा जस दूलह तस बनी बराता ।
children.translated_text: Second: for example, 'What wonder that <s>Bharata</s> does thus? A poison-creeper does not

children.text: दूसरो यथा का आचरज भरत अस करहीं ।। नहिं विषबेल अमिय
children.translated_text: bear nectar-fruit.' Third: for example, 'The bones of the drum, the palm tree — [<s>Rāma</s>] showed [them]; without effort,

children.text: फल फरहीं ।। तीसरो यथा दुंदुभि अस्थिताल देखराये । बिनु प्रयास
children.translated_text: <s>Raghunātha</s> (Lord of the <s>Raghus</s>) toppled them.' Now, <s>vicitra</s> (the wondrous): making an effort for the opposite result — for example, '<s>Rāma</s>

children.text: रघुनाथ ढहाये ।। अथ बिचित्र उलटे फलको यतन करनो यथा राम
children.translated_text: said, "O sage, abandon [your anger], O lord of sages; here is the axe before [you], here is this head."' Now, twofold

children.text: कहेउ रिसि तजिय मुनीशा । कर कुठार आगे यह शीशा ।। अथ द्वै
children.translated_text: <s>adhika</s> (excess): where the supported exceeds the support (1), and the support exceeds the supported (2).

children.text: बिधि अधिक जहां आधारतें आधेय अधिक आधेयते आधार अधिक २
children.translated_text: First: for example, 'Hearing the letter, the two brothers were thrilled; the excess of love could not be contained in the body.'

children.text: प्रथम यथा सुनि पाती पुलके दोउभ्राता । अधिकसनेह समातन गाता ।।
children.translated_text: Second: for example, 'The all-pervading <s>Brahman</s>, stainless, beyond qualities, without sport — that unborn one, by the power of <s>prema</s> (love) and

children.text: दूसरो यथा व्यापक ब्रह्म निरंजन निर्गुण बिगत बिनोद । सो अजप्रेम
children.translated_text: <s>bhakti</s> (devotion), [sits] in <s>Kausalyā's</s> lap.' Now, <s>alpasūkṣma</s> (minute subtlety): an extremely subtle support for the supported —

children.text: भक्ति बश कौशल्याके गोद ।। अथ अल्पसूक्ष्म आधेयते अति सूक्ष्म आ-
children.translated_text: for example, 'On every hair, tens of millions of universes reside.' Now, <s>anyonya</s> (mutual): through mutual

children.text: धार यथा रोम रोम प्रतिलागे कोटि कोटिब्रह्मंड । अथ अन्योन्बापरस्पर
children.translated_text: assistance — for example, 'Meeting the sage, thus shines the Gracious One.' Now, threefold <s>viśeṣa</s> (distinction):

children.text: उपकारते यथा मुनिहिं मिलत अस सोह कृपाला । अथ त्रिबिधि विशेष
children.translated_text: two [types of] support and supported (1); accomplishing much from little (2); describing one in many places (3).

children.text: बे आधार आधेय १ थोड़ करेते सिद्ध बहु २ एकको अनेक ठौर बरणै ३
children.translated_text: First: for example, 'Having seized the mountain, it ran in the night, bowing.' Second: for example, 'A <s>mantra</s> (sacred syllable), extremely small,

children.text: प्रथम यथा गहिगिरि निशि नमधावत भयऊ । दूसरो यथा मंत्रपरम लघु
children.translated_text: under whose power are <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Hari</s>, <s>Hara</s>, and all the gods.' Third: for example, '<s>Satī</s> saw a wonder on the path —

children.text: जासु बश बिधि हरिहर सुरसर्ब । तीसरो यथा सती दीख कौतुक मगजा-
children.translated_text: ahead, <s>Rāma</s> together with Śrī [<s>Sītā</s>] and his brother. Turning back, she saw the Lord behind [her] again.' Now,

children.text: ता ।। आगे राम सहित श्रीभ्राता ।। फिरं वितवा पाछे प्रभु देखा । अथ
children.translated_text: <s>vyāghāta</s> (obstruction) is of two kinds: doing one task instead of another (1); the effect arising from an opposing cause (2).

children.text: ब्याघात द्विबिधि और काजतें और काजकरै १ विरोधीते कारजहोइ २
children.translated_text: First: for example, 'Behold, father, the beautiful spring — to me, bereft of my beloved, it produces fear.'

children.text: प्रथम यथा देखहु तात बसंत सोहावा । प्रियाहीन मोहिं भय उपजावा ।।
children.translated_text: Second: for example, 'Preserve me until the [appointed] time, knowing [me] alive; O Friend of the wretched,

children.text: दूसरो यथा राखिय अवथजु अवधिलगि रहतजानि अप्रान । दीनबन्धु
children.translated_text: [I shall remain] in <s>Avadha</s> (Ayodhyā).'

children.text: सुन्दर सुखद शील सनेह निधान ।। अथ कारनमाला उत्तर उत्तरहोय
children.translated_text: Beautiful, pleasant, a treasure of virtue and affection. Now <s>Kāraṇamālā</s> (Chain of Causes) — where each subsequent [effect] arises

children.text: पूरबकाज यथा बिनु सतसंग बिबेक न होई । रामकृपा बिनु सुलभ न
children.translated_text: from the preceding cause, as for example: "Without <s>satsaṅga</s> (holy company), discrimination does not arise; without the grace of <s>Rāma</s>, it is not easily

children.text: सोई ।। अथ एकावली जंजीराजोर पदकरे यथा बिनु गुरु होइ कि ज्ञानु
children.translated_text: attained." Now <s>Ekāvalī</s> (Single String) — where words are strung together like links in a chain, as for example: "Without a <s>guru</s>, can there be <s>jñāna</s> (knowledge)?

children.text: ज्ञान कि होइ बिरागुबिनु । अथ मालादीपक दपिक एकाबलमिलले यथा
children.translated_text: Can <s>jñāna</s> exist without <s>vairāgya</s> (dispassion)?" Now <s>Mālādīpaka</s> (Garland Illuminator) — where one element illuminates another in sequence, as for example:

children.text: जप जग रामराम जपजेही अथसार एकतेंएक अधिक यथा सबतें अधिक
children.translated_text: "<s>Japa</s> (repetition), <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice), <s>Rāma</s>, <s>Rāma</s> — chant this." Now <s>Sāra</s> (Climax) — where each succeeds the previous in excellence, as for example: "Of all, most dear to me

children.text: मनुज मोहिं भाये ।। अरु तिन्हमहुँ निगम धर्म अनुसारी ।। इत्यादि अथ
children.translated_text: are humans. And among them, those who follow the <s>dharma</s> of the <s>Vedas</s>." Et cetera. Now

children.text: न्यूनसार यथा एक मंद मैं मोहबश कुटिलहृदय अज्ञान ।। पुनि प्रभु मोहिं
children.translated_text: <s>Nyūnasāra</s> (Anti-climax) — as for example: "I alone am dull, under the sway of delusion, crooked-hearted and ignorant. Moreover, the Lord has

children.text: बिसारेउ दीनबंधु भगवान ।। अथ यथासंख्यबरणन विर्षे वस्तु अनुक्रमतें
children.translated_text: forgotten me — <s>Dīnabandhu Bhagavān</s> (God, friend of the wretched)." Now <s>Yathāsaṅkhya</s> (Enumeration in Order) — where items are described in sequence,

children.text: यथा बंदौ रामनाम रघुबरको । हेतुकृशानु भानु हिमकरको ।। अथ द्विविध
children.translated_text: as for example: "I salute the name of <s>Rāma</s>, chief of the <s>Raghus</s>, the cause of fire, sun, and moon." Now there are two kinds [of <s>Paryāya</s>]:

children.text: पर्याय अनेक को क्रम तें आश्रय एक २ पुनः एकको आश्रय अनेक
children.translated_text: <s>Paryāya</s> (Alternation) — [first], many things are sequentially assigned to one subject; [second], one thing is assigned to many subjects.

children.text: प्रथम यथा जनक लहेउ सुखशोचबिहाई । दूसरो यथा नाम अनंत अनंत
children.translated_text: The first, as for example: "<s>Janaka</s> attained happiness, abandoning sorrow." The second, as for example: "The Name is infinite, infinite

children.text: गुण अमित कथा बिस्तार । अय प्रवृत्ति कछु कछुको बदलनो यथा तारा
children.translated_text: are its qualities, immeasurable the expanse of its narrative." Now <s>Pravṛtti</s> (Exchange) — where things exchange attributes with each other, as for example: "Seeing <s>Tārā</s>

children.text: बिकलदेखि रघुराया। दीन्हज्ञान हरलीन्हीमाया ।। अथ परसंख्याएकठौर
children.translated_text: distressed, <s>Raghurāya</s> (Lord <s>Rāma</s>) bestowed knowledge and <s>Hari</s> (Viṣṇu) removed [her] <s>māyā</s> (illusion)." Now <s>Parasaṅkhyā</s> (Relative Enumeration) — where [an attribute] is denied in one place

children.text: बरजिकै दूसरेठौर ठहरे यथा मणिमुक्तामाणिक छबिजैसी ।। अहिगिरिगज
children.translated_text: and affirmed in another, as for example: "The splendor of gems, pearls, and rubies — upon the heads of serpents, mountains, and elephants

children.text: शिरसोहन तैसी ।। नृपकिरीट तरुणीतनपाई । लहहिं सकल शोभा अ-
children.translated_text: it adorns just so. When placed upon kings's crowns and the bodies of young women, all beauty is

children.text: धिकाई ।। अथ बिकल्प यहहै कि वह यथा की तनप्राण कि केवलप्राना ।
children.translated_text: greatly enhanced." Now <s>Vikalpa</s> (Alternative) — "is it this or that?", as for example: "Is it body-and-life, or life alone?"

children.text: अथ द्विविध समुच्चय भावबहुत एकठौर गूथेहोइ १ एक काज चाहै अनेक
children.translated_text: Now <s>Samuccaya</s> (Aggregation) is of two kinds: [1] where many sentiments are woven together in one place; [2] where one task requires many

children.text: अंग होय २ प्रथम यथा चकृत चितव मुँदरी पहिंचानी । हर्ष बिषादहृदय
children.translated_text: components. The first, as for example: "Astonished, she gazed and recognized the ring; joy and sorrow made her heart

children.text: अकुलानी ।। दूसर यथा अब मैं कुशल मिटे भयभारे । देखि राम पद
children.translated_text: agitated." The second, as for example: "Now I am well, the burden of fear has been removed, having beheld the lotus feet of <s>Rāma</s>,

children.text: कमल तुम्हारे ।। अथ कारक दीपक एकमों क्रमतें अनेकभाव यथा
children.translated_text: which are yours." Now <s>Kārakadīpaka</s> (Agent Illuminator) — where in a single [construction], various sentiments arise sequentially, as for example:

children.text: बारबार मुख चुंबति माता । नयन नेह जल पुलकित गाता ।। अथ
children.translated_text: "The mother kissed his face again and again; tears of affection flowed from her eyes, and her body was thrilled." Now

children.text: समाधि और हेतु मिल कारज सुगम होइ यथा वचन सुनत कपि
children.translated_text: <s>Samādhi</s> (Combination) — when cause and instrument combine, the task becomes easy, as for example: "Hearing the words, the monkey

children.text: मन मुसुकाना । भई सहाय शारद मैं जाना ।। अथ काव्यार्थ प्रति
children.translated_text: smiled inwardly. I knew that <s>Śāradā</s> (Sarasvatī) had come to my aid." Now <s>Kāvyārtha</s> (Poetic Implication) —

children.text: यह कियो वहक्या यथा जितेउ सुरासुर तब श्रम नाहीं । नर बानर
children.translated_text: "this was done, so what of that?", as for example: "You conquered gods and demons then without effort; of what account are men and monkeys

children.text: केहिलेखे माहीं ।। अथकाव्य लिंग युक्तितें अर्थ समर्थन होय यथा सो
children.translated_text: compared to them?" Now <s>Kāvyaliṅga</s> (Poetic Mark) — where meaning is supported through reasoning, as for example: "How could that

children.text: नर क्यों दशकंध बालिबध्यो जेहि एकशर । अथ अर्थान्तरन्यास समान
children.translated_text: man [be merely human], O <s>Daśakaṇṭha</s> (Rāvaṇa), who slew <s>Bāli</s> with a single arrow?" Now <s>Arthāntaranyāsa</s> (Corroboration) — where a general [truth] strengthens

children.text: विशेष दृढ़तें यथा राम एकतापस तिय तारी । इहांते नाम प्रसाद
children.translated_text: a particular [statement], as for example: "<s>Rāma</s> alone delivered the wife of the ascetic." From this to "By the grace of the Name,

children.text: शोच नहिं सपने । इहांलौ अथ बिकस्वर जहां विशेषहोय पुनि समान वि-
children.translated_text: there is no sorrow even in dreams" — up to this point. Now <s>Vikasvara</s> (Expanding Figure) — where first a particular is stated, then a general principle

children.text: शेष यथा सुमिरि पवनसुत पावननामू । अपने बशकर राखेउ रामू ।। अपत
children.translated_text: supports it, as for example: "Remembering the sacred name of the son of the Wind [<s>Hanumān</s>], <s>Rāma</s> kept him under His own control. The fallen

children.text: अजामिल गज गणिकाऊ । भयेमुक्त हरिनाम प्रभाऊ ।अथ प्रौढ़ोक्ति वर्णन
children.translated_text: <s>Ajāmila</s>, the elephant [<s>Gajendra</s>], and the courtesan [<s>Gaṇikā</s>] — they all became liberated by the power of <s>Hari's</s> name." Now <s>Prauḍhokti</s> (Hyperbole) — where description involves

children.text: में अधिकाई अधिकार यथा कामकलभ करि भुज बल सीवां अथ सम्भा
children.translated_text: exaggeration and amplification, as for example: "The young elephant of <s>Kāma</s> (desire) [is no match for] the boundary of his arm-strength." Now <s>Sambhāvanā</s>

children.text: वना ज्यों ऐसा होइ तो ऐसा होय यथा जो छबि सुधा पयोनिधि होई ।
children.translated_text: (Supposition) — "if such were the case, then such would follow", as for example: "If beauty were an ocean of nectar,

children.text: यह प्रसंगभर अथ मिथ्या घौं सित झूठहिं कथे झूठी रीति यथा बारिमथे
children.translated_text: this passage fills it." Now <s>Mithyā</s> (Impossibility) — describing something by stating an impossible condition, as for example: "Sooner would butter come from churning water, sooner oil from sand."

children.text: घृतहोइ बरु सिकताते बरुतेल । अथ ललित जो कहो चाहै ताहीको प्रति
children.translated_text: Now <s>Lalita</s> (Elegant Expression) — where what one wishes to say is expressed through a mirror-image, as for example: "Beloved, you shall not win

children.text: बिम्ब यथा पिय तुम नाहिं जितब संग्रामा। जाकेदूत्केर यह कामा ।। अथ
children.translated_text: the battle — [consider] whose messenger accomplished this deed." Now <s>Praharṣaṇa</s> (Delightful Surprise) is of three kinds: [1] where the desired result comes without effort;

children.text: त्रिबिध प्रहर्षण बिनु यतन इच्छाफल होइ १ इच्छातें अधिकफल बिना
children.translated_text: [2] where the result exceeds the desire — obtained without labor; [3] where one's effort directly bears fruit. The first, as for example:

children.text: श्रम मिलै २ याको यतन सीधे सो हाथ मिलै २ प्रथम यथा चितवत पंथ
children.translated_text: "I was watching the path day and night.

children.text: रहेउँदिनराती । अबप्रमुदखिजुड़ानीछाती ।। दूसरो यथा धरहुधीर होइहि
children.translated_text: Now joy has come and my heart is soothed." The second, as for example: "Take courage — you shall have four

children.text: सुत चारी । त्रिभुवन बिदित भक्त भय हारी ।। अथ तीसरो एहि बिधिमन
children.translated_text: sons, renowned in all three worlds, who remove the fear of devotees." Now the third: "Having thus reflected in his mind, the king —

children.text: विचारकर राजा । आइगये कपि सहित समाजा ।। अथ बिषाद चितचाह
children.translated_text: the monkeys arrived along with their assembly." Now <s>Viṣāda</s> (Dismay) — where the opposite of what the heart desires occurs, as for example: "He set out to draw the moon but drew <s>Rāhu</s> [instead]."

children.text: ते उलटा जो होय यथा लिखत सुधाकरगा लिखि राहू । उल्लास गुण
children.translated_text: Now <s>Ullāsa</s> (Exultation) — where the qualities

children.text: औगुण औरको और भये यथा परदुख दुख सुख सुख देख पर । अथ अव
children.translated_text: and faults of others produce opposite effects, as for example: "Sorrow at another's sorrow, joy at another's joy." Now <s>Avajñā</s>

children.text: ज्ञा और को गुण दोष न लगै यथा ऊषर बरषै तृण नहिं जामा।अथ लेस
children.translated_text: (Disregard) — where another's qualities and faults have no effect, as for example: "Rain falls on barren land, but no grass grows." Now <s>Leśa</s>

children.text: गुणमों दोष देखे १ दोषमों गुण देखे २ यथा मोहिं दीन्ह सुख सुयश सु-
children.translated_text: (Trace) — [1] seeing fault in a quality; [2] seeing quality in a fault — as for example: "He gave me happiness, good fame, and a fine

children.text: राजू।कीन्हकैकई सबकर काजू ।। दूतरो यथा जोनहिंहोत मोह अतिमोहीं।
children.translated_text: kingdom — <s>Kaikeyī</s> accomplished everyone's purpose." The second, as for example: "Had there not been such excessive delusion,

children.text: मिलतेउं तात कवन विधि तेहीं।।अथ अनुकै दोषै गुणमाने यथा रामहिं
children.translated_text: how, father, would I have met Him?" Now <s>Anukā</s> (Favorable Interpretation) — where even a fault is regarded as a virtue, as for example: "Gazing at <s>Rāma</s>,

children.text: चितव सुरेश सुजानागौतम शाप परम हित माना ।। अथ मुद्रा प्रस्तुत
children.translated_text: wise <s>Indra</s> considered <s>Gautama's</s> curse to be supremely beneficial." Now <s>Mudrā</s> (Seal/Hidden Meaning) — where the words of the text

children.text: पद बिषै औरै अर्थ प्रकाशै यथा पूछेउ गुनिनरेखतिन्हखांची । भरतभुआल
children.translated_text: reveal another meaning, as for example: "He asked the learned ones, and they drew the [astrological] chart; <s>Bharata</s> shall be king —

children.text: होहिं यह सांची।।अथ रत्नावली प्रस्तुत विषय और नामक्रमतें यथा बहुरि
children.translated_text: is this true?" Now <s>Ratnāvalī</s> (String of Gems) — where the subject is described through a sequence of names, as for example: "Then [he said] child, then darling,

children.text: बच्छ कहि लाल कहि रघुपति रघुवर तात । अथ तद्गुण आपनो गुण
children.translated_text: then <s>Raghupati</s>, <s>Raghuvar</s>, father." Now <s>Tadguṇa</s> (Acquiring Another's Quality) — where one abandons one's own quality and takes on

children.text: छोड़ और को लेइ यथा धमौ तजै सहज करुआई ।। अगरु प्रसंग सुगन्ध
children.translated_text: another's, as for example: "<s>Dhūpa</s> (incense) abandons its natural bitterness; <s>agaru</s> (aloewood), through association, is infused with

children.text: बसाई अथ पूर्व रूप द्विबिध संगतिको गुण लेइ तजि पुनः अपनो
children.translated_text: fragrance." Now <s>Pūrvarūpa</s> (Prior Form) is of two kinds: [1] where one acquires the quality of one's companion and then reclaims one's own

children.text: गुण लेइ १ जहां गुण न मिटै यतन हूं किये ते २ प्रथम यथा खल
children.translated_text: quality; [2] where the quality does not disappear despite all efforts. The first, as for example: "The wicked are reformed by finding good

children.text: उबरहिंभल पाइ सुसंगू । मिटइन मलिन सुभाव अभंगू ।। दूसरो
children.translated_text: company, but their impure nature, being unbreakable, does not truly perish." The second,

children.text: यथा राकापति षोडश उअहिंतारागण समुदाय।सकल गिरिन्ह दवलाइ
children.translated_text: as for example: "The full moon, with the host of sixteen [phases], and the multitude of stars — they illuminate all the mountains,

children.text: अबिनु रबिराति न जाय।।अथ अतद्गुन आनके संगहु गुनलेइन जानको
children.translated_text: but without the sun, night does not depart." Now <s>Atadguṇa</s> (Not Acquiring Another's Quality) — where one does not take on the quality of one's companion,

children.text: यथा बायस पालहिं अति अनरागा । होहिं निरामिष कबहुं कि कागा ।।
children.translated_text: as for example: "Though you nurture crows with great affection, can crows ever become vegetarian?"

children.text: अथ अन्य गुन अपनो गुन औरके संग बढावै यथा मज्जन फल दंखिय
children.translated_text: Now <s>Anyaguṇa</s> (Another's Quality Enhances One's Own) — where one's own quality is enhanced by another's association, as for example: "The fruit of bathing is seen

children.text: ततकाला । काकहोहिं पिकवकउ मराला।। अथ मिलित सम ताते दूजो
children.translated_text: immediately — crows become cuckoos and cranes become swans." Now <s>Milita</s> (Merged) — where because of similarity, one cannot distinguish the other, as for example:

children.text: न लखाइ यथा बेनु हरित मनिमय सब कीन्हें । सरलस पर्ब परहिं नहिं
children.translated_text: "All the bamboos were made [to look] like green gems; being straight, their joints could not be

children.text: चीन्हें ।। अथ समान भिन्नौ रूपसों बिशेषन पाइये यथा राम लषण सखि
children.translated_text: discerned." Now <s>Samāna</s> (Equal) — where distinction is perceived despite similarity of form, as for example: "Friend, are <s>Rāma</s> and <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>

children.text: होहिं कि नाहीं । अथ उनमिलत सादृश्यते भेद कैसो खुलै यथा बयबपु
children.translated_text: [the same] or not?" Now <s>Unmilat</s> (Unfolding) — where despite resemblance, distinction is revealed, as for example: "The same age, form,

children.text: वरनरूप सोइ आली । शील सनेह सरिस सम चाली ।। वे पुनिसो सखि
children.translated_text: complexion, and appearance, O friend; equal in virtue, affection, and conduct. Yet those [two] again, friend,

children.text: सीयन संगा । आगे चली अनी चतुरंगा अथ गूढोक्ति अभिप्राय से उत्तर
children.translated_text: are with <s>Sītā</s>; the fourfold army marches ahead." Now <s>Gūḍhokti</s> (Concealed Speech) — where an answer is given according to one's true intent, as for example:

children.text: देय यथा अब कहु कुशल बालि कह अहई।बिहंसि बचनतब अंगदकहई।।
children.translated_text: "Now tell me, is <s>Bāli</s> well?" — says [<s>Rāma</s>]. Smiling, <s>Aṅgada</s> then replied:

children.text: दिन दश गये बालिपहं जाई । बृझेउ कुशल सखा उर लाई ।। अथ
children.translated_text: "I went to <s>Bāli</s> for ten days; he embraced me and asked about [your] welfare, O friend." Now

children.text: प्रश्नोत्तर प्रश्नउत्तर जामों होय यथा कह दशकंठ कवन तैं बंदर । मैं
children.translated_text: <s>Praśnottara</s> (Question and Answer) — where both question and answer occur, as for example: "<s>Daśakaṇṭha</s> (Rāvaṇa) said: What kind of monkey are you? — I am the messenger of <s>Raghuvīra</s>,

children.text: रधुबीर दूत दशकंधर।।अथ विन प्रश्न उत्तर एकपद में होय यथा काबर्षा
children.translated_text: O <s>Daśakaṇṭha</s>." Now [a case where] without a question, the answer occurs within a single verse, as for example: "What use is rain

children.text: जब कृपी सुखानि । समय चूकि पुनिका पछताने ।। अथ सूक्ष्म कवनोभाव
children.translated_text: when the crop has dried up? Having missed the right time, what use is remorse?" Now <s>Sūkṣma</s> (Subtle) — where one knows the other's mind through some indication,

children.text: ते मनकी बात जाने यथा सातहि सभय देखि रघुराई । कहा अनुजसन
children.translated_text: as for example: "Seeing <s>Sītā</s> fearful, <s>Raghurāī</s> (Lord <s>Rāma</s>) communicated to his younger brother

children.text: सैन बुझाई।। अथ पिहित छिपी बात वतायदेइ यथा अंगद नाम बालि
children.translated_text: through a gesture." Now <s>Pihita</s> (Concealed) — where a hidden matter is revealed, as for example: "<s>Aṅgada</s> by name, the son of <s>Bāli</s> —

children.text: करबेटा । तासों कबहुंकि भईहि भेंटा ।। अथव्याजोक्ति आकार छिपाय
children.translated_text: will there ever be an encounter with him?" Now <s>Vyājokti</s> (Pretextual Speech) — where one conceals one's [true] form and speaks

children.text: और बिधि कहै यथा जिन्हहिं बिरचि बड़भयउ बिधाता । महिमा अवधि
children.translated_text: in a different manner, as for example: "He by creating whom the Creator became great — the limit of glory,

children.text: राम पितु माता ।। अथ मूढ़ोक्ति औरके बहाने औरको उपदेश करै यथा
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma's</s> father and mother." Now <s>Mūḍhokti</s> (Indirect Instruction) — where under the pretext of advising one, another is instructed, as for example:

children.text: बहुरि गौरिकर ध्यान करेहू । भूप किशोर देखि किनलेहू ।। अथ विघ्नोक्ति
children.translated_text: "Meditate again upon <s>Gaurī</s>; O king, why did you take [interest in] a young man?" Now <s>Vighnokti</s> (Obstacle Speech) —

children.text: श्लेषमों छिपैको प्रकाश करै यथा प्रीति बिरोध समानसन करिय नीति
children.translated_text: where what is hidden within <s>śleṣa</s> (double meaning) is revealed, as for example: "One should practice friendship and enmity according to

children.text: अस आहि । जो मृगपति वधि मंडुकनि भलकि कहै कोउ ताहि ।।
children.translated_text: proper policy. Who would call it good if one kills a lion to [save] frogs?"

children.text: अथ युक्ति क्रियाकरि बरण छिपावै यथा बहुरि वदन बिषु अंचल
children.translated_text: Now <s>Yukti</s> (Contrivance) — where an action is described while concealing [the true purpose], as for example: "Then she covered her face with her veil,

children.text: ढांकी । पियतन चितइ भौंहकरि बांकी ।। खंजन मंजु तिरीछे नै-
children.translated_text: gazed at her beloved with arched eyebrows; with beautiful, sidelong <s>khañjana</s>-bird-like

children.text: ननि । निज पति कहेउ तिन्हहिं सिय सैननि ।। अथ लोकोक्ति कधृ
children.translated_text: eyes, <s>Sītā</s> conveyed to her lord through those gestures." Now <s>Lokokti</s> (Proverb) — taking a common

children.text: बवनते प्रवाद । लेइ यथा मास दिवसमहँनाथनआवा। तौ पुनि मोहिं
children.translated_text: saying [to convey meaning], as for example: "If in a month's time my lord does not come, then he shall not find me

children.text: जियतनहिं पावा ।। वक्रोक्ति सूधी बातमों टेढ़ो भाव यथा मैं सुकुमार
children.translated_text: alive." <s>Vakrokti</s> (Crooked Speech) — where a straight statement carries a crooked meaning, as for example: "I am delicate, my lord, and the forest is my destiny;

children.text: नाथ बनयोगू । तुमहिं उचित तप मोकहं भोगू ।। अथ सुभावोक्ति जहां
children.translated_text: for you, austerity is fitting, and for me, enjoyment." Now <s>Svabhāvokti</s> (Natural Description) — where the natural state is described:

children.text: सुभाव बरनो जाइ भोजन करत चपल चित इत उत अवसर पाइ ।
children.translated_text: "While eating, with restless mind, [the children look] here and there, and finding an opportunity,

children.text: भागि चले किलकात मुख दधि ओदन लपटाइ।।अथ भाविक भूत भवि-
children.translated_text: they run away, mouths smeared with yogurt and rice, shouting joyfully." Now <s>Bhāvika</s> (Evocative) — where past, future,

children.text: ष्यादि जहां प्रत्यक्ष लखाय यथा भयउ न अहइ न अब होनिहारा । भूप
children.translated_text: etc. appear as if directly perceived, as for example: "There has never been, nor is, nor ever shall be a king

children.text: भरत जस पिता तुम्हारा ।। अथ उदात अथ लक्षणअधिकारीदैसोम्यिये
children.translated_text: like <s>Bharata</s>, like your father." Now <s>Udātta</s> (Noble) — where the characteristics of a worthy recipient are described,

children.text: यथा बालि न कबहुं गाल अस मारा। मिल तपसिन तैं भयउ लवारा।।अ
children.translated_text: as for example: "<s>Bāli</s> never made such a boast; from association with ascetics, you have become a braggart." Now

children.text: थाप्युक्ति बहुतवढ़ायकै कहै यथा जो सम्पदा नीच गृह सोहा।सो बिलोकि
children.translated_text: <s>Apyukti</s> (Overstatement) — where something is described with great exaggeration, as for example: "The splendor that adorns even a lowly house — seeing it,

children.text: सुरनायक मोहा।।अथ निरुक्ति जहां योगतें नामको औरै अर्थ कल्पे यथा
children.translated_text: the lord of the gods was enchanted." Now <s>Nirukti</s> (Etymology) — where a name is given a different meaning through etymology, as for example:

children.text: नाम तुम्हार प्रताप दिनेशा।सत्यकेतु तव पिता नरेशा।। अथ प्रतिषेध जहां
children.translated_text: "Your name is <s>Pratāpa</s> (valor), O <s>Dineśa</s> (lord of the day); your father is King <s>Satyaketu</s>." Now <s>Pratiṣedha</s> (Prohibition/Negation) — where

children.text: निषेध को बखाने यथा मुकुट न होहिं भूपगुण चारी।अथ बिधि फेरकैअर्थ
children.translated_text: a negation is described, as for example: "Without the four royal virtues, a crown does not [truly] exist." Now <s>Vidhi</s> (Injunction) — where meaning is established through reversal,

children.text: साधै यथा याको फल पावहुगे आगे । बानर भालु चपेटन लागे।।अथ हेतु
children.translated_text: as for example: "You shall receive the fruit of this in future — the monkeys and bears have begun their attacks." Now <s>Hetu</s> (Cause)

children.text: द्विबिध कारज कारण एक संगै होइ कारण कारज वस्तु एकै २ प्रथम
children.translated_text: is of two kinds: [1] where cause and effect occur together; [2] where cause and effect are one and the same entity. The first,

children.text: यथा उयउ अरुण अवलोकहु तातापंकज कोक लोक सुख दाता।।दूसरो
children.translated_text: as for example: "The dawn has risen — behold, O father — the lotus, the <s>cakravāka</s> bird, the world's bestower of happiness." The second,

children.text: यथा सकल अमानुष करम तिहारे । केवलकौशिक कृपासुधारे ।। इति
children.translated_text: as for example: "All your deeds are superhuman; only by the grace of <s>Kauśika</s> (<s>Viśvāmitra</s>) are they accomplished." Thus ends

children.text: अर्था लंकार अथ शंका संसृष्टि एक छंदमों जहां बहुत अलंकार परैं
children.translated_text: the section on <s>arthālaṅkāra</s> (figures of meaning). Now <s>Śaṅkā-Saṃsṛṣṭi</s> (Doubtful Combination) — where in a single verse, many <s>alaṅkāras</s> occur together,

children.text: तिल तंदुल न्याय यथा चली ल्याइसीतहिसखी सादरस जिसुमगल
children.translated_text: following the <s>tila-taṇḍula nyāya</s> (principle of sesame and rice), as for example: "The companions reverently brought <s>Sītā</s>, the auspicious

children.text: भामिनी । नवलप्तसाजेसुन्दरी सबमत्त कुंजरगामिनी । कलगान सुनि
children.translated_text: lady, adorned with fresh cosmetics, all beautiful women walking with the gait of intoxicated elephants;

children.text: मुनि ध्यानत्यागहिं काम कोकिललाजहीं ।मंजीर नूपुर कलितकिंकिनि
children.translated_text: hearing their melodious songs, sages abandon meditation and <s>Kāma</s> (desire) puts the <s>kokila</s> (cuckoo) to shame; anklets, foot-ornaments, and tinkling bells

children.text: तालगति बरबाजहीं ।। टी० कुंजर गामिनीमों रूपक ध्यान संगेमों
children.translated_text: sound rhythmically in time with their steps." Commentary: In "elephant-gaited" there is <s>rūpaka</s> (metaphor); in "abandoning meditation" there is

children.text: अन्योक्ति लाजहिं तीतरी प्रतीप अथशंकर दो तीन अलंकार मिलेतें
children.translated_text: <s>anyokti</s> (allegory); in "putting to shame" there is <s>pratīpa</s> (contrast). Now <s>Śaṅkara</s> (Blending) — where two or three <s>alaṅkāras</s> blend together

children.text: छीर नीर न्याय यथा जिनके यश प्रताप के आगे । शशि मलीन रबि
children.translated_text: following the <s>kṣīra-nīra nyāya</s> (principle of milk and water), as for example: "Before whose fame and valor, the moon appears dim and the sun

children.text: शीतललागे।।टी०यामों यथा शेष प्रतीपको शंकरहै एकसुक आगेते समा-
children.translated_text: appears cool." Commentary: In this, the remainder after <s>pratīpa</s> (contrast) is <s>śaṅkara</s> (blending); at one level, before the comparison,

children.text: नहो प्रधान अरु कहुं संदेहते शंकरको तीन प्रकार और अलंकार बहुतहैं
children.translated_text: the dominant figure appears; and sometimes through doubt, <s>śaṅkara</s> is of three types. There are many more <s>alaṅkāras</s>

children.text: बिस्तारकाव्यके ग्रंथनमें। देखिलेंगे अथकछु पिंगलयातें कि काव्य शरीर
children.translated_text: which will be seen in the detailed texts on poetics. Now, some [discussion of] <s>Piṅgala</s> (prosody) — since the body of poetry

children.text: छंद रीतिहीहै अथगुरु लघु बिधि संयोगीके आदिगुरुयथासत्य अरुबिसर्ग
children.translated_text: is meter. Now, regarding <s>guru</s> (heavy) and <s>laghu</s> (light) syllables: a conjunct consonant at the beginning makes it <s>guru</s>, as for example <s>satya</s>; and a <s>visarga</s>,

children.text: यथाकः अरुदीर्घ मात्रा बिंदुयुक्त यथा काकी कूके कोकौ कं अरुपादअंत
children.translated_text: as for example <s>kaḥ</s>; and a long vowel, or one with a <s>bindu</s> (nasal dot), as for example <s>kākī kūke kokau kaṃ</s>; and at the end of a <s>pāda</s> (verse-quarter),

children.text: मों बिकल्प ये पांचो बिधि गुरु अथलघुमात्रारहित लघु आरु इउमात्रालगे
children.translated_text: optionally — these five ways [produce a] <s>guru</s>. Now <s>laghu</s> — a syllable without a long vowel is <s>laghu</s>; and even with the vowels <s>i</s> and <s>u</s>,

children.text: हूं लघुअरुकाहूं आदि संयोगिके लघुकोलघुहीरहतहै भारन परेते जैसेनाम
children.translated_text: it remains <s>laghu</s>; and in the case of an initial conjunct, the preceding <s>laghu</s> remains <s>laghu</s>. When weight falls upon it, then [it becomes heavy], as in <s>nāma</s>,

children.text: प्रेम पियूष हृदइत्यादि अथ प्रस्तार मात्रातुत्तको मात्रावृत्तके गण पांच हैं
children.translated_text: <s>prema</s>, <s>pīyūṣa</s>, <s>hṛdaya</s>, etc. Now <s>prastāra</s> (metrical expansion): for <s>mātrā-vṛtta</s> (moraic meters), there are five <s>gaṇas</s> (metrical feet):

children.text: ठगनछकल डमन पांच कलडगन चारि कलठगन तीन कलणगन द्वैकल
children.translated_text: <s>Ṭha-gaṇa</s> [has] six <s>kalās</s> (morae); <s>Ḍa-gaṇa</s> [has] five <s>kalās</s>; <s>Ḍa-gaṇa</s> [has] four <s>kalās</s>; <s>Ṭha-gaṇa</s> [has] three <s>kalās</s>; <s>Ṇa-gaṇa</s> [has] two <s>kalās</s>.

children.text: अथ प्रस्तार रीति मात्राको नवमें गुरुके नीचे लघु बनावै पुनः समपांति
children.translated_text: Now the method of <s>prastāra</s> (expansion) for <s>mātrā</s> (moraic meters): below a <s>guru</s> in the new [row], place a <s>laghu</s>; then make the rows equal;

children.text: करै उबरै जो गुरुलघुते पूरण करै सबलहूलो अथ पांवो मात्रा गनषट
children.translated_text: whatever remains, complete it with <s>guru</s> and <s>laghu</s>; [continue] until all [rows are filled]. Now, the counting of <s>mātrās</s> up to six

children.text: कललौं उदाहरण अथ बरण प्रस्तार रीति प्रथम गुरुके तरे लघु धरे फिर
children.translated_text: <s>kalās</s>, with examples. Now the method of <s>varṇa-prastāra</s> (syllabic expansion): first, below the <s>guru</s>, place a <s>laghu</s>; then

children.text: अन्तको पाती बराबर करे जो घटे तो गुरुहीते पांति पूण करे तब प्रस्तार
children.translated_text: make the end rows equal; if any are short, complete the row with <s>guru</s> only; then know that the <s>prastāra</s>

children.text: को अन्त जानै अरु बरणके प्रस्तारमें बरणकी गिंती होतहै अरु मात्रा
children.translated_text: has ended. And in the <s>varṇa-prastāra</s>, the count is of syllables (<s>varṇa</s>); and in the <s>mātrā</s>-

children.text: प्रस्तारमें कलागनती इतनाही भेदहै यथा मात्रावृत्त संज्ञा बरण ।।
children.translated_text: <s>prastāra</s>, the count is of <s>kalās</s> (morae) — this is the only difference. As for example, <s>mātrā-vṛtta</s> designations and syllables:

44. <s>Dohā</s>: Printed in clear type with proper markings — as if the imperishable abode of speech made manifest for the skilled. 45. <s>Sorathā</s>: <s>Īśvarakavi Kavirāja</s> composed this magnificent introduction,

children.text: णगन२
children.translated_text: <s>Ṇa-gaṇa</s> — 2 [morae]

children.text: टगण३
children.translated_text: <s>Ṭa-gaṇa</s> — 3 [morae]

children.text: डगन४
children.translated_text: <s>Ḍa-gaṇa</s> — 4 [morae]

children.text: ढगन५
children.translated_text: <s>Ḍha-gaṇa</s> — 5 [morae]

children.text: टगत्र६
children.translated_text: <s>Ṭa-gaṇa</s> — 6 [morae]

children.text: बरण३रूप
children.translated_text: Three-syllable <s>varṇa</s> patterns:

children.text: गनदेव
children.translated_text: <s>Gaṇa</s>-deity [associations]:

children.text: फलगन
children.translated_text: <s>Phala-gaṇa</s> (fruit-groups):

children.text: ऽऽऽ मगन
children.translated_text: ऽऽऽ — <s>Ma-gaṇa</s> (heavy-heavy-heavy)

children.text: भूमि
children.translated_text: Earth

children.text: मंगल सुख
children.translated_text: Auspiciousness and happiness

children.text: ।ऽऽ यगन
children.translated_text: ।ऽऽ — <s>Ya-gaṇa</s> (light-heavy-heavy)

children.text: जल
children.translated_text: Water

children.text: बुद्धिवृद्धि ज्ञामगन
children.translated_text: Increase of intellect and knowledge

children.translated_text: ।ऽ। — <s>Ra-gaṇa</s> (light-heavy-light)

children.translated_text: ।ऽऽ — <s>Sa-gaṇa</s> (light-heavy-heavy)

children.text: पवनवकाल
children.translated_text: Wind and time

children.text: उचाटमीचु
children.translated_text: <s>Uccāṭa</s> (unsettling) and death

children.text: ऽऽ। तगन
children.translated_text: ऽऽ। — <s>Ta-gaṇa</s> (heavy-heavy-light)

children.text: अकाश
children.translated_text: Space

children.text: फलसुत्र
children.translated_text: Fruit and progeny

children.text: ।ऽ। जगन
children.translated_text: ।ऽ। — <s>Ja-gaṇa</s> (light-heavy-light)

children.text: भानु
children.translated_text: Sun

children.text: रोग
children.translated_text: Disease

children.text: ऽ।। भगन
children.translated_text: ऽ।। — <s>Bha-gaṇa</s> (heavy-light-light)

children.text: चंद
children.translated_text: Moon

children.text: कीरति
